tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (hūm̐ dang*/rgyud btus pod shrī/)༄༅/ /dpal ldan nā ྃrom̐ ta pa'i zhal gyi lung*/ /tshad ma bzhi ldan mkham̐' spyodam̐ dga' ma'i lam/ /brgyud ldan zhal ra
(hūm̐ dang*/rgyud btus pod shrī/)༄༅/ /dpal ldan nā ྃrom̐ ta pa'i zhal gyi lung*/ /tshad ma bzhi ldan mkham̐' spyodam̐ dga' ma'i lam/ /brgyud ldan zhal ra

tei:div.tei:p: (hūm̐ dang*/ rgyud btus pod shrī/)༄༅// dpal ldan nā ྃrom̐ ta pa'i zhal gyi lung*// tshad ma bzhi ldan mkham̐' spyodam̐ dga' ma'i lam// brgyud ldan zhal rlangs ma yal snyingam̐ gi thim̐g /mkha' spyod 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan mdzes rgyan 'di// sprang chal snyom las mkhan gyi snying bcud de// dam med dbang khrid ma thob rtog ge ba// 'di snang gzu lum mkhan gyi spyod yul min// de phyir dpal mgon dur khrod mgon po yis// rab dmar spyan gsum 'khyugs la dus drug gzigs// dam tshig rdo rje'i rwa gdengs sra brtan rgya// sa ma ya: ༈ /na mo gu ru shtsa bha ga wā ti badzra yo gi nī ye/ 'pho med bde chen nyi gzhon snang bas mi 'bral rtag 'khyud rig stong thugs dbyings lha lam cher// mkhyenam̐ dang brtsem̐ ba'i chu khur stug po gsang chen rig pa'i rang gdangs sgra brgya'i nga ro can// thog mtha' bar dge'i dbam̐ng phyug rnam ster chos char gshin pom̐ kum̐n dgam̐'i 'khri shing nges skyed pa// bskal pa rgyun gyi 'khor lor legs stsol he ru kaḥdapal 'jam̐m dbyangam̐s bla mar spyi bos 'dud// dpa' bo'i dbang phyug gtsug gi 'od dkar bdud rtsi'i zegs ma rtag 'bab pa// rgod ma'i rig pa tsaṇḍa līs bzhus lhan skyes bde drod cher 'bar gzi// bde chen raktas mngon par gsal byas stong pa bcu drug dag pa'i lus// dmar bas rab sgeg mkham̐' spyodam̐ dgam̐' mam̐ bdag la thugs rjes rtag brtser mdzod// rnal 'byor dbang mo mngon par rjes chags bdud rtsi'i ro// yang yang myangs des grub pa'i lus zungs yongs brtas shing*// 'phags yul bstan pa'i snang byed gcig pu dpa' bo'i rje// nām̐ rom̐ pam̐ zhes mkhas grub che der dad phyag brtsegs// rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i dbus na legs gnas shing*// thub bstan lhun por bcas pa'i 'dzin ma 'degs// snyan brgyud nor bu'i mdzod 'chang sam̐ skyam̐ pam̐// brgyud bcas klu yi dbang por gus phyag 'tshal// gsang rgyud ngal bsos bu yi gan mdzad nas// yang zab dbang gi rgyal po phyag mtshan du// bzhes te tshad ma bzhi ldan 'dod rgu'i char// 'bebs mkhas tsharam̐ pam̐ chos rje gtsug na mchod// zab gsang slob bshad bum bzang lag brgyud du// rim par 'bebs las bde chen gnas ster ba// dngom̐s brgyudam̐ mkham̐s dang grubam̐ pa'i tshogs kun la'ang*// mi phyed gus pa rab kyi rtse mor gzung*// zhing dang nye ba'i zhing sogs gnas gsum gyi// dpa' mo bde ba mchog gi dgyes sde mo// zhim̐ng sngagam̐s lhanam̐ skyesam̐ rigs kyi ḍākki ma// bgrang yas kun kyang 'dir ni rjes brtser mdzod// rab dkar dung gi ljon par bskal me yis// 'khyud pa'i gzi byin la 'gran zhingam̐ skyongam̐ mgom̐n// dam tshig la dgongs gsang chen myur lam 'di'i// mel tshe g.yel ba med par mdzod cig kye// gzhan yang chos srung dam can rgya mtsho dang*// rgyud sde'i gnyer 'chang ma sring rgya mtsho yis// gsang lam ma 'khrul gang 'dir 'chad spro na// rjes brtse'i gnang ba bzang po da stsol mdzod// deng dus thub pa'i bstan mjug sdud la nye// rang gir spyod rnams bde ba'i grong la dgyes// chos gzugs ltar snang 'chad nyan phyogs tsam la// blo ltos 'cha' ba rtags tsam 'dzin min nam// rang rgyud grub gnyis rtogs pas yongs grol te// gzhan rgyud thugs rje chen pos bde blag 'dul// yid ches rgyud dang rgya gzhung bslad med don// gsal mdzad kho bo'i bla ma gcig pur nges// 'di na lkog gyur nyams myong go yul dang*// bral mod snyan brgyud bdud rtsi mngar po'i rgyun// mi nub srid du bsrings pa'i lhag bsam gyis// gsal la go bder 'chad 'di 'bras med min// thun mong yul min dbang po yang rab chos// mkha' spyod grong du 'khrid pa'i sa mkhan ste// des kyang myur bar myang 'das grong skyel phyir// mdzes pa'i rgyan 'dis klubs shig shes ldan dag

/bshad srol gzhan rgyas ma bkab par// 'khrul zad tshad thub gong ma'i gsung*// 'khrugs bsdebs bdud rtsi'i yang zhun 'di// skal bzang legs bris gzhon nus spyod// ces rnam dkar dge ba'i ngag gis lam yangs par byas te/ de'ang rje btsun mkhas grub chen po blo gsal ri khrod pas/ spyir deng sang dus snyigs mar song*/ tshe yun thung*/ shes bya rnam grangs mang*/ ji ltar byas kyang bstan pa dang sems can la phan pa ni dka' bas/ bstan rgyun dang rang rgyud la phan nges kyi dbang lung nyan bshad re tsam ma gtogs/ 'jig rten gyi bya ba dgra 'dul gnyen skyong sogs phar zhog rang dbang byung na gdul bya zang zing bsdu ba/ thos bsam tsab tsob byed pa/ 'chad nyan gyi 'du long sgrub pa sogs gang la'ang gzhan mgo bskor spyad las dgos pa med/ mdor hril gyis dril na/ nam 'chi cha med bsams nas tshe 'di blos gtang*/ ngo bsrung dang 'gras 'dris spang*/ mchog dman gang la'ang re dogs mi bya/ tshe 'di la zhen pa can gyi rigs dang lta spyod mi bstun/ grub mtha'i phyogs zhen bskyur/ rang tshod rang gis bzung nas mtshams bsnyen sgrub byas byas kyi kha khral 'jal 'dod tsam min par nyams len gsha' ma zhig la rgas rgas 'chi 'chi'i bar snying por dril ba 'thad/ ces bdag gi bla ma la gdams shing*/ bdag gi bla ma rje mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis kyang*/ don med 'jig rten 'khrul ba'i bya gzhag dang*// don nyams chos ltar bcos pa kun spangs nas// don dam nges gsang zab mo'i lam 'di la// don ldan rtse gcig sgrub la brtson par mdzod// ces ji skad brtse bas gdams pa ltar/ 'jig rten gyi bya gzhag la rgyab kyis phyogs te/ snying nas chos don du gnyer ba dag gis ni yang gsang slob bshad kyi gdams pa 'di lta bu zhig la snying nas brtson par bya dgos te/ des ni nges pa nyid du snyigs dus kyi tshe thung gcig la bde ba chen po mngon du byed nus par gdon mi za'o// de'i phyir 'dir yang gsang nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi dmigs khrid ji ltar nod pa zhal shes kyis brgyan nas bklags chog tu bkral bar bya'o// de la'ang*/

bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med thugs rje can de nyid kyis gdul bya rnams kyi mos pa dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ khams dang*/ dbang po dang*/ bag la nyal gyi rim pa dang rjes su mthun par dam pa'i chos kyi phung po dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs pa de dag thams cad phyogs dang ris su bsdu na theg pa chen po dang*/ theg pa dman pa gnyis su 'du ba las/ gtso bor gyur pa ni theg pa chen po'i sde snod yin/ de la'ang nang gses su rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gnyis las/ 'dir mchog tu gyur pa thabs mang ba dang dka' ba med par mchog sgrub nus pa sogs khyad chos du mas mngon par 'phags pa sngags kyi theg pa yin zhing*/ de la'ang bya spyod rnal 'byor bla med kyi rgyud sde bzhir dbye ba las/ snyigs dus kyi tshe thung gcig la sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i thabs rmad du byung ba ni rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud sde rnams yin la/ sngags bla med la'ang*/ thabs snang phyogs sgyu ma'i sku rtsal du bton pa pha rgyud dang*/ shes rab stong phyogs don dam 'od gsal rtsal du bton pa ma rgyud gnyis las mthar thug mchog dman gyi khyad par med kyang*/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir 'grub thag nye zhing byin rlabs kyi tshan kha shin tu che ba ni rnal 'byor ma rgyud kyi skor yin/ de la'ang grangs kyis dbye na bye ba phrag bcu drug yod pa'i nang nas gsang mtha' 'khor lo sdom pa'i skor ni/ ston pas ri rab kyi rtse mor dkyil 'khor dngos su sprul te rgyud gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor deng sang yang dngos su bzhugs nas 'dzam bu'i gling gi yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi sogs su pho nya gsum gyi sprul pa dpag tu med pas 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa dang*/ bshad rgyud rnam pa lngas bkral ba'i bde mchog gsang mtha'i lam mchog tu zab pa sogs rgyu mtshan du mas rab dang*/ mchog dang*/ phul du gyur pa yin la/

de la'ang paṇa grub rnams kyis dgongs pa 'grel tshul mi 'dra ba'i dbang gis bka' srol mang du bzhugs pa las/ rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar mngon par mtho ba ni rtsa rgyud nag po'i skor/ kun spyod lū hi'i skor/ zab don dril bu'i skor te/ slob dpon chen po lū nag dril gsum gyis bkral ba'i zab lam rnams yin zhing*/ de dag gi zab don mthar thug pa snying po lta bu ni yang zab nā ro'i skor 'di nyid kho na ste/ de'ang gdams pa 'di nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rang nyid kyis paṇa grub dbang po nā ro ta pa la dngos su gnang zhing*/ grub dbang nā ro ta pa de nyid kyis kyang*/ rgya gar du gnyis skyes mchog gnyis la sogs pa'i slob ma paṇa grub bcu gnyis tsam yod pa dang*/ bod yul nas lho brag mar pa chos kyi blo gros sogs dka' ba dpag med spyad pa'i grags chen gyi slob ma su la'ang ming tsam yang ma gnang bar/ bal po pham mthing pa gcen 'jigs med grags pa dang*/ gcung ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa ste sku mched gnyis kho na la slob bshad chig brgyud kyi tshul du gnang ba/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs dang*/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa gnyis las rim par brgyud de rje btsun sa skya pa chen po'i phyag tu babs pa las/ gangs ljongs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa chen po yab sras rnams la rnal 'byor bla med dang rjes su 'brel ba'i gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bu zhig bzhugs pa las gtso bor gyur pa lcags ri las mi 'da' ba'i gser chos bcu gsum mam bcu bzhir grags pa las gtso bo ni mchog sgrub pas thun mong zhar la 'byung ba dmar po skor gsum gyi skor dang*/ de la'ang snying po kho na ba ni lus 'di ma spangs par mkha' spyod du bgrod par byed pa zab pa las kyang ches zab pa rje btsun nā ro mkha' spyod ces grags shing*/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan yan snyan brgyud kho na'i tshul gyis/

bla ma dam pa bsod rgyal pa'i dbon brgyud rin chen sgang pa'i gdung rigs zhal ngo kho nar chig brgyud du bzhugs pa las gzhan gang gis kyang rna bar thos pa tsam yang mi 'gyur ba lta bu las/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis gsung ngag slob bshad kyi gdams pa mtha' dag 'phags yul gyi grub dbang bram ze mchog sred kyi rnam sprul rdo ring kun spangs chen po kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma blo ldan shes rab dpal bzang po la ma tshang ba med par stsal zhing*/ des rdo rje 'chang dbang tshar pa chos rje blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po la gnang*/ de nas bzung ste tshar lugs thun mong ma yin pa snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi ldan

dbang gi chu bo ma nub pa/ byin rlabs kyi brgyud pa ma nyams pa/ gdams ngag gi sarga ma log pa/ mos gus kyis bsams pa tshim pa ste snyan brgyud bzhi dang*/ bla ma tshad ma/ lung tshad ma/ bstan bcos tshad ma/ nyams myong tshad ma ste tshad ma bzhi'o// mchan/ zhes mtshan du grags shing*/ snod ldan gyi slob ma rnams la rim gyis dar rgyas su gyur pa yin la/ de min dge zhwa bo jo sogs su'ang smin grol thor bu dang*/ ngor rdzong gong gsum du legs par dar kyang gtso che ba ni tshar lugs thun mong ma yin pa 'di kho na yin gsungs/ de lta bu'i zab lam nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i gdams pa nyams su blang bar bya ba la sa bcad gsum ste/ gang gis nyams su len pa'i rten gyi gang zag des nyams su blang bya'i lam dngos/ lam de mthar phyin pa'i 'bras bu'o// dang po la/ smin lam la 'jug rung gi gang zag dang*/ grol lam sgom rung gi gang zag gnyis kyi/ dang po la rab rgyud sde nas gsungs pa'i nyan pa po'i mtshan nyid tshang zhing*/ 'khor lo sdom pa lū nag dril gsum gang rung gi rdul mtshon nam/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang gis smin pa dang*/ 'bring bde mchog gang rigs zhig gi dbang thob pa/ tha ma'ang kyai rdor man ngag lugs lta bu'i ma rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor gang yang rung ba'i dbang bzhi thob cing dam tshig dang sdom pa rnam par dag pa zhig dgos so// gnyis pa ni/ de lta bu'i gang zag des/ lte ba'i tsaṇḍa lī nang gi rnal 'byor ma'i ngo bor ye gdod ma nyid nas lhan skyes su bzhugs pa mngon sum du ngo sprod par byed pa'i thabs sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du byin rlabs phyag len 'khrul pa med pa legs par thob cing chag med du nyams su blang 'dod pa zhig dgos te/ sindhu ra'i byin rlabs kyi yig cha'ang rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang gis mdzad pa'i yig rnying be'u bum du bzhugs pa de gtso che yang*/

de'i dgongs pa thams cad 'dus pa tshar chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i nye lam mam/ de nyid gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang gis nag 'gros su mdzad pa dang*/ zhwa lu ba rin chen blo gsal bstan skyong gis mdzad pa'i byin rlabs kyi cho ga'i mtshams sbyor rnams kyi steng nas thob pa nges par dgos gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa nyams su blang bya'i lam dngos la'ang mkha' spyod rig pa 'dzin pa'i rten gtso bor sgrub pa bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig dang*/ mkha' spyod chen mo mchog gi go 'phang gtso bor sgrub pa rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma dang gnyis su yod pa las/ 'dir bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig gsungs pa gtso bor mtshon pa tsam ste/ don gyis bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug yin te mngon rtogs kyi dkyus gcig la dbang bzhi'i lam mtha' dag tshang ba'i phyir ro gsungs/ mchan/ dang po bskyed rim la/ gang zag dbang po rab bzlas sgom rnam pa gnyis la brten nas mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub sgrub pa/ 'bring bsnyen sgrub las gsum laṅka li dang sindhu ra'i sgrub pa sogs/ mchan/ la brten nas mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub sgrub pa/ tha ma bar do dang man ngag 'pho ba'i gdams pa la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa/ yang mtha' skye ba brgyud nas smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar te nam zhig na mkha' spyod 'grub pa ste bzhi yod pa las/ de thams cad kyi nyams su blang bar bya ba/ ༈ /rje sa chen gyis/ nyal 1 dang ldang 2 dang bdud rtsi myang 3 // tshad med 4 bla ma 5 bdag lhar bskyed/ 6 /'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang*/ 7 /dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlab/ 8 /ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin/ 9 /bsam gyis mi khyab rnal 'byor dang*/ 10 /spyod lam gyi ni rnal 'byor 11 te// de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go /zhes bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig tu bsdu bar mdzad pa de la bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyis sgro 'dogs gcod pa bskyed rim gyi rnam bshad dang*/

bcad don nyams su len pa sems 'dzin te gnyis su byung mod kyi/ 'dir ni re zhig go bde ba'i slad du sa bcad so sor phye ste bshad pa la/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes dang gsum gyi/ dang po la/ rnal 'byor bsgom pa ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro dang*/ rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i sngon 'gro gnyis las/ dang po la'ang sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ rgyud nas bshad pa'i mtshan nyid tshang ba'i gnas sam/ dben pa'i rang gnas kyang rung ste yid du 'ong bar byi dor legs par bya/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa bkod mdzes su dgram/ mchod pa phyag len 'khrul med ltar g.yo med par mdzes par bsham/ rang nyid gnyis snang gi rtog pa dbyings su nub pa'i rten 'brel du kha nub tu phyogs pa'am/ khang pa'i dkar mthong la yun ring kha blta ba mig la gnod pa'i phyir mos pas gang bder phyogs te/ bsam gtan gyi stan bde bar bsham/ rdor dril/ nang mchod/ ḍā ma ru sogs rnal 'byor gyi yo byad thams cad tshogs par bya'o/ ༈ /gnyis pa la gsum ste/ nyal ba'i rnal 'byor/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor/ bdud rtsi myong ba'i rnal 'byor te gsum gyi/ dang po nyal 1 ba'i rnal 'byor la/ spros bcas dang*/ spros med gnyis las/ dang po ni/ gnas khang la tha mal gyi snang zhen bkag nas/ chos 'byung nyis brtsegs 'od kyi rang bzhin can phyi dkar la nang dmar bar bsam/ de'i nang du seṅge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du padma dmar po 'dab ma 'bum dang ldan pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i steng du/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor drod tsha lam me ba bsgom ste/ 'dis gnyid mi g.yer ba yin no gsungs/ nyi ma'i steng du rang dang grogs yod na thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo bu mo lo bcu drug lon pa'i rnam pa can rgyan dang phyag mtshan med par bsams la/ seṅge'i nyal stabs kyis gzhogs g.yas phab ste mgo byang dang kha nub tu blta ba'am/

der mos pas nyal ba'i sngas mgor seng khri padma nyi zla'i gdan la rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can du bzhugs pa'i sku pang du rang gi mgo bzhag par mos te/ mos gus drag po dung dung pa dang bcas nyal/ de'ang gnyid ma log gi bar du res rang dang grogs lhar gsal ba/ res sngas mgo'i bla ma/ res chos 'byung khri gdan sogs la dmigs pa gtad de gsal 'debs kyin nyal/ nam sad pa na'ang de nyid gsal btab ste tha mal gyi snang zhen bkag par bya'o gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa spros pa la mi dga' bas do nub kyi thun mthar bsam mi khyab thun mong ba'i sdud rim yan chad byas nas nyal ba yin la/ de'ang rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i snying ga'i bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa bun long gis phyogs bcur 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad la khyab pas reg pa tsam gyis gzugs med khams rnams lan tshwa chur bcug pa ltar 'od sngon po'i rnam par ltem gyis zhu ba rang gi lus kyi stod cha la thim/ gzugs khams rnams zhu ba 'od dmar po'i rnam pas rang gi lus kyi bar cha la thim/ 'dod khams rnams zhu ba 'od dkar po'i rnam pas rang gi lus kyi smad cha la thim/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad mi dmigs pa'i stong pa nyid la blo gzhag de nas rang lhar gsal ba'ang stod smad nas 'od dmar por zhu ba snying ga'i chos 'byung la thim/ chos 'byung zla ba la thim/ zla ba sngags phreng la thim/ sngags phreng bam̐ yig la thim/ de'i ba zla tshes la thim/ zla tshes thig le la thim/ thig le nā da la thim/ nā da de'ang je phra je phrar nam mkha' la sprin zhi ba ltar mi dmigs par bsams pa'i mthar/ rang sems stong pa had chad ma yin pa'i gsal zhing rig pa/ de'i ngo bo gang du'ang ma grub pa'i rang bzhin stong pa gnyis zung du 'jug pa de ga'i ngang du dmigs pa khra ler bzhag ste/ dmigs gtad kyi mtshan 'dzin ma zhugs par bzo med rang babs su bzhag nas nyal lo// des sbyang gzhi snod kyi 'jig rten 'jig pa/

bcud kyi sems can 'chi ba/ nyams len gyi rtsis ma zin par gti mug gi sgo nas nyal ba thams cad sbyong byed gnyid kyi rnal 'byor 'dis sbyangs pas/ sbyangs 'bras 'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi sku mngon du byed pa ste/ de'ang rnal 'byor nyams su len pa la sngon du ldang dgos la/ de'i sngon du'ang nyal ba 'gro dgos pas na nyal ba'i rnal 'byor 'di thog mar byung ba yin no gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa ldang 2 ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ mdang spros bcas kyis nyal na/ nam gyi brgyad cha lus pa'am/ skya rengs shar ba nas ldang bar brtsams pa na/ yul nyer bzhi'i dpa' bo dang mkha' 'gro nam mkha' gang ba rnams kyis ḍā ma ru khrol lo lo 'khrol ba oṃ gsum ma'i sngags kyi rang gdangs su lhang lhang grag pas gnyid las bslangs par mos te/ spro na ḍā ma ru'ang 'khrol tsam bya/ gnas khang yang chos 'byung dang*/ sngas mgo'i bla ma rdo rje chos dang*/ grogs sogs yod na rnal 'byor mar gsal gdab pa sngar bzhin byas la/ dag pa'i snang zhen gyis rang nyid rnal 'byor ma rgyan yod la phyag mtshan med pa'i rnam par ldang nas/ sngas mgo'i bla ma la mos gus drag pos gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma dgyes bzhin 'od dmar po bye'u'i sgo nga tsam du zhu ste rang gi smin mtshams nas zhugs te snying ga'i rang sems bam̐ yig tu gsal pa la sib kyis thim pas byin gyis brlabs te sngar bas 'od dang gzi byin cher 'bar bar bsam mo// yang sngar spros med kyis nyal na/ skya rengs shar ba tsam na nam mkha' nas nye snying oṃ gsum ma dang*/ yab kyi gsang sngags yi ge bdun pa'i sgra lhang lhang grag pas gnyid sad par mos la/ stong nyid kyi ngang las chu las nya 'phar ba'am/ chu bur rdol ba ltar rnal 'byor ma rgyan ldan phyag mtshan med par ldang ste/ des sbyang gzhi snod kyi 'jig rten chags pa/ bcud kyi sems can skye ba/ rang gzhan thams cad la gnyid sad pa'i snang ba tha mal lang shor du snang ba rnams/

sbyong byed ldang ba'i rnal 'byor 'dis sbyangs pas/ sbyangs 'bras skye ba sprul pa'i sku'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa yin no gsungs/ ༈ /gsum pa bdud rtsi myang 3 ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ thod pa mtshan ldan nam/ rdo dang nya phyis kyi kā pa la sogs rgyun bzhag mi rul ba'i ched nang du mar sogs kyis g.yogs par/ grub mtha' gzhan phyogs ma yin par/ sa ngor gyi bla ma brgyud pas kyai rdor sogs rgyud sde'i dgongs pa ltar bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu rab gsum/ 'bring gnyis/ tha ma gcig chang la sbyar ba dang*/ ma 'byor na chang rgod la dmigs kyang rung zhing*/ gang ltar thog mar bde mchog lū nag gi nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab/ rgyun du lag pa g.yon bstan la oṃ zhes bdud rtsi snod bcas stong par sbyang*/ g.yas bstan la āḥzhes thod par sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga gsal gdab/ gnyis ka bstan pas hūm̐ zhes thod pa'i 'og nas rlung g.yos me sbar bas zhu zhing khol nas zag med kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsam/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan te/ ha ho hrīḥzhes pas 'dzad pa med par sbar te/ gsar pa yin na brgya rtsa tsam dang*/ rgyun du dmigs pa gsal pas lan gsum re brjod/ myang tshul dngos ni/ lag pa g.yas pas ka pā la bzung ste lag pa g.yon pa'i srin mdzub kyi rtser chos 'byung dmar po chung ngu rtse mo rang la bstan par bsams nas/ mtheb srin sbyar bas 'bru gsum brjod bzhin du thod pa'i chang la chos 'byung rtse mo rang la bstan pa zhig g.yon skor du bri ba'i stangs ka bya/ de'i dbus nas bde stong gi ye shes bdud rtsi'i snying po srin lag gi rtse mo'i chos 'byung gi skyogs kyis bcus par bsams nas 'bru gsum brjod cing lce'i steng du bzhag ste myangs pas longs spyod 'khor lo gsung rdo rje ya ra la wa'i rtsa bzhi'i nang nas mar song ste/ lus kyi nang thams cad zag med kyi bdud rtsis mer gyis khengs/

bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma snying ga'i bam̐ yig rnal 'byor ma'i ngo bor gsal ba de la thim pas de nyid nyi ma bye ba'i mdangs ltar 'od dang gzi brjid bltar mi bzod par 'bar/ sdig sgrib dang mtshan 'dzin gyi rtog pa sangs kyis dag bde stong zag med lhan skyes kyi ye shes rgyud la skyes par bsams la brjod med du cung zad cham mer gzhag go /des sbyang gzhi bza' btung sogs la 'dod sred kyi dbang gis bag med du spyod pa dang*/ mu stegs byed rnams lus bkrus pas sems kyi skyon dag par 'dod pa'i lta log dang*/ der ma zad 'dul ba dang rgyud sde 'og ma rnams nas khrus dang gtsang sgra gsungs pa thams cad kyang sbyang gzhi sbyong byed kyi gnad dang ma 'brel bas myur du sangs rgyas thob pa'i rgyur mi 'gro bas/ de rnams las khyad par du 'phags pa sbyong byed bdud rtsi myong ba'i rnal 'byor 'dis 'dod sred kyi rtog pa dang gtsang sme'i rtog pa thams cad sbyangs pas/ sbyangs 'bras bar do longs spyod rdzogs sku mngon du byed pa yin no// 'di la 'khor lo bde mchog gi zab gnad dga' ba gsum mam dag pa gsum yang tshang ste/ rang lus lhar gsal pa sku'i dga' ba/ bdud rtsi mgrin pa 'od dpag med gsung rdo rje'i gnas su myang ba gsung gi dga' ba/ bdud rtsi'i dwangs ma snying ga'i bam̐ yig la thim pas ye shes skyes par mos pa thugs kyi dga' ba dang*/ yang na spros med stong nyid kyi ngang du nyal ba thugs kyi dga' ba/ ldang ba'i rnal 'byor sku'i dga' ba/ bdud rtsi myang ba gsung gi dga' ba ste/ lus ngag yid gsum dag par byed pa yin no gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa rnal 'byor bsgom pa'i sngon 'gro la thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' bsam pa/ 'chi ba mi rtag par bsam pa/ las rgyu 'bras bsam pa/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs bsam pa ste bzhi las/ 'dir sa bcad tsam 'god na/

dang po la/ dal 'byor ngos gzung ba/ don che bar bsam pa/ rnyed par dka' bar bsam pa gsum/ ༈ /gnyis pa la/ spyir 'chi nges pa/ nam 'chi cha med pa/ 'chi tshe chos las gzhan pa gang gis kyang mi phan pa'i tshul bsam pa gsum/ ༈ /gsum pa la/ las 'bras kyi ngo bo/ des 'bras bu 'byin tshul/ thams cad las kyi rang bzhin du bstan pa gsum/ ༈ /bzhi pa la/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal spyir bsam pa/ bye brag rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal bsam pa gnyis te/ de dag ni smon lam las/ dal 'byor gru chen sogs shlau ka gcig gi don te/ de re re la'ang dpe/ rgyu mtshan/ lung 'dren bcas zhib par bgyis na mang bas 'jigs te ma bkod la/ blo ldog rnam pa bzhi po 'di la ma mtha' yang myong ba sne zin thon pa ni lam gyi rming rdo gal shin tu che ba yin pas/ lam 'bras snang gsum dang*/ jo bo bka' gdams pa'i blo sbyong bstan rim dang*/ zhen pa bzhi bral sogs la legs par sbyangs te rgyud la bkal bar bya'o gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la/ lam log pa mu stegs pa las khyad par du bya ba skyabs 'gro/ lam dman pa nyan rang las khyad par du bya ba sems bskyed/ 'gal rkyen sdig sgrib sbyang ba rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas/ mthun rkyen tshogs gsog pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang bzhi las/ dang po skyabs su 'gro ba la/ gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul/ gang gis skyabs su 'gro ba'i rten/ tshul ji ltar skyabs su 'gro ba dngos dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ rang nyid bde ba'i stan la lus rnam snang gi chos bdun ldan du 'khod/ dbugs stod du 'tshangs pa lta bu ma yin par/ rlung dbyung rngub mnyam zhing ngal bso ba'i tshul du gzhag rang rgyud la legs par brtags te/ dug gsum ngan rtog dang zhi bde don gnyer gyi blo sogs kun slong skyon chags pa rnams bcos/ de nas rang gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs gnas khang sogs la dmigs pa ched du gtad pas/

de thams cad nam mkha' la du ba yal ba ltar rjes med du 'jam lam mer yal zhing*/ thaṃ maṃl gyiṃ snangaṃ baṃ dbyingaṃs su nub/ de'i ngang las zhing yongs su dag pa sa phyogs thams cad bai ḍūrya sngon po'i sa gzhi la gser sbyangs kyis mig mangs ris su bris pa/ mnan na nem zhes byed cing bteg na spar zhes byed pa/ reg na bde ba khyad par can skyed pa de lta bu'i dag pa'i zhing khams kyi dbus/ rang gi gnas khang gi dod thub lta bur ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi/ rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa/ yangs shing rgya che la mtho zhing lhun stug pa/ rin po che'i drwa ba dang*/ drwa ba phyed pa/ zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ gser gyi dril g.yer rlung gis bskyod pa las chos kyi sgra 'byung ba/ gser gyi rgya phib kyi rtse mor nor bu'i tog gis spud pa/ gzhal med khang de'i nang*/ rang gi smin mtshams kyi thad kyi nam mkhar/ gser dngul spug dang rdo'i snying po/ bai ḍūrya dang padma rā ga margad dang ke ke ru la sogs pa rin chen sna tshogs las grub cing 'od 'phro ba'i khri yangs shing mtho la rgya che ba/ 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral zhing dbang phyug brgyad mtshon pa'i phyogs rer seṅge gnyis gnyis te/ rngams shing brjid pa'i seṅge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa/ de'i steng du chags sogs 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pa'i brdar padma dmar po 'dab ma 'bum dang ldan pa kha bye ma thag pa lta bu zil pa phrom zhing dri bsung phun sum tshogs pa 'phro ba/ de'i steng du byang chub kyi sems mtshon pa'i brdar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dkar bsil nya gang ba/ de'i steng du don dam 'od gsal mtshon pa'i brdar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dmar ser gsal zhing 'od 'phro ba/ de'i steng du rang gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can/

gdul bya rnams la snying rje chen pos rjes su chags pa'i rang mdangs sku mdog dmar gsal gzi byin 'bar ba/ du ma ro gcig thig le chen por mtshon pa'i zhal gcig zhi zhing 'dzum pa/ bden gnyis mtshon pa'i phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ do shal/ gdu bu la sogs pa rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan cing*/ dar bzang po'i stod g.yogs dang sham thabs lhab lhub tu bkra ba/ thabs shes mtshon pa'i zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ de nyid brgyud pa'i bla ma gong ma thams cad kyi byin rlabs gcig tu 'dus shing tshang bas bla ma kun 'dus/ de'i phung po lnga sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i ngo bor bzhugs pas sangs rgyas kun 'dus/ de'i thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i lung rtogs kyi yon tan dang*/ zhal nas legs par 'doms pa'i chos rnams dam chos kun 'dus/ phyi nang gi dbang po dang skye mched sems dpa' dang sems ma/ yan lag khro bo'i rang bzhin du bzhugs pas dge 'dun kun 'dus/ yang na sku dge 'dun/ gsung dam chos/ thugs sangs rgyas te skyabs gsum kun 'dus/ bla ma'i gtso bo/ yi dam gyi rang bzhin/ mkha' 'gro'i dbang phyug ste rtsa gsum kun 'dus/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams bka' nyan gsung sdod kyi tshul du bka' 'khor na gnas pa ste/ mdor na skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gsal gdab ste/ khrid tshul 'ga' zhig na skyabs yul 'khor lo sdom pas gtso bor byas pa dang*/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la kun 'dus su byas pa dang*/ gzhan yang cung zad mi 'dra ba 'ga' re mchis kyang*/ slob bshad brgyud pa'i gdams pa 'di nyid yin la/ tshogs zhing bsgom tshul la'ang 'khor dang longs spyod rgyas pa'i ched du khrom tshogs dang*/ byin rlabs myur du 'jug ched kun 'dus nor bu lugs gnyis su yod pa las/ skabs 'dir phyi ma nyid mdzad pa yin no gsungs/

༈ /gnyis pa gang gis skyabs su 'gro ba'i rten ni/ de lta bu'i tshogs zhing gi mdun du rang nyid/ rang gi g.yas su pha/ g.yon du ma/ mdun du mngon par sdang byed kyi dgra bo dang*/ mi mngon par gnod pa'i 'dre/ mtha' skor kun tu rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad kyang smra shes don go ba mi'i rnam pas ston mo chen po la khrom tshogs pa ltar smug shig ger yod par bsam/ rang dang sems can de dag thams cad lus gus shing 'dun pa/ ngag snyan pa'i skyabs gsol/ yid khyed shes kyi mos gus rtse gcig pas skyabs 'gro byed par bsams la/ ༈ /gsum pa tshul ji ltar skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad spyir 'khor ba dang khyad par ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal la shin tu 'jigs shing skrag pa'i blo mi

1 nag can chad pas skrag pa lta bu dang*/ 'jigs pa de las skyob pa'i nus pa mdun na bzhugs pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas kun 'dus de nyid la yod par shes pa mi nag can khas drag la skyabs tshol ba 2 lta bu ste skyabs 'gro'i rgyu gnyis dang*/ yang na rang sdug bsngal la 'jigs pa'i nges 'byung 1 */ gzhan gyi sdug bsngal la dmigs pa'i snying rje/ 2 skyabs yul la sdug bsngal las skyob pa'i nus pa yod par shes pa 3 ste rgyu gsum tshang ba gal che/ de'ang skyabs yul la mkhyen pa med na skyob mi shes pa la/ bdag gzhan thams cad kyi bde sdug gi rgyu 'bras phyin ci ma log pa dang*/ khams dang bsam pa phra zhib mkhyen pas mkhyen pa'i ye shes mnga'/ mkhyen pa yod kyang brtse ba med na mi skyob pa la/ ma bu gcig pu la brtse ba las kyang ches lhag pa'i brtse ba'i thugs rje mnga'/ mkhyen brtse gnyis yod kyang nus pa med na ma lag zha ma'i bu chus khyer ba ltar skyob mi nus pa la sku'i 'od zer re re dang*/ chos thun re tsam dang*/ zhal gyi dbugs tsam gyis kyang sems can grangs med pa smin grol la 'god nus pas skyob pa'i nus mthu mnga' ba'i mthar thug gtan gyi skyabs gnas su yid ches par byas te/ skyabs su 'gro mkhan yang*/ dper na brag phug la char skyob pa'i nus pa yod kyang*/ rang nyid the tshom med par der ma phyin na/ kha nas brag phug ces brgya stong brjod kyang phan pa med pa ltar/ rang la dad pa'i a long yod na/ der thugs rje'i lcags kyu nges par thebs nas bde legs kyi lam sna zin pas na dkon mchog kun 'dus bla ma rin po che de la/ blo lings kyis bkal nas/ skyid rung*/ sdug rung*/ mthor gtong ngam/ dmar gtong ngam/ ci mdzad khyed shes snyam pa'i sgo nas snying khong rus pa'i gting nas skyabs su 'gro zhing*/ dus kyang lo zla kha shas tsam dang*/ ma shi bar dang*/ skye ba gcig gnyis tsam ma yin par/ ji srid bdag gzhan sangs rgyas ma thob bar ram/

rang nyid skyabs yul du ma gyur pa de srid du dang*/ kun slong yang rang gcig pu zhi bde 'thob pa tsam ma yin par sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob 'dod kyi bsam pa shugs drag po'i sgo nas/ bdag dang sems can thams cad srid zhi'i 'jigs pa mtha' dag las bskyab par mdzad du gsol snyam pas/ rang gis skyabs 'gro'i dbyangs drangs te mtha' skor gyi sems can thams cad kyis kyang yid gnyis the tshom med pa'i yid rtse gcig pas 'ur di ri ri skyabs 'gro brjod par bsams la/ bdaṃg daṃng zhes pas skyabs zhu mkhan rang nyid dang*/ 'groṃ baṃ zhes sogs kyis sems can thams cad la yid gtad/ dusaṃ 'diṃ nasaṃ sogs kyis dus kyi khyad par 'dir byang chub kyi snying po ni rgya gar rdo rje gdan la gnas byang snying dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi ye shes chos sku ni rtogs pa byang snying yin gsungs/ mchan/ dang*/ blaṃ maṃ zhes pa'i skabs su bla ma'i thugs ka'i thad du dmigs pa cher gyis gtad nas skyabs gnas spyi dang*/ khyad par rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma kun 'dus su thag bcad la/ bdag la thugs rje chen pos bskyab tu gsol snyam pa'i 'dun pa shugs drag bskyed la bla ma'i thugs kar thim la khad pa lta bur bsam/ sangaṃs rgyasaṃ zhes pa'i skabs su bla ma'i phung po lnga bder gshegs lnga'i ngo bor bzhugs pa la dmigs te/ bdag gi lam ston pa po mdzad du gsol snyam pa dang*/ chosaṃ zhes pa'i skabs su bla ma'i thugs rgyud la bzhugs pa'i 'gog lam gyi bden pa gnyis dang*/ zhal nas gsungs pa'i chos rnams la dmigs te bdag gi lam dngos mdzad du gsol snyam pa dang*/ tshoṃgs mchoṃg gam dgeṃ 'duṃn zhes pa'i skabs su bla ma'i dbang po skye mched yan lag rnams dge 'dun gyi ngo bor bzhugs pa la dmigs te lam sgrub pa'i zla grogs mdzad du gsol snyam pas sems rgya yan du ma song bar dmigs pa rtse gcig pas skyabs 'gro'i tshig brgya stong sogs brjod pas bdag gzhan thams cad bla ma'i skyabs 'og tu tshud song snyam du bsam/

mthar rdo rje thal mo sbyar te/ blaṃ maṃ daṃng dkoṃn mchoṃg rinaṃ poṃ cheṃ zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ skyabs yul bla ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po bde ba'i rang bzhin can 'phros/ sems can thams cad la phog pas/ skyabs 'gro'i mi mthun phyogs la sogs pa sgo gsum gyi dri ma sdig sgrib bag chags thams cad sangs kyis dag ste lus zag med 'ja' lus rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sku dang*/ yid rtog med chos kyi skur sangs rgyas te dag pa mkha' spyod kyi zhing du bya khyu chen po 'phur ba ltar 'ur ding gis gshegs par bsam/ de nas bla ma la mos gus byas pas gdan seng khri nas yar dang*/ dbu gtsug tor nas mar 'od dmar por ltem ltem zhu/ thugs ka'i thad du 'od dmar gyi gong bu phug ron gyi sgo nga tsam dmar gsal dwangs pa mthong tsam nyid nas bde ba chen po skyed nus pa gcig tu gyur te/ rang gi spyi bo nas thim pas bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du 'dres par bsam pa yan chad ni kun rdzob kyi skyabs 'gro dang*/ de'i ngang las 'das ma 'ongs kyi rnam rtog gi rgyun bcad la/ rang dus kyi shes pa so ma had de ba la cher gyis bltas pas/ sems kyi ngo bo nam mkha' dwangs pa'i dkyil lta bur gsal ba ni dge 'dun/ ngos gzung gi dmigs gtad thams cad dang bral ba'i stong pa ni chos/ de gnyis tsandan dang dri bsung bzhin zung du 'jug pa ni sangs rgyas/ de gsum brjod bral lhan skyes dbyer med du shes pa bla ma ste/ skyabs gnas thams cad rang sems las logs su med par thag bcad nas/ de ga'i ngang du lus sems lhod kyis glod la bying rgod ma zhugs par mnyam par gzhag pa ni don dam pa'i skyabs 'gro'am/ gnas lugs rdo rje'i skyabs 'gro'o// des sbyang gzhi tshe rabs thog med nas/ skyabs gnas phal pa 'jig rten gyi lha mthu bo che dang*/ mu stegs byed la sogs pa skyabs gnas su mi 'os pa du ma la skyabs zhus nas las ngan bsags pa thams cad/

sbyong byed skyabs 'gro khyad par can 'dis sbyangs pas/ sbyangs 'bras rang gzhan thams cad mthar thug skyabs mchog gsum gyi go 'phang 'thob par 'gyur ro// 'dir rnal 'byor bcu gcig gi khongs su tshad med rnal 'byor zhes pa las skyabs 'gro ma thon pa ni/ skyabs 'gro sdom pa thams cad kyi rten du gyur pas sems bskyed kyi sngon du shugs kyis thob pa la dgongs pa yin no gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa sems bskyed ni/ rje btsun nā ro ta pa'i bka' srol ltar sems bskyed dang tshad med ngo bo gcig tu song bas/ 'di tshad med 4 kyi rnal 'byor nyid yin te/ de'ang mkha' khyab kyi sems can thams cad rang gi ma ma byas pa gcig kyang med tshul la bsams te mar shes/ ma nam byas kyi gnas skabs thams cad du thog mtha' bar gsum du drin gyis legs par bskyangs tshul bsams te drin dran/ de lta bu'i ma sems can thams cad 'dod pa bde ba 'dod kyang thabs mi mkhas pas/ sdug bsngal gyi rgyu 'bras 'ba' zhig la longs spyod tshul zhib mor bsams te bde ba dang 'phrad 'dod kyi yid 'ong gi byams pa dang*/ sdug bsngal dang bral 'dod kyi snying rje bskyed la/ ma 'di rnams la drin du gzo phyir sdug bsngal las sgrol zhing bde ba la 'god pa'i khur ni bu bdag nyid gcig pus khyer ba'i 'os su 'dug kyang*/ da lta ni de 'dra'i nus pa mi bdog cing*/ nam bdag sangs rgyas pa na sems can thams cad sgrol ba'i nus pa thob par 'dug pas/ des na bdag gis sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par byas la/ sems can 'di rnams thams cad bde chen sangs rgyas kyi sa la bzhag par bya'o snyam pa'i smon sems dang*/ de'ang rgyu med rkyen med las mi 'grub pas/ de nyid 'thob pa'i ched du myur lam zab mo 'di nyid nyams su len par bya'o snyam pa 'jug sems te/ de lta bu'i 'dun pa drag pos/ bdag gis rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas zhes sogs brgya stong gi sgo nas gsal gdab pa ni kun rdzob sems bskyed dang*/

de ltar sems bskyed pa'i yul/ sems bskyed pa po/ sems bskyed dngos te 'khor gsum po thams cad bde stong sgyu ma lta bur blta ba ni don dam pa'i sems bskyed yin/ des sbyang gzhi tshe 'khor ba thog med nas ma sems can 'ga' zhig la dgrar bzung ste gnod pa ci 'khyol byas pa dang*/ rang nyid kho na gces par 'dzin pas thar 'dod kyi blos zhi bde don du gnyer ba sogs nyan rang dman lam gyi mthar ltung nas theg chen gyi lam dang 'gal ba'i nyes pa thams cad/ sbyong byed tshad med kyi rnal 'byor 'dis sbyangs pas/ sbyangs 'bras bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang 'thob pa ste/ 'di la tshad med rnal 'byor zhes pa'i don/ sems bskyed tshul 'dir tshad med bzhi'ang tshang bas te/ de'ang sems can thams cad mar shes pa sogs kyis dmigs yul du byas pas btang snyoms dang*/ sdug bsngal ba la dmigs te de las sgrol 'dod bskyed pa snying rje dang*/ byang chub la 'god par 'dod pa byams pa dang*/ byang chub la 'khod na rang tshim pa ni dga' ba tshad med rnams don gyis tshang bas na tshad med pa'i rnal 'byor zhes bya ba yin no gsungs/ yang 'dir mkhas grub 'ga' zhig bdag bskyed la thob bya 'bras dus kyi yongs dag bzhi dang rnam pa mthun par lam dus su slob dgos pas/ longs spyod yang dag dang cha mthun par mchod pa 'bul dgos par bshad pa la bsams nas/ 'ga' zhig bdag bskyed kyi mchod pa bshams shing byin gyis brlabs pa skabs 'dir byas te/ 'og nas 'bul tshig kyang bshad pa byung mod de/ rang lugs de 'drar mi dgos shing*/ sa lugs spyir yang bdag bskyed ting nge 'dzin gyi che ba dang*/ mdun bskyed mchod bstod kyi che ba yin pas/ mchod pa 'bul ba bdag bskyed la byung ba dag kyang dngos bsham byin rlabs sogs mi dgos la/ ting nge 'dzin kho nas mchod pa spro ste/ longs spyod yongs dag gi cha mthun yang des 'grub bo gsungs/

༈ /gsum pa rdor sems bsgom bzlas ni/ rang tha mal du gnas pa'i spyi bor mtho gang tsam gyi nam mkhar padma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa lte ba dang bcas pa sdong bu rang gi tshang bug la reg pa/ de'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba/ de'i steng du skad cig gis bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' sku che chung mtho tshad tsam sku mdog dkar po khril ldem sgeg pa'i tshul can/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu thugs kar bsnol te 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkaraṃ mo phyag g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud cing*/ byin pa gnyis yab kyi sku sked la 'khril te rgyab tu zhabs mthil gnyis sprad pa padma'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ yab la phyag rgya drug dang*/ yum la thalaṃ chenaṃ spangs pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ yab yum gnyis ka'i spyi bor rigs bdag gi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa phyed pa re res mtshan par bsgom pa ni yan lag bzhi rdzogs bsdus pa yin pas ma brjed par dgos shing*/ 'di la cho ga gsum bskyed sogs mi mdzad gsungs/ de nas yab kyi thugs kar zla dkyil dkar po sen mo tsam gyi steng du/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi ngo bo hūm̐ dkar po spus bris pa lta bu 'grengs stabs su bskyed cing*/ lugs 'dir yig brgya'i sngags phreng gsal btab mi dgos gsungs/ rdor sems kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad bdud rtsi 'od zer gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim par bsams la/ 1 rten gyi stobs spyi bo'i rdor sems sangs rgyas kun 'dus su nges shes bskyed/

2 sun 'byin pa'i stobs sngar byas kyi nyes pa la dug khong du song ba lta bu'i 'gyod sems drag pos nyes pa bshags 'dod kyi bsam pas/ bcomaṃ ldaṃn 'daṃs rdoṃ rjeṃ semaṃs dpaṃ' zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las bdud rtsi 'od zer dkar po'i rnam pa skya chil chil babs/ yab kyi sku lus gang*/ rdo rje'i sbu gu nas brgyud/ yum gyi padmar babs/ yum gyi sku gang*/ yab yum gnyis ka'i sbyor mtshams dang sku'i cha thams cad las bdud rtsi dkar po'i rgyun zil pa phrom mer babs/ padma'i sdong bu la 'khril te rang gi spyi bo tshangs pa'i bu ga nas zhugs/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ bdud rtsi dga' zhig pad zla'i steng nas brag mthon po'i kha las 'ong ba'i chu 'phyar ba bzhin du babs te/ rang gi lus kyi phyiṃ nang thams cad bkrus par bsam ste/ a bhi dha na las/ phyi dang nang gi chus khrus bya// rnal 'byor ma yis dbang rab bskur// zhes pas bdud rtsi yab yum sbyor mtshams dang*/ gtso cher yum gyi mkha' gsang las 'babs par bsam pa gtso che'o gsungs/ de la'ang thun mong ba'i dmigs skor gsum dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs skor bzhi ste bdun du gsungs pa las/ dang po la/ sdig sgrib sbyang ba/ nad sbyang ba/ gdon sbyang ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun des las nyon sdig sgrib nyes ltung bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad rnag khrag chu ser dud khu sol khu lta bu'i rnam pas bshang gci'i lam dang*/ dbang po'i sgo/ ba spu'i bu ga sogs nas dbyar gyi sha 'od drag pos bye rdul dang sbur ma ded pa ltar sbyangs te mi dmigs par yang na 'chi bdag gi khar btang ba'i dmigs pas kyang rung*/ mchan/ yal ba'i dmigs pa brtan po dang*/ lus kyi phyi nang thams cad shel bum dri mas ma gos pa ltar dwangs gsal du song bar bsam/ 'di'i sdig pa ni nyon mongs pa/ sgrib pa ni shes bya'i sgrib pa/

nyes pa ni rang bzhin gyis kha na ma tho ba/ ltung ba ni bcas 'gal gyi ltung ba/ dri ma ni lus dang gnas kyi dri ma rnams yin no gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa ni/ rlung mkhris bad kan sogs nad rigs rgyu dang bcas pa thams cad rlung ljang dmar dang khu rlangs sngo dmar 'khyil zhing 'tshubs pa'i rnam pas sngar bzhin phyir thon par dmigs la/ de'ang grang nad ldang na mas 'ded ces bdud rtsis lus khengs pas/ chu snod chus bkang ba na snod nang gi sbur ma steng na 'phyo ba ltar nad rnams yar ded de/ kha sna sogs nas phyir thon par bsam/ stod nad ldang na yas 'ded ces 'og sgo gnyis sogs nas mar thon par dmigs/ pho mchin sogs bar nad ldang na bar 'ded ces snying ga sogs nas phyir thon par bsam/ gzhan yang grang nad la bdud rtsi nyi ma'i 'od lta bu drod shin tu che ba/ tsha ba'i nad la bdud rtsi zla 'od lta bu dwangs shing bsil ba/ rlung nad la bdud rtsi 'bri mar gyi zhun ma lta bu bcud dang ldan pa/ gdon nad la bdud rtsi khro chu zangs zhun lta bu rno la rtsub pa'i gseb nas gdon 'dul gyi khro bo 'gyu ba sogs dmigs pa'i kha bsgyur bya ba man ngag yin no gsungs/ ༈ /gsum pa ni/ gdon bgegs thams cad sbal sbrul/ sdom sdig rta glang*/ grog sbur/ lcang mo sogs srog chags ma rungs pa'i rnam par ded de sbyangs par mos pa ste/ de ltar bsgoms pas dngos nyams rmi lam du lus las 'bu srin rnag khrag thon pa/ khrus byas pa/ nam mkhar 'phur ba/ gos ser po dkar po gyon pa/ nyi zla 'char ba sogs sdig sgrib dag pa'i rtags rnams 'byung zhing*/ bag chags ngan pa dag par byed pa'i slad du 'di la brtson pa gal che zhing*/ yi ge brgya pa'ang ji tsam mang ba legs na'ang*/ rgyun du nyer gcig re ma mthar byas pa bzla ste/ dmigs skor gsum po de re re la bdun bdun du bcad pas 'grub bo gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs bskor dbang bzhi blang ba ni/

rang tha mal du gnas pa'i lus stong sangs phru ma phus btab pa lta bu'i nang gi dbus drang thad sgal tshigs la cung zad nye bar rtsa dbu ma mda' smyug dang*/ ro rkyang gro sog gi phra sbom tsam sum gshibs su gnas pa mar sne lte 'og sor bzhi tsam dang*/ dbu ma'i yar sne tshangs bug tu kha gdangs nger yod pa de nyid la srog shing byas pa'i/ spyi bor rtsa 'dab so gnyis/ mgrin par bcu drug snying gar brgyad/ lte bar drug cu re gnyis pa rnams gdugs kyi rtsibs ltar bkram pa/ kha dog rang gi sha mdog lta bu/ thams cad sbubs stong ldir ri bar bsam/ de'ang rang lus stong sangs nger bdud rtsi phab ste dbang bzhi blang dmigs byas chog kyang*/ rdzogs rim zab mo'i smin byed du rtsa sbyong gi cha mthun lta bur 'gro bas rtsa 'khor bsgoms pa nyid legs pa yin gsungs/ de la dmigs skor dang po ni/ rdor sems las gong ltar bdud rtsi babs/ tshangs bug nas zhugs/ spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor gang*/ sne nas phyir lud pas smin mtshams yan chad gang*/ lus kyi sdig sgrib dag rdor sems sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ bum pa'i dbang thob/ sprul sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag par mos/ ༈ /gnyis pa ni/ sngar ltar bdud rtsi babs/ mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor dang de yan gyi lus gang*/ ngag gi sdig sgrib dag gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ gsang ba'i dbang thob/ longs sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag par mos/ ༈ /gsum pa ni/ sngar bzhin bdud rtsi babs/ snying ga'i rtsa 'khor dang de yan gyi lus gang*/ yid kyi sdig sgrib dag thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ chos sku 'grub pa'i nus pa bzhag par mos/ ༈ /bzhi pa ni/ sngar ltar bdud rtsi babs/ lte ba'i rtsa 'khor dang lus thams cad gang*/ sgo gsum gyi sdig sgrib mtha' dag sbyangs/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ dbang bzhi pa thob/ zung 'jug ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i nus pa bzhag par mos la de re re la'ang yi ge brgya pa bzla ste thun mong ma yin pa'i dmigs rkang bzhi'o// yi ge brgya pa'ang*/

thams cad gsang ba'i rgyud las/ rdo rje slob dpon gang dag gis// lhag pa'i lha ni gang dag la// dpal ni nges par sbyor bya zhing*// dpal ni nges par brjod par bya// zhes pa'i lung la brten nas 'gro mgon 'phags pa rin po ches shrī zhes sbyor ba gnang ba'i/ oṃ shrī badzra he ru ka sogs he ru ka'i yi ge brgya pa bzla ste/ a bhi dha na las/ dpa' bo dang ni rnal 'byor ma// 'di ni kun gyi gsang sngags te// zhes dang*/ mtshan brjod las/ thig le stong pa yi ge brgya// zhes gsungs pas bsod nams tshad med pa'i 'jug ngogs su gyur pa'o// mthar rdo rje thal mo sbyar te/

3 nyes pa las slar log pa'i stobs deng phyin chad sdig pa mi dge ba'i las srog la babs kyang mi bgyid do snyam pas/ bdaṃg niṃ miṃ sheṃs zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje sems dpa'i zhal nas dgyes bzhin du/ rigs kyi bu zhes sogs sdig pa dag pa'i dbugs dbyung stsal zhing phyin chad de ltar ma byed ces gdams te/ 'od dkar po zhu nas rang la thim par bsam pa ni kun rdzob kyi bshags pa dang*/ rdor sems rang nyid la thim pa de'i ngang las rang sems dang dbyer med du gyur par bsams la rig pa brjod med du 'jog des dub na sems kyi gsal gdangs sna tshogs su 'char ba ni/ sems dpa' srid pa gsum gcig pa// zhes pa ltar sems gsal ba'i ngo bo/ rang bzhin stong pa brjod bral du gnas pa ni/ rdo rje mi phyed ces kyang brjod// ces pa ltar rdo rje ste don dam pa'i rdor sems kyi rang ngo shes par byas la de'i ngang la gzhag pa bla na med pa don dam pa'i bshags pa ste de gnyis dang*/ spyir yang stobs bzhi'i gnad dang ldan pas bshags na sdig ltung ji tsam che'ang 'dag nges snyam pa gnyen po 4 kun spyod dam/ sor chud pa'i stobs so// sbyang gzhi thog med nas bsags pa'i sdig ltung thams cad sbyong byed rdo rje sems dpa'i rnal 'byor 'dis sbyangs pas/ sbyangs 'bras sgrib bral ye shes chen po mngon du 'gyur zhing*/ spyir sdig pa la yon tan med kyang bshags pas dag pa sdig pa'i yon tan yin gsungs pas sdig ltung rang bzhin med par shes pa'i sgo nas khrid kyi skabs dang*/ dus gzhan du'ang nan tan gyis brtson pa gal che ste/ nyi ma re re bzhin nyer gcig re bzlas pas ltung ba'i 'phel kha chod pa dang*/ 'bum bzlas pas myong nges kyi las dang rtsa ltung yang 'dag par bshad cing*/ rgyun du rdor sems sgom bzlas bar 'dir ma lcogs kyang cho ga chad skyon ni med do gsungs/ ༈ /bzhi pa maṇḍal bla ma'i rnal 'byor la/

gal che ba'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ sgom tshul dngos gnyis las/ dang po ni/ he badzra las/ gzhan gyis brjod min lhan cig skyes// gang du yang ni mi rnyed de// bla ma'i dus thabs bsten pa dang*// bdag gi bsod nams las shes bya// zhes sems nyid brjod bral gyi rang ngo mthong nas/ zung 'jug gi go 'phang thob dgos la/ de lta bu'i sems nyid ni bla ma dam pa'i gdams pa dang*/ mos gus bsod nams bsags rgyab la brten pa las gzhan gang gis kyang brjod pa dang myong ba'i yul las 'das pa ste/ gzhaṃn yaṃng*/ kha dog yi ge yon tan dpe bral ba// smra ru mi btub gyi na tsam gyis mtshon// zhes gsungs pa ltar lung rigs gtan tshigs gang gis kyang mthil phyin par brjod pa dang rtogs par mi nus pas ngag gi lam las 'das par ma zad/ smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// zhes pa ltar/ phyi nang gang du btsal kyang sems nyid la dbyibs dang kha dog tu ma grub pa'i phyir/ rang zhal mthong ba'i skabs med do// 'o na de rtogs pa'i thabs med dam zhe na/ nā ga rdzu nas/ ri rab rtse nas gang zhig lhung gyur na// lhung bar mi 'gyur snyam yang lhung bar 'gyur// bla ma'i drin las phan pa'i lung thob na// grol bar mi 'gyur snyam yang grol bar 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa bzhin sems nyid rtogs pa la/ bla ma dam pa la brten nas bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pas/ de'i byin rlabs kyi mthu las da gzod ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs te/ gnas lugs kyi don phyin ci ma log pa rtogs par 'gyur te/ sdud pa las/ ji srid dge ba'i rtsa ba yongs su ma rdzogs par// de srid stong nyid dam pa de ni rtogs mi 'gyur// zhes dang*/ rgyud las/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen gnas// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// zhes so// de la tshogs gsog pa'i yul yang*/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod pa bas/ bla ma kho na lhag par bsngags pa ci yin snyam na/ rang cag snyigs ma'i dus mthar skyes pa'i skabs 'dir/

sangs rgyas kyi sku dngos su mthong ba dang*/ gsung snyan thos par mi nus shing*/ mthong thos kyi skal ba dang mi ldan pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyi byin rlabs 'jug mi thub/ bla ma dam pa 'di ni rang dang skal ba 'tshams shing tshul mtshungs pa'i mdzad pa bstan te/ sku gsung dngos su mthong thos kyi yul du mi gzugs bzung nas bsod nams kyi zhing du bzhugs shing*/ zab rgyas kyi gdams pa sangs rgyas bzhugs kyang de las lhag pa gsung rgyu med par gang 'dod lhug par 'doms pa de rim gyis nyams su blangs pas spangs rtogs thams cad bskyed pa'i gzhir gyur pas na/ sku drin gyi ngos nas sangs rgyas thams cad las kyang bla ma nyid lhag par bka' drin che/ de che ba'i phyir bsod nams kyi zhing du mchog tu 'gyur/ de la gsol ba btab pas byin rlabs myur du 'jug pa'i phyir bla ma'i rnal 'byor nyid la brtson dgos te/ sdom 'byung las/ 'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das// lhag pa'i lha ni gcig pu nyid// man ngag rab tu ster ba'i phyir// rdo rje slob dpon de bas lhag /ces dang*/ mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi// sku ni bskal par bsgoms pa bas// bla ma dran pas bsod nams che// zhes dang*/ gsang 'dus las/ sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed la mchod pa byas pa bas/ bla ma'i ba spu'i bu ga gcig la til mar gyis byugs pa phan yon che'o// zhes gsungs so gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor bsgom tshul dngos la thun mong ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ rang sems dang rdor sems bsres pa'i stong nyid de'i ngang las/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seṅges btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri/ sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can/ sku mdog dmar po/ phyag g.yas bde stong gi sgra sgrogs pa'i ḍā ma ru dang*/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin pa/

gru mo g.yon na kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams shing*/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ lang tsho dar la babs pa'i rnam pa can/ skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bor gyur par bsams la mos gus drag pos/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes sogs gdung shugs drag pos gsol ba btab pas/ bla ma 'od dmar po'i rnam pas rang gi spyi bo nas zhugs/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig la thim pas/ de nyid je cher song ste mthar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar gyur par mos la/ gsal stong 'dzin med kyi ngang du mnyam par gzhag go/ ༈ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa la/ gnyis bral 'chad dus kyi zhal shes gsum zhes pa'i dang po bla ma bskyed pa'i zhal shes/ gnyis pa dbang blang ba'i zhal shes/ gsum pa bla ma bstim pa'i zhal shes dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ brgyud pa'i byin rlabs 'jug pa dang chos rgyud mi nub pa'i rten 'brel du tho brtsegs/ rtogs pa skye sla ba'i phyir kun 'dus nor bu lugs/ 'khor dang longs spyod rgyas phyir khrom 'tshogs rnams su bsgom tshul yod pa las/ 'dir phyi ma ltar bsgom pa la/ tshogs zhing bskyed bstim/ de la phyag 'tshal ba/ zhen chags spang ba/ mchod pa dang bzhi las/ dang po ni/ gnas khang skyabs 'gro'i skabs ltar gsal 'debs shing*/ de'i dbus su rang gi smin mtshams kyi thad drang gi nam mkhar rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i shar sgo rang la blta ba'i/ mchan/ thar pa chen po'i gzhal med khang*/ gru bzhi/ sgo bzhi/ rta babs bzhi dang bcas pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ dag gsal 'od dang ldan pa'i dbus su rin po che'i khri dbang phyug brgyad mtshon pa'i seṅge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa mtho zhing rgya khyon shin tu che ba'i dbus su seng khri de las chung ba zhig gi khar sna tshogs padma dang*/

zla ba dang*/ nyi ma'i gdan gyi steng du rang gi bka' drin sum ldan gyi rtsa ba'i bla ma de nyid 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po dang*/ kun dga' 'jam dbyangs tha mi dad pa/ sangs rgyas rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa mi tshad che phyogs sku mdog dmar po mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/ dpe byad bzang po brgyad cus brgyan pa/ 'od dang gzi byin 'bar zhing zhal gcig zhi zhing 'dzum pa/ phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin cing thugs kar bsnol ba'i 'khyud rgya can/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i rgyan brgyad dang dar bzang po kha dog sna tshogs pa'i stod g.yogs dang*/ smad g.yogs lhab lhub tu gsol ba/ de'i mdun thad seng khri che ba'i steng nas g.yon skor gyis sgor mor padma dang zla ba nyi ma'i gdan re re'i steng du/ mdun du sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ de nas rim par rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ 'di la ring brgyud mi mdzad gsung*/ mchan/ grub chen nā ro ta pa/ pham mthing pa sku mched gnyis/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal gyo lo tsā ba blo gros grags/ sa chen kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang ston dkon mchog dpal ba/ na bza' brag phug pa bsod nams dpal ba/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ yar klungs pa seṅge rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ yab rje 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rdo ring kun spangs pa kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma/ tshar chen rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug sding ma mkhan chen bslab gsum rgyal mtshan/ khyab bdag dbang phyug rab brtan/ bka' 'gyur ba mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/

zhwa lu ba rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' lhun grub/ gnas gsar ba kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros/ mkhas grub phyogs las rnam rgyal/ dge 'dun bkra shis dpal 'byor/ zhwa lu ri sbug sprul sku rin chen blo gsal bstan skyong rnams so// ༈ /yang na kun blo nas/ thar rtse nam mkha' 'chi med/ rje legs pa lhun grub/ de gnyis ka las mkha' spyod dbang mo 'chi med bstan pa'i nyi ma/ 'dren mchog ngag dbang rin chen/ byams pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ gcung rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po rnams/ ༈ /yang na gnas gsar ba nas bod 'brug blo gsal phun tshogs/ lce btsun bstan 'dzin 'phrin las/ bka' 'gyur ba dga' ldan bstan 'dzin/ gsang sngags mkhar pa dga' ldan dar rgyas/ dngul chu bla ma dbang phyug chos bzang*/ rin chen blo gsal bstan skyong rnams sangs rgyas las logs su med pa'am/ lam 'dis mchog brnyes pa mtshon phyir thams cad kyang dpa' bo rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa sku mdog dmar po g.yas ḍā ma ru 'khrol zhing*/ g.yon thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar bsnams pa/ gru mo g.yon na kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin cing*/ dar dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ mtshan dpe gsal rdzogs longs sku'i rnam pa can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis zhal phyir bstan dang nang bstan gang bder bzhugs par mos/ de'ang gong gi brgyud srol mi 'dra ba rnams so so'i dus mnyam du bsdus te ngo bo dbyer med du byed pa'o// blos ma lcogs na so sor byed pa dang*/ de'ang ma bde na brgyud srol gang rung gcig gis chog go /de rnams kyi steng 'og bar gsum mtha' skor du bla ma yi dam/ sangs rgyas byang sems/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro/ chos srung nor lha/ dam can gter bdag gi tshogs thams cad sprin phung gtibs pa ltar bzhugs par bsam/

tshogs zhing de dag thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po re re gsal gdab/ de rnams kyi thugs ka'i hūm̐ yig las 'od zer dmar po lcags kyu lta bu dpag tu med pa spros pas/ rtsa ba'i bla mas thog drangs chos 'brel dngos thob kyi bla ma rnams dang*/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas skyabs kyi yul du gyur ro cog ma lus pa spyan drangs/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma re re la'ang skyabs gnas cha tshang ba re re bstim zhing*/ de dag skyabs kun 'dus pa'i ngo bor gsal gdab pa yid 'khul nges bya'o gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa de la phyag 'tshal ba ni/ rang gi lus zhing gi rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam par sprul nas lus gus pas phyag dang*/ ngag gus pas gsol 'debs kyi tshig yid gus pas gsol ba phur tshugs su gdung shugs drag pos 'debs bzhin/ dngos su phyag 'tshal ba'am/ thal mo sbyar te/ gangaṃ giṃ driṃn gyisaṃ sogs dang*/ sangs rgyas rdo rje chos la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabatu gsol// zhes pa nas gong ltar/ rin chen blo gsal bstan skyong la= /bdag gi rgyud= /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la= /bdag gi rgyud= /zhes pa'am/ rnal 'byor 'jam dpal bzang po la= /bdag gi= /drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la= /bdag gi= /zhes pa'i bar sbyar ba dang*/ yang na/ skyabaṃs kunaṃ 'aṃdus zhal rtsa brgyud bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa'am/ rgyas par na/ rgyalaṃ baṃ rgyaṃ mtshoṃ'i riṃgs bdaṃg rdoṃ rjeṃ choṃs// zhes sogs brgyud 'debs kha skong dang bcas pa legs par 'don dgos kyi/ gang yin rtsad ma chod pa'i ham pa dpa' thal mi bya la/ 'dod don gsol ba'i phyir/ daṃl 'byoraṃ gruṃ chenaṃ sogs smon lam yang bya'o// ༈ /gsum pa zhen chags spang ba ni/

skyabs yul rnams kyi mdun der/ rang gi gces shing phongs pa'i khang zhing*/ nor rdzas/ gnyen bshes/ mdza' grogs sogs chags pa skye yul gang yod khrom chen po'i tshong zong ltar gsal btab la/ de rnams kyang sngar bas kha dog rgyu/ dbyibs sogs bzang zhing phun sum tshogs par bsams la/ dusaṃ gsumaṃ sangaṃs rgyasaṃ thamaṃs cadaṃ kyiṃ ngo bo bla ma rin po che la bdag gi gnyen bshes nor rdzas kyi dngos po thams cad dbul bar bgyi'o// bdag 'dzin chags ser sna dang bral bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes rang gis bdag tu bzung ba dang*/ ma bzung ba'i longs spyod thams cad bla ma la phongs pa med par phul bas/ bla ma dgyes bzhin bdag gir bzhes te/ rang 'dod chags rang grol du song bar bsam/ ༈ /yang rang gi mdun der sdang bar byed pa'i dgra dang*/ gnod par byed pa'i bgegs/ phung sna 'dren pa'i byur sogs zhe sdang skye ba'i yul thams cad khrom ltar gsal btab la gong bzhin/ bdag gi dgra sogs zhe sdang skye ba'i yul thams cad dbul bar bgyi'o// bdag zhe sdang dang bral bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes phul bas/ rang gir bzhes te/ rang zhe sdang rang grol du song bar mos/ ༈ /yang rang gi mdun du/ tshe 'dir phan gnod ci'ang ma byas pa'i bar ma'i sems can rnams dang*/ dngos po bar ma thams cad gsal btab la gong bzhin/ bdag gi bar ma'i sems can dang dngos po thams cad dbul bar bgyi'o// bdag rmongs pa gti mug dang bral bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes phul bas/ rang gir bzhes te/ rang gti mug rang grol du song bar mos te chags sdang rmongs gsum skye yul med na mi skye ba'i phyir ro gsungs/ ༈ /bzhi pa mchod pa la/ phyi mchod/ nang mchod/ gsang mchod/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa/ ku sā li'i tshogs gsog maṇḍal dang drug las/ dang po phyi mchod la'ang nyer spyod lnga/ rig ma bcu drug rin chen bdun/ 'dod yon lnga ste bzhi/

dang po nyer spyod ni/ rang nyid skad cig gis rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas/ 'od zer gyi sne la mchod pa'i lha mo mdzes sdug rgyan gyis sgeg pa/ mthong ba tsam nas bde chen gyi ye shes skyed par nus pa dpag med sprul te/ rang rgyud kyi dus gsum gyi dge rtsa thams cad dang*/ der ma zad mi dge ba'i las 'bras bag chags bcas pa thams cad kyang*/ mchod pa'i rdzas bzang zhing gya nom pa/ kun tu bzang po'i rnam thar las byung ba lta bur bsgyur ba dang*/ phyogs bcu'i zhing rab 'byams kyi mchod rdzas thams cad kyang blangs te/ de yang lha mo dkar mos phyag tu dung phor yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chus bkang ba la sman bzang pos bkang ba'i mchod

1 yon/ lha mo dkar mos rin po che'i snod du zhabs 'khru 2 ba'i chu gtsang dri med 'dag rdzas dang ldan pa/ lha mo dkar mos me tog 3 gi sdong bu dang dkon bu dang sil ma btus pa'i phreng ba sogs mdzes shing dri zhim pa ma rnying pa/ lha mo dud kas nor bu'i spos snod bzang por tsandan dang a ga ru dang du ru ka sogs ril bu dang phye mar byas pa'i bdug 4 pa'i dud sprin lang long du g.yo ba/ lha mo dmar ser gyis gser gyi kong bu 'bru mar rtsi mar sogs kyi mar me dang nor bu me shel la sogs pa'i snang gas 5 la 'od bkrag 'gyed pa/ lha mo ljang gus shel dkar gyi snod dam dung phor du ga pur gur gum dzā ti sihla la sogs pa'i dri bza 6 nga chu gtsang la sbyar ba'i byug pa/ lha mo sna tshogs pa'i mdog gis rin po che'i snod du zha 7 la zas ro brgya dang ldan pa/ lha mo kha dog ma nges pa du mas pi waṃ gling bu rdza rnga cha lang sogs 'bud dkrol rgyud sbubs las byung ba'i rol mo'i da 8 byangs snyan bcas so sor thogs te phul bar bsam la/ stong gsum 'di'am zhes sogs kyi mthar mtshan sngags mchod sngags phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod pa ni chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod rol mor bcas pa ste mthar lha mo rnams rang gi snying gar bsdu ba rlung sems dbu mar 'du ba'i rten 'brel yod gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa rig ma bcu drug ni/ dkyil chog gi mchod phreng ltar/ rdo rje lha mo pi waṃ ma// zhes sogs sam/ bsdu na sngags tsam gyis kyang rung bas/ gang ltar phyag rgya dang bcas pas mchod/ lha mo rnams kyi sku mdog tshig las gsal zhing spro bsdu snying ga nas byed pa yang 'dra'o/ ༈ /gsum pa rin chen bdun dbul ba ni/ yang rang gi snying kha nas gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa/ dgos 'dod bsam 'phel gyi nor bu/ mdzes sdug yid 'ong gi btsun mo/ blo gros ldan pa'i blon po/ theg chen stobs dang ldan pa'i glang po/

rlung shugs ldan pa'i cang shes/ nor mdzod 'chang ba'i khyim bdag gam/ phas rgol 'joms pa'i dmag dpon rnams spros te mchod par bsam la/ driṃn can rtsa brgyud bla ma la// 'khor lo rin chen 'di phul bas// zhes sogs dang sngags dang phyag rgyas dbul zhing*/ chos kyi rgyal srid brtan pa'i rten 'brel du 'di mi bsdu bar gzhag gsungs/ ༈ /bzhi pa 'dod yon ni/ yang rang gi snying ga nas gzugs kyi lha mo dkar mo me long ngos gnyis pa thogs pa/ sgra'i lha mo sngon mo rgyud mang bsgreng ba/ dri'i lha mo ser mo dri'i dung chos bsnams pa/ ro'i lha mo dmar mo zhal zas bsnams pa/ reg bya'i lha mo ljang gu lha'i na bza' thogs pa mdzes shing sdug pa rnams spros te mchod par bsams la/ khaṃ doṃg dbyibaṃs legaṃs sogs dang sngags rgyas 'bul la/ mthar 'dod yon lha mo so so bla ma'i dbang po sgo lnga'i gnas so sor thim pas thugs rgyud la bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes khyad par can 'khrungs par mos pas/ dbang shes lnga dag pa'i rten 'brel yod la/ gzhan yang bkra shis rdzas rtags nye rin rnams kyang phul bas chog gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa nang mchod ni/ sngar nas nang mchod byin gyis brlabs zin pas byin rlabs bskyar nas ma byas kyang rung mod/ nus shing spro na nang mchod kha gsos pa sngar ltar phyag rgya dang bcas byin gyis brlabs te/ dmigs pa rgyas pa bde mchog gi khrid las blangs pas 'thus/ de nas rang gi snying ga nas rnal 'byor ma dpag tu med pa spros te phyag gi thod pas mdun gyi ka pā la nas bdud rtsi lum lum bcus te/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma la so sor phul bar bsams la/ so so'i mtshan mthar 'bru gsum btags pas dngos su mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi 'thor nas 'bul zhing*/ rnal 'byor ma rnams rang la bsdu ba sogs 'dra/ ༈ /gsum pa gsang mchod ni/ yang rang gi snying ga nas rnal 'byor ma mdzes sdug can phyag mtshan spangs pa dngos brgyud bla ma'i grangs dang mnyam pa spros te/

snyan pa'i glu dbyangs blangs/ mdzes pa'i gar bsgyur te mthar bla ma rnams dang snyoms par zhugs nas 'o dang*/ 'khyud pa/ padmas reg pa sogs la brten nas zag med lhan skyes kyi bde ba chen po sku nyams su bstar bas mnyes par bsams la/ lhanaṃ skyesaṃ bdeṃ ba'iṃ dpal ster sogs sngags dang bcas pa brjod cing 'khyud rgya'i mthar se gol gtog skabs 'dir rang rgyud la rjes chags mi skyed kyang mchod yul rnams bde chen la rol pa'i dmigs pa brtan khyad yin la/ mthar spros pa'i rig ma rnal 'byor ma rnams rang la bsdu bar bya'o gsungs/ ༈ /bzhi pa de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ mchod yul tshogs zhing*/ mchod mkhan rang nyid/ mchod bya dngos bshams yid sprul gyi rdzas thams cad blos phar brtags nas/ ming brdas bzhag pa tsam las/ don rang bzhin gyis ma grub pas stong pa'i lta thog tu bzhag la/ choṃsaṃ sku rangaṃ bzhiṃn zhes sogs brjod/ ༈ /lnga pa ku sā li'i tshogs gsog ni/ ku sā li zhes dge ba dang ldan pa'am/ ku su lu zhes ma bcos lhug par 'jog pa la go ba 'jug pas/ de'ang paṇḍi ta ltar mkhas par ma bslabs/ rnal 'byor pa ltar brtul zhugs can du'ang ma byas par/ col chung ngus rang rgyud dge ba la sbyor ba zhig gis nyams su blang bya ste/ de lta bu'i rang lus tshogs su 'bul tshul la/ rang nyid tha mal par gnas pa'i lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma sba lcag tsam khang stong gi ka ba ltar mas sne lte 'og sor bzhi dang*/ yas sne tshangs bug tu kha gdang nger yod pa'i snying ga'i thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du rang sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam rgyan phyag mtshan dang bcas pa gsal btab la/ de nyid dbu ma'i nang brgyud tshangs bug nas rgyangs kyis thon te tshogs zhing gi seng khri'i thad du slebs pa dang gzhan du bla ma dang zhal sbyor du bzhugs pa las phyi mig bltas zhes byung kyang gong du gsang mchod song bas 'dir ma byas kyang chog gsungs/

mchan/ rang gi phung po rnying pa de nyid la g.yon nas phyi mig zhig bltas pas phung po de lings kyis 'gyel/ de'ang che ba/ tsho ba/ snum pa/ mdzes pa zhig tu gyur par mthong nas/ ga re/ bdag tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas rnam smin gyi phung po ji snyed cig blangs pa thams cad dbang med du 'dor zhing don med don log 'ba' zhig tu chud zos song 'dug pa la/ da res phung po 'di nyid mchod sbyin du byas la tshogs rlabs po che bsags te don yod par bya'o snyam du bsams nas/ de nyid du phyir log ste/ phung po'i rtsar byon/ phyag gi gri gug des phung po'i smin mtshams/ ltag pa/ rna gong rnams su reg tsam re byas pas thod pa gog la khad du gyur pa de nyid/ phyag g.yon pas ling gis bkog nas blangs pas stong gsum gyi rgya khyon tsam du gyur pa de/ mdun du rlung ljang nag g.yo ba/ de'i steng du me gru gsum dmar zhing 'bar ba/ de'i steng du mi mgo rlon pa'i sgyed pu ri rab tsam gsum rnams rang grub tu byung ba'i steng du bkal/ de nas phyag gi gri gug gis phung po de'i rkang pa g.yon/ rkang pa g.yas/ lag pa g.yon/ lag pa g.yas/ brla g.yon/ brla g.yas/ dpung pa g.yon/ dpung pa g.yas/ mgo ltag g.yon/ mgo ltag g.yas rnams dum bu gsum gsum du bregs shing gtubs nas thod pa'i nang du bskyur/ de nas lus khog pa g.yon dang g.yas/ nang khrol don snying thams cad dum bur gtubs nas bskyur bas sha'i ri bo/ rus pa'i gram khrod/ khrag zhag gi rgya mtsho chen pos mer gyis khengs par bsam/ thod pa'i sgyed pu'i 'og gi rlung g.yos/ me drag tu 'bar/ thod pa dros/ nang gi rdzas rnams zangs snod du mar zhu ba ltar zhu zhing so ro ro khol/ snyigs ma rnams lbu sob kyi rnam pas kha nas phyir g.yam pa me lces lhag med du bsregs/ de'i steng gi nam mkhar hūm̐ sngon po/ āḥdamar po/ oṃ dkar po rnams steng nas steng du brtsegs mar gnas pa/

de rnams las 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi ye shes kyi bdud rtsi dang*/ khams gsum gyi bcud thams cad bdud rtsi 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum gyi rnam par bsdus te 'bru gsum la thim/ hūm̐ mthing thod par lhung bas kha dog dri ro nus pa'i skyon sbyangs/ āḥdamar lhung bas zag med ye shes kyi bdud rtsir bsgyur/ oṃ dkar lhung bas mi zad pa'i gter du mang por spel bar byas nas yi ge gsum bdud rtsi dang gcig tu 'dres pas/ thod pa'i rdzas de nyid zag med kyi bdud rtsi kha dog dkar la ro mngar ba/ reg bya bsil ba/ nus pa shi nas zhag bdun lon pa'ang gso bar nus pa lta bu/ rlangs pa las grub pa'i mtshan ma dpal be'u dang*/ g.yung drung dang*/ dga' ba 'khyil ba/ bkra shis rdzas rtags kyi gzugs brnyan 'char ba zhig tu bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes phyag rgya dang bcas lan gsum gyis byin gyi brlabs la/ raṃng semaṃs rnalaṃ 'byoraṃ maṃ sogs brjod/ de nas dbul ba la/ kha cig mgron rigs bzhi logs su bsam tshul bshad kyang*/ rang lugs la/ rang sems rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba des phyag gi thod pas bdud rtsi de nas bcus te/ rtsaṃ ba'iṃ blaṃ maṃ rdo rje 'chang la lan bdun gyi bar mtshan mthar 'bru gsum btags la phul bas kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan gyi go 'phang myur du thob pa'i dgos pa yod gsungs/ de nas/ rang sems rnal 'byor mar gsal ba de nyid thod pa'i zur der bsdad/ rang gi snying ga nas rnal 'byor ma thod pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ de dag ngang pa'i khyu mtsho nang zhugs pa ltar bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho der dmar ltem gyis zhugs/ thod pas bdud rtsi nas bcus te brgyudaṃ pa'iṃ blaṃ ma rnams la lan re phul bar mos te/ so so'i mtshan mthar 'bru gsum btags pas dbul/ de nas yang bcus te/ gzhaṃn yaṃng mchoṃd paṃr 'os pa'i skyabs yul thams cad la 'bru gsum dang bcas pas mchod/

de nas yang bcus te/ gdoṃn bgeṃgs riṃgs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad la sbyin pa dang 'thor ba sogs byas pas myong grol dang reg grol du gyur te/ snod thams cad chos 'byung gi gzhal yas khang*/ bcud thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur par bsams la 'bru gsum dang bcas pas dbul/ skyabs yul rnams kyi ljags rdo rje rtse gsum pa 'od kyi sbu gus bdud rtsi drangs te gsol bas thugs rgyud la zag med kyi bde ba chen po 'khrungs/ dngos grub dang byin rlabs stsol bar bsam/ bgegs rigs 'gro drug thams cad lus zag med 'ja' lus dang sems rtog med chos kyi skur gyur par bsams la/ de ltar skyabs yul bde ba chen pos mnyes pa dang*/ mar mgron rnams grol ba la bkod pa'i thabs mkhas lus bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di 'dra'i don chen 'grub pa dga' ba la ang snyam du rjes su yi rangs bsgom/ mthar lha mo rnams snying gar bsdu zhing*/ rlung me thod sgyed snod bcud thams cad rang yal du song bar bsams la bde stong gi ngang du mnyam par 'jog/ ༈ /drug pa maṇḍal ni/ maṇḍal gyi rgyu rab gser dngul sogs dang*/ 'bring zangs rag 'khar ba/ tha ma rdza rdo shing gsum gang yang rung ba bsod nams kyi tshogs 'dum pa'i ched ji tsam che ba bzang zhing*/ de lta bu'i maṇḍal gyi gzhi de la 'god rgyu'i rin po che dang sman sna 'bru sna sogs gtsang zhing dri bzang gi chus brlan pa bcas tshogs par byas nas tshom bu lag len ltar bkod cing*/ rang gi lus longs spyod dge tshogs thams cad/ rnam pa ri gling lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs par sprul nas 'bul ba ste/ de'ang dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ phyi lcags ri khor yug dbus su rin po che sna bzhi'i rang bzhin gyi ri rab bang rim bzhi pa lha gnas bye ba dang bcas/ shar lus 'phags gling dkar po zlum po/ lho 'dzam bu'i gling sngon po sog ka

nub ba lang spyod dmar po gru bzhi/ byang sgra mi snyan zla gam ser po'am ljang gu ste/ re rer yang gling g.yog zung res brgyan pa/ nyi zla'i snang ba rab tu gsal zhing*/ 'jig rten thams cad 'byor pa khyad du 'phags pa/ bcud kyi sems can rnams kyang theg pa chen po'i rigs can dbang po rnon po/ rnag smin pa brtol ran pa lta bu sha stag gis gang ba/ snod kyi dpal 'byor dag pa'i zhing khams lta bu/ bar mtshams thams cad lha mi'i longs spyod kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin lta bus phyur bur khengs par bsams la/ dmigs pas 'chun na gling bzhi lhun po bye ba phrag brgya bsgom ste/ maṇḍal tshom bu bdun ma tshar bdun sogs gang mang dang*/ mjug tu 'gro mgon lugs kyi so bdun ma tshar gcig phul/ mi 'dra ba'i khyad par lcags ri dang dri chu g.yon skor du 'gyed/ nyi ma nub dang*/ zla ba shar du dgod/ gzhan spyi ltar la 'dod don gyi gsol 'debs zhal shes ltar bya/ gal te maṇḍal dngos su ma 'byor na dmigs pas kyang rung ngo gsungs/ shes shing spro na gaṃng giṃ mchodaṃ rdzaṃs ma'ang gdangs dang bcas te bya/ mthar thoṃs paṃ rgyaṃ mtshoṃ ma brjod la/ rang gi dus gsum gyi rnam dkar thams cad mchod rdzas de dang der shar bar mos la sgrub pa'i mchod pa dbul/ de'ang dngos 'byor gyi mchod pa la/ dang po rtsol ba'i dri ma/ bar du ser sna'i dri ma/ rjes rlom sems kyi dri ma gsum 'byung bas/ 'di ltar yid kyi 'phrul 'degs ni skyon de dag dang bral bas phul du byung ba'i mchod pa ste/ bsod nams kyi tshogs gsag pa yin no gsungs/ de lta bu'i maṇḍal ni sangs rgyas kyi zhing sbyong du'ang 'gro zhing 'bad pa chung ngus tshogs rlabs po che rdzogs par byed pa yin no// mchod pa de rnams kyis sbyang gzhi thog med nas yul mtho ba sangs rgyas nas/ dma' ba 'bu srin yan chad thams cad la brnyas smod ma gus par byas pa dang*/

ser sna'i sgrib pa gang bsags pa thams cad/ sbyong byed mchod pa'i cho ga 'dis sbyangs pas/ sbyangs 'bras nges pa lnga ldan tshogs kun rdzogs pa'i longs sku mngon du byed do// kha cig brgyud 'debs skabs 'dir mdzad kyang sngar bshad pa nyid legs gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa dbang blang ba'i zhal shes ni/ rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang de nyid la mos gus drag pos/ sangaṃs rgyasaṃ kuṃn dngoṃs zhes sogs bcad lhug gang rigs kyis dbang bskur ba'i gsol 'debs kyi tshigs dngos su rang gis lan gsum brjod cing*/ dmigs pa lan dang pos rang gis rtsa ba'i bla ma la/ lan gnyis pas rtsa ba'i bla mas brgyud pa'i bla ma la/ gsum pas brgyud pa'i bla mas gnang ste rtsa ba'i bla ma la gsol ba btab par bsam gsungs/ mchan/ gsol ba lan gsum btab pas/ rtsa ba'i bla mas brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la 'di la dbang bskur ram mi bskur zhes dgongs pa dang bstun pa'i phyir g.yon phyogs su spyan cher gyis gzigs pas/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams nas kyang dbang bskur cig ces pa'i brdar g.yas phyogs nas bla ma'i thugs kar spyan cher gyis gzigs/ de nas bla ma gong ma gong ma'i byin rlabs kyi rgyun 'og ma 'og mar chad med du bzhugs pa'i brdar bla ma'i mdun gyi rdo rje 'chang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la thim/ rnal 'byor ma nā ro pa la thim pa nas/ rim bzhin 'jam dpal bzang po'am blo gsal bstan skyong gi bar du thim/ de nyid kyang dbus kyi rtsa ba'i bla ma la thim ste/ so so'i gdan khri'ang rim pa des bla ma'i gdan khrir thim/ de nas bla ma'i spyi bor oṃ las 'od dang bdud rtsi dkar po oṃ dkar gyi phreng ba dang bcas pa byung*/ rang gi smin mtshams nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang*/ srog gcod sogs lus kyi sgrib pa dag sku'i byin rlabs dang bum pa'i dbang thob/ lam bskyed rim bsgom pa la dbang*/ dbang dus kyi nyams dga' ba'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/

'bras bu sprul sku thob pa'i nus pa bzhag par bsam/ ༈ /yang bla ma'i mgrin pa'i āḥlas 'od dang bdud rtsi dmar po āḥdamar gyi phreng ba dang bcas pa byung*/ rang gi mgrin pa nas thim/ lus thams cad gang*/ rdzun smra sogs ngag gi sgrib pa dag gsung gi byin rlabs dang gsang ba'i dbang thob/ lam tsaṇḍa lī'am gtum mo bsgom pa la dbang*/ dbang dus kyi nyams mchog dga'i ye shes rgyud la skyes/ 'bras bu longs sku thob pa'i nus pa bzhag par bsam/ ༈ /yang bla ma'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od dang bdud rtsi sngon po'i rgyun hūm̐ sngon gyi phreng ba dang bcas pa byung*/ rang gi snying ga nas thim/ lus thams cad gang*/ brnab sems sogs yid kyi sgrib pa dag thugs kyi byin rlabs dang shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ dbang dus kyi nyams dga' bral gyi ye shes brgyud la skyes/ 'bras bu chos sku thob pa'i nus pa bzhag par bsam/ ༈ /yang bla ma'i gnas gsum gyi yi ge gsum las 'od dang bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing ba'i rgyun 'bru gsum rang mdog gi phreng ba dang bcas pa byung*/ rang gi gnas gsum char nas zhugs/ lus thams cad gang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma thams cad byang zhing dag sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang dbang bzhi pa thob/ lam zung 'jug phyag rgya chen po bsam mi khyab kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa la dbang*/ dbang dus kyi nyams lhan skyes kyi dga' ba rgyud la bskyed/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid sku thob pa'i nus pa bzhag par mos/ de dag ni lam dbang thod rgal du blang ba zhes bya gsungs/ ༈ /gsum pa bla ma bstim pa'i zhal shes ni/ de nas dusaṃ gsuṃm sangaṃs rgyasaṃ thaṃms cadaṃ kyi ngo bo sogs gsol ba gdung shugs drag pos btab nas/ bla ma 'di nyid skyon kun spangs yon tan kun rdzogs kyi sangs rgyas dngos rang yin snyam du rlung dmigs sems gsum 'jug pa gcig tu bsgril/

dad 'dun rtse gcig pas bla ma'i thugs ka'i thad du dmigs pa gtad de rang bla ma'i thugs kar thim la khad pa lta bu dang*/ bla ma'i thugs las rang sems logs su phye mi thub pa lta bu dang*/ rang sems bla mas 'phrog pa lta bu ma byung gi bar du gsol ba phur tshugs su btab pas bla ma dbu gtsug tor nas mar dang*/ gdan seng khri nas yar/ gnas gzhal yas khang nas tshur 'od du ltem gyis zhu/ thugs ka'i thad du 'od dmar po'i gong bur hril gyis 'dril nas/ dmar ba la

dmar ser li khri lta bu zhes kyang 'byung*/ mchan/ bltas na dmar ba'i mthar thug pa/ dwangs gsal nyi ma 'bum gyi 'od ltar gzi brjid bzod par dka' ba/ mthong ba tsam gyis bde chen gyi ye shes skyed nus pa zhig tu lam gyis gyur/ de nyid rang la je nye je nyer nar gyis byung*/ rang gi spyi bo'i tshangs bug nas hril gyis zhugs/ snying ga'i rang sems bam̐ yig la sib kyis thim pas rang sems dang bla ma'i thugs dbyer med du 'dres shing bam̐ yig de je che je cher song nas nam mkha'i mtha' khyab tu yal song bar mos/ der rang sems la cer gyis bltas pas stong pa sems kyi rang bzhin bla ma chos kyi sku/ gsal ba sems kyi mtshan nyid bla ma sprul pa'i sku/ zung 'jug sems kyi ngo bo bla ma longs spyod rdzogs sku ste/ rang sems skad cig ma 'di ga bla ma sku gsum gyi ngo bor thag chod ngo shes par byas te/ gshis skye med stong nyid du rjen ne ba/ gdangs 'gag med mos gus su lam me bar lta thog tu mnyam par gzhag pa ni ye shes kyi tshogs bsag pa don dam bla ma'i rnal 'byor yin gsungs/ 'dir bam̐ la blo gzhag pa snang bcas kyi stong nyid bsgom pa'i lugs te/ de'ang gsang sngags 'bras bu lam byed yin pas/ gnad des snang ba gtan med kyi stong nyid bsgom pa mi 'thad par tshar pa yab sras bzhed de/ 'on kyang rang phyogs mkhas grub mang pos bam̐ je cher dmigs med du btang ste/ rang lhar gsal ba de'i snying gar chos 'byung bam̐ yig sngags bcas bsgoms pas phung po sbyangs te 'od kyi gong bu las lhar bskyed par mdzad pa mi 'thad pa ma yin zhing*/ de de ltar byas kyang chog la/ lam thun mong ba'i phyogs la de nyid legs kyang*/ 'dir bam̐ chen po snang bcas su byas nas rang lus dngos mi dmigs par bam̐ je cher 'gro ba'i skabs su rang lus dang gnas khang de dang bsres te lta ba skyong ba yin no// des sbyang gzhi rang gzhan kun la mthar las ngan gyi dbang gis las dang*/

tshe dang*/ bsod nams kyi stobs zad nas 'chi ba'i gnas skabs byung la/ de'i tshe 'byung ba phra ba nas rim gyis bsdus te sa chu la/ chu me la/ me rlung la/ rlung rnam shes la/ rnam shes snang ba la/ snang ba mched pa la/ mched pa nyer thob la/ nyer thob 'od gsal la thim ste smig rgyu la sogs pa'i rtags 'char zhing*/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa g.yo ba'i las rlung gi rgyu ba rim gyis 'gags nas gzhi dus kyi 'od gsal ston dus tho rangs kyi nam mkha' g.ya' dag pa lta bu de nyid sems can thams cad la 'char yang ngo ma shes pas brgyal ba lta bur gyur te 'chi ba'i snang ba 'char ba yin la/ de nyid sbyong byed ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa 'dis lam du 'khyer te/ rang sems bam̐ yig bde stong gi ngang du bzhag pas/ nam zhig gzhi dus kyi 'od gsal ma zhes bya ba de 'char ba'i tshe/ da lta lam dus su bsgom pa'i stong nyid kyi lta ba'am/ 'od gsal bu zhes bya ba gnyis zhal mjal ra 'phrod pa'i rkyen gyis gzhi gcig lam gnyis dbyer med du 'dres pas/ sbyangs 'bras 'chi ba chos kyi sku mngon du byed pa yin no gsungs/ 'dir smras pa/ gsang chen dbu ma chen po'i chu gter cher// 'jug thabs sngon 'gro'i rin chen gru gzings 'di// 'khrul med gdams pa'i thag pas dam bcings te// rim gnyis dal 'gro'i klung chen 'dir btsugs kyis// bde chen 'jog po'i gtsug nor don gnyer ba'i// las ldan snying grogs tshong phrug 'ga' yod na// bshes gnyen ded dpon thabs mkhas shugs ldan dang*// lhan cig mkha' spyod rin chen gling na bzhud// deng dus phyogs zhen dha du'i khu ba yis// blo bsgyur 'ga' zhig tshig la gces par bzung*// tshad ma bzhi ldan myong ba'i skal bas phongs// kye kye sngon 'gros rgyud sbyongs lam 'dir 'byon// zhes pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ /na mo gu ru badzra dhā ra kā ru ṇi kā ya/
