ma dag phung po lcags khams thabs mkhas kyi// gser rtsis bran pa'i gdams zab 'brug gi sgra// bsgrags kyis skal med srin bya nyal byos la// thar 'dod mdongs mtha' can tshogs rna ba blogs// gnyis pa dngos gzhi bdag 6 lhar bskyed pa'i rnal 'byor la/ bdag gi gzhi sbyang bsgyur dang*/ gzhan gyi gzhi sbyang bsgyur gnyis/ dang po la gsum/ mthar thug gi sbyang gzhi ngos gzung ba/ bdag gi gzhi sbyang ba/ gzhi bsgyur ba'i rim pa'o// dang po mthar thug gi sbyang gzhi ngos 'dzin pa la/ rgya che ba'i sbyang gzhi/ zab pa'i sbyang gzhi/ mthar thug gi sbyang gzhi dang gsum las/ 'dir mthar thug gi sbyang gzhi rang sems lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes brjod pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba 'di sa bon lta bu la/ rkyen bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi skabs su tshogs gnyis bsags pa de chu lud lta bus nyer len byas te/ 'bras bu rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur bskyed pa yin no// de lta bu'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la dbye na/ gsang ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma ste/ sems can thams cad kyi kun gzhi gdod nas dag pa'i sems 'od gsal ba la bya/ de'i rten 'brel la brten nas nang gi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma lte ba'i rtsa mdud gru gsum gyi nang gi a thung ngam lugs 'di pa'i bam̐ yig la bya/ de la brten nas phyi rol 'khor 'das kyi snang ba 'char bas 'og min na bzhugs pa'i lhanaṃ skyesaṃ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dang*/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi yul nyer bzhi gnas so gnyis sogs na bzhugs pa'i zhiṃng skyesaṃ sprul pa'i sku dang*/ yul thams cad na bzhugs pa'i bud med ni laṃs skyesaṃ mkha' 'gro ma/ de dag las ma mkha' 'gro ma yin pa'i rgyud du byung ba'i bu mo ni rigaṃs skyesaṃ mkha' 'gro ma/ rnal 'byor pa rang nyid mkha' spyod dga' ma'i bskyed rim bsgoms pa dang gzhan sbyangs bsgyur byas pa'i 'gro ba rnams sngagaṃs skyesaṃ mkha' 'gro ma ste de dag gi rnam par 'char la/

gzhan yang ma dag snod kyi 'jig rten/ der gnas pa'i bcud kyi sems can thams cad nang gi khams dang rtsa'i stobs kyis shar zhing*/ sems can rnams bde sdug gi tshor ba myong ba ni rten dkyil 'khor bzhi'i stobs kyis shar ba ste/ gzugs sdug mi sdug thams cad rtsa'i stobs kyis dang*/ sgra snyan mi snyan thams cad yi ge'i stobs kyis dang*/ tshor ba bde sdug thams cad bdud rtsi'i stobs kyis dang*/ rnam rtog bsam gyis mi khyab pa thams cad rlung gi stobs kyis shar ba yin te/ ye shes thig ler/ phyi dang phyi yi don rnams kyis// nang gi don gnas shes par bya'o// zhes dang*/ bde mchog nyung ngu'i rgyud las/ ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang*// zhes so// de ltar 'khor 'das kyi chos thams cad rang gi sems la bag chags kyis tshang zhing*/ lus la rtsa yi ge'i rnam par dod/ de'i stobs kyis phyi rol gyi snod bcud snang ba sna tshogs su 'phro ba ni/ sdom 'byung las/ rnam pa sna tshogs dri med yid// dkyil 'khor dag ni 'phro bar snang*// zhes so// de'i phyir rang gi sems nyid ye gdod ma nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i ngo bor gnas pa de gsal bar bya ba'i phyir bla ma dam pas dang po sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du 'jug skabs nang dang gsang ba'i phag mo ngo sprod/ de la nges shes bskyed nas rgyun skyong bar byed pa'i thabs rim pa gnyis kyi rnal 'byor nyams su blangs pas phyi rol gyi dpa' bo dang dpa' mo sprul pa'i sku thams cad dbang du 'du zhing*/ de dag gi byin rlabs kyis rang rgyud kyi nyon mongs pa rags pa spong nus pa 'byung*/ de la brten nas lhan skyes kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor mas byin gyis brlabs pas sems rgyud la bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes zer ba'i sgra bo che de skye bar 'gyur bas na byin gyis yas rlob dang rtogs pa mas 'char bya ba yin no gsungs/

༈ /gnyis pa bdag gi gzhi sbyang ba ni/ stong nyid deṃ'i ngaṃng laṃs raṃng lus dngos su ma dmigs kyang bsgom don sngar bam̐ yig snang med la rang lus snang bcas byas tshe 'dir rang gi snying gar te/ mchan/ snying ga'i thad tsam na e yig bye ru'i mdog can nyis brtsegs e 'dir e mgo mjug log pa zhig kyang yod/ steng ma yig ngo mdun dang*/ 'og ma yig ngo rgyab tu bstan pa'i rnam pa can thol gyis byung bar bsam/ des gang du skye 'gyur gyi gnas dang phaṃ maṃ gnyiṃs sbyor bar byed de/ e nyis brtsegs de nyid yongs su gyur pa las chos 'byung nyis brtsegs gnyis ka'ang phyi dkar la nang dmar ba 'od kyi rang bzhin srab mthug rgya shog tsam pa gcig gi nang du gcig yod kyang gcig gis gcig la thogs sgrib med pa/ chos 'byung phyi ma'i zur gnyis dku g.yas g.yon dang*/ zur gcig sgal tshigs phyogs su bstan pa/ chos 'byung nang ma'i zur gnyis sta zur phyogs dang*/ zur gcig mdun phyogs su bstan pa/ gnyis ka'i rtse mo phra ba thur du zug cing gdengs ka che ba steng du bstan pa/ dwangs gsal 'ja' 'od lta bur bsam/ des gang du skye 'gyur gyi skye gnas bzhis bsdus pa'i mngal gyi gnas thams cad sbyong bar byed/ chos 'byung bsnol ma'i mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa dkar dmar bzhi dang*/ re re la'ang 'khyil chung bzhi re yod par bsams te/ des ni skyes pa lo bcu drug pa la khu ba 'bab pa dang*/ dga' ba bcu drug mtshon/ chos 'byung gnyis la phyi nang gi ngos bcu gnyis yod pas bud med lo bcu gnyis mar khams dmar po 'bab pa dang*/ dga' ba bzhi la mchog dman 'bring gsum du phye ba'i bcu gnyis mtshon/ phyi la zla ba'i cha bcu drug dang nyi ma'i cha bcu gnyis mtshon pa yin gsungs/ ༈ /de nas chos 'byung nang ma'i dbus der a yig dkar po las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya yongs su gang ba/

dbus cung zad dmar ba'i mdangs can chos 'byung gi kha gdangs dang mtho dman rgya tshad mnyam par bsgom/ des mngal skyes dang sgong skyes kyi khu khrag rdzus skyes kyi sems chags rten gsal stong*/ drod skyes kyi rlan gsher rnams sbyong bar byed de/ chos 'byung re re'i zur nas zur du rgya tshad sor bcu gnyis tsam bsgom mo// de'i steng gi dbus su rang gi sems nyid kyi ngo bo yi ge bam̐ dmar po dbu can gyi rnam pa can/ des skye gnas bzhir skye 'gyur gyi rnam shes mtshon/ de'i mthar zla ba'i steng der mdun nas g.yon skor du/ oṃ gsum dang*/ de nas rbas/ ddhabu/ ki ḍā/ ye nī/ dzrab/ rṇawa/ ye nī/ dzrab/ ro bai/ zhes yig 'bru gnyis log de nas/ ye nī tsa/ hūm̐ gsum/ phaṭa gsum/ swā hā zhes pa rnams ther spungs ma yin par khrig ger 'khor ba/ kha dog bye ru'i phreng ba lta bu 'od kyi drwa bas sbrel ba 'greng stabs rang sgra sgrogs par bsgom/ dga' 'khyil bzhi'ang hril li li g.yon skor du 'khor bar bsams te/ des mer mer sogs mngal gyi gnas skabs bcu dang*/ bam̐ yig gis bar do'i lus ngag yid gsum dang*/ sngags phreng gis 'bras bu'i dus kyi mtshan dpe yig 'bru so gnyis mtshan dang*/ dbyangs gsal so sor phral na brgyad cu yod pa dpe byad do// mchan/ dang*/ kha dog dmar pos bar do'i shes pa chags pas bcings pa mtshon te de dag sbyong bar byed/ sngags phreng bam̐ dang bcas pa las 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan 'ja' tshon lta bu bun long gis 'phros pas/ rang gi rnam smin gyi lus sha khrag rus gsum sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa'i ngo bo sngar gyi phyi'i bam̐ bam̐ snang med dang rang snang bcas kyi phyogs la rang lus sbyang ba yin/ mchan/ yig chen po nam mkha'i khams khyab pa de nyid la phog pas/ de thams cad sbyangs te 'od dmar po'i gong bur gyur nas zla gdan gyi steng du tshur 'dus par bsam/

des bar do'i 'khrul snang sbyong zhing mngal du lus rgyas pa mtshon la/ de rnams bar do longs skur 'khyer ba'i rnal 'byor te/ sbyangs 'bras longs sku 'thob par byed do gsungs/ ༈ /gsum pa bdag gi gzhi bsgyur ba ni/ kha cig dur khrod srung 'khor bsgom par bshad kyang*/ rang lugs stong nyid srung ba bla na med// zhes pas sngar ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa des srung 'khor bla med du gyur pas mi dgos la/ dur khrod sogs 'dir gsal gdab mi dgos so// des na chos 'byung nyis brtsegs zla dkyil bam̐ yig sngags phreng 'od dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur pa ni sngar snying gar bsgom rgyu'i chos 'byung ji skad bshad pa bzhin/ rang gi go sar chos 'byung phyi dkar la nang dmar ba nyis brtsegs kyi phyi ma'i zur gcig rgyab dang*/ nang ma'i zur gcig mdun du bstan pa/ gnyis ka'i rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug cing kha gdangs gyen la bstan pa 'od kyi rang bzhin shin tu yangs pa zhig bsgoms te/ rten gzhal yas khang gi dod thub yin la/ de'i dbus su sgrub pa po 'khor bar gnas kyang chags sogs 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pa'i brdar padma dmar po 'dab ma 'bum ldan kha dog dang dri bsung phun sum tshogs pa da lta kha bye ma thag pa lta bu/ de'i steng du ze'u 'bru dang rgya mnyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems sogs dkar chos thams cad kyi myu gu 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i ye shes kyi ngo bor smin pa'i brdar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor me shel gyi maṇḍal kha sbubs pa lta bu dbyibs zlum 'khyil 'od dmar ser gyi phung po bltar mi bzod pa 'phro ba/ de'i steng du raṃng giṃ seṃms nyid rgyal ba thams cad skyed pa'i yum shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i rang bzhin mkhaṃ' spyodaṃ rdoṃ rjeṃ baṃtsun moṃ lhanaṃ skyesaṃ sprulaṃ pa'iṃ sku'iṃ rnam par shar ba ni/

chos sku bde ba chen po'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad zin kyang*/ ma dag 'khaur ba'i gnas su rnam 'phrul sna tshogs pa'i gzugs sku'i bkod pas 'gro ba rnams snying rjes mi gtong bar rjes su 'dzin pa ste/ zhi ba myang 'das kyi mtha' la mi gnas pa mtshon pa'i brdar zhabs g.yas pa thabs kyi rang bzhin brkyangs pas khams gsum las rnam par rgyal ba'i go 'phang brnyes pa mtshon phyir 'jig rten gyi lha chen dus mtshan ma dmar mo gri thod 'dzin pa gan rkyal du bsgyel ba'i 'dod chags kyi gnas nu ma'i steng nas mnan pa/ shes rab chen pos don dam rnam par mi rtog pa spros pa thams cad nye bar zhi ba'i chos kyi sku'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad de/ srid pa 'khor ba'i mtha' la mi gnas pa mtshon pa'i brdar zhabs g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po'am/ dbang phyug mdog nag po gdong gcig pa/ lag pa bzhi pa g.yas gnyis na gri gug dang cang te'u/ g.yon gnyis na thod pa dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'dzin pa kha sbub tu bsgyel ba'i zhe sdang gi gnas snying ga'i thad kyi rgyab tu gti mug gi gnas mgo bo bltab cing*/ phrag dog gi gnas dpral ba nas dzir gyis mnan pa/ de gnyis kyang shi ba'i ro lta bu dang*/ khengs shing dregs pa lta bu ma yin par/ dul ba'i rnam pa nyon mongs pa'i rtog tshogs dang bral ba'i ngang tshul can du bsam/ sems can la rjes su chags pa mtshon phyir so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes kyi rang mdangs sku mdog padma rā ga ltar dmar zhing dwangs la ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas ye shes kyi 'od dmar po 'phro ba/ bskal pa'i me dang nyi ma bye ba'i gzi brjid can/ chos thams cad don dam zung 'jug stong pa nyid kyi dbyings su ro gcig pa mtshon pa'i brdar zhal gcig zhi zhing 'dzum la chags pa'i nyams can/ de'ang ngo shes phrad dus he zer ba lta bu'i zhal cung zad gdangs shing mche ba'i myu gu nas 'bru tsam mngon pa las grag stong skye med kyi chos sgra lhang nger sgrogs pa/

tshems phreng bzhi bcu dkar zhing thags bzang ba/ dus gsum gyi shes bya thams cad sgrib med du gzigs pa'i brdar spyan gsum khro chags kyi nyams can zhi ba ltar zim bu dang*/ khro bo ltar bsgrad pa ma yin pa/ bden pa gnyis po kun rdzob dang don dam thugs su chud pa'i brdar phyag gnyis/ phyag g.yas 'khor ba'i nyes skyon spyi dang bdag tu 'dzin pa'i drwa ba rtsad nas gcod pa'i brdar thur du shad kyis brkyangs pas gser gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa phyed pas yu ba byas pa'i zangs kyi gri gug 'jol stabs su 'dzin pa/ phyag g.yon steng mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub brnyes pa'i brdar gyen du bteg ste/ dung ltar dkar ba'i ka pā la 'dod chags rnam par dag pa mtshon pa'i brdar ngo bo bde stong ye shes chen po'i rang bzhin rnam pa bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba cung zad yo bas bzung ste zhal du dmar chil li li gsol bas bde chen gyi ye shes thugs rgyud la mnga' ba mtshon pa/ shes rab stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin yin pa'i phyir zhal cung zad g.yon phyogs kyi steng du phyogs pa/ phrag pa g.yon par rus pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga dkar po yu ba brgyad gzhog smad phra la rtse mo sbom zhing ldir ba lus tshad dang mnyam pa/ rtsa bar gser gyi rdo rje phyed pa/ rtse mor sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte bar bum pa/ de'i steng du thod skam dkar po/ de'i steng du rlon pa dmar po/ de'i steng du rnyid pa sngon po gsum brtsegs pa'i rtser rdo rje rtse lnga pa sngon po sgang pos mtshan pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang yu ba'i mtshams nas ḍā ma ru dang*/ dril bu dang*/ 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang ba/ rtsa ba mdun dang rtse mo rgyab tu bstan te phrag par bkal nas gru mos 'khyud pa'i tshul gyis 'dzin pa/ thabs bde ba chen po he ru ka dang nam yang mi 'bral bar mtshon pa ste/ de'ang rting pa'i rdo rje phyed pas srung 'khor me ri/ yu ba brgyad gzhog gis dur khrod brgyad dang*/

der gnas pa'i klu/ sprin/ ri/ shing*/ mchod rten/ me/ chu/ phyogs skyong*/ zhing skyong rnams/ sna tshogs rdau rjes gzhal yas khang gi gdan dang sgo mtshams brgyad kyi lha/ bum pas gzhal yas khang*/ mi mgo gsum gyis sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha tshogs/ rtse mo'i rdo rje'i yar rtse'i dbus rwa he ru ka mar rtse'i dbus rwa rnal 'byor ma/ steng rwa bzhi snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ 'og rwa bzhi bum thod bzhi/ ḍā dril/ 'phan rtse gsum pas de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa mtshon te/ yab 'khor lo sdom pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa mtshon pa'o// kun rtog gi 'ching ba thams cad grol ba'i brdar dbu skra bung ba ltar gnag pa 'jam la ma 'dzings shing sil bur grol bas sku sked yan chad khebs pa/ dga' ba'i dga' ba sogs dga' bde bcu drug dang*/ de'i yul stong nyid bcu drug mtshon pa'i lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu'i lang tsho rgyas pa/ bde ba bskyed pa'i nu 'bur zung dang chu 'dzin mkhrang la rgyas pa/ sku smad rgyas shing 'doms stug pa dmar seng nge ba nas khrag gi rgyun 'babs pa/

1 spyi bo'i rtsa 'khor mtshon phyir dbu gtsug tu rus pa'i 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs sum cu gnyis pa sbub stabs su yod pa'i rtsibs kyi gseng bar rnams nas dbu skra phyir thon zhing mi sgrib pa/ sne mo rnams nas rus phreng gi drwa phyed 'phyang ba/ 'khor lo de'i lte bar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i rigs kyi bdag po rnam snang he ru ka dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis g.yas pas 'khor lo thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten te 'dzin pa/ thod skam lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ thor tshug gi rtse mor rdo rje phyed pa dang*/ g.yon ngos su zla tshes kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang gis bzhugs pa la rang 'dra'i yum gyis 'khyud pa zhig bsgom ste/ de'ang bdag bskyed la rigs bdag rang chas byed pa ni/ rgyal po'i bu gcig pu skyes tsam nyid nas rgyal srid du dbang bskur bar nges pa dang*/ mdun bskyed la dbang lhas dbang bskur rgyas gdab bya ba ni/ rgyal po la bu mang po yod pa dbang ma bskur bar rgyal srid la mi dbang ba lta bu ste/ mchod pa'i yul du spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs kyi gtso bor mnga' gsol ba'i phyir dbang bskur ba yin gsungs/ ye shes lnga'i yon tan rdzogs pa'i phyir skra mtshams nas gser gyi 'khyud mo bai ḍūrya sogs kyi phra tshom gyis spud pa bcings par/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga mtshon pa'i mi thod leb mo sor lnga pa la tshon dmar pos kha mig gi ri mo btod pa'i thod skam lnga'i rtse mo rnams su gser gyi pa tra'i nang du dbus mar 'khor lo/ g.yas gnyis la rdo rje dang rin po che/ g.yon gnyis la padma dang ral gri'i gzugs kyis mtshan pa'i cod pan mdzes par bcings pa/ de'i gcig dang gcig gi bar la rus phreng gi drwa ba nyil li li 'phyang ba/ nang gi ā li kā li ste khams dkar dmar rnam par dag pa'i thod skam lnga bcu ye shes rang snang las grub pa'i ro skra'i skud par brgyus pa'i do shal mgrin pa nas brla phra sbom gyi bar du 'phyang ba/

2 snyan gnyis la rus pa'i a long nyis gshibs kyi rnam pa'i snyan rgyan rtse mor gser gyi pa tras mdzes pa/ 3 mgul par rus rgyan dbus dang g.yas g.yon la rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i gzhung gsum gyi bar du mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor mtshon pa'i rus phreng bcu drug gis bsnol mar sbrel zhing*/ sne rnams su drwa phyed zar tshags 'phyang ba/ 4 phyag gi dpung pa gnyis/ mkhrig ma gnyis/ zhabs kyi long bu'i mtshams rnams su rus pa'i gzhung gsum re phan tshun rus phreng gis sbrel zhing drwa phyed dang ldan pa'i gdub bus brgyan pa/ 5 sku sked du rus pa'i gzhung lnga la rus phreng bcu drug bsnol mar btang nas sbrel ba'i 'og pags las lte ba'i rtsa 'khor mtshon pa'i rus phreng drug cu re bzhi 'phyang ba'i sne mor dril chung zla ba phon tshar gyis mtshon pa'i ring ba rnams zhabs kyi long bu/ bar pa rnams byin pa/ thung ba rnams zhabs pus su slebs pa ste phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ se ral kha'am mchod phyir thogs dang*/ thal chen shes rab ma mtshon byed yin pas 'dir mi dgos la/ thod skam dang thod phreng nye ba'i phyag rgya lnga'i gras min gsungs/ sku dang rgyan thams cad dwangs gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can snang stong sgyu ma lta bur bsams la/ mthong ba tsam gyis bde chen gyi ye shes rgyud la skyed par nus pa'i sku las 'od zer dmar po khor yug tu 'phro ba'i sne mo rnams las yeṃ shesaṃ kyi meṃ dpungaṃ rab tu 'bar ba'iṃ klongaṃ naṃ bzhugaṃs par bsgom/ de ni skye ba sprul skur 'khyer ba'i lam 'khyer te/ sbyang gzhi las nyon gyi dbang gis rigs drug gang rung zhig tu skye ba de sbyong zhing*/ sbyangs 'bras sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa'i sku 'grub par 'gyur ba yin no// de'ang rnal 'byor ma 'di nyid ni spyir sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ bye brag tu dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid de/

'di'i gsang sngags las kyang sarba buddha ḍā ki ni zhes pa sangs rgyas kun gyi mkha' 'gro ma zhes pa yin pas 'di nyid bsgoms na de thams cad bsgom par 'gyur zhing*/ rigs thams cad 'dus pa'i bdag nyid de/ rigs thams cad bsdu na sku gsung thugs kyi rigs gsum du 'du ba las/ skyabs 'gro'i skabs bla ma gsung rdo rje dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor skabs bla ma thugs rdo rje dang*/ rigs bdag rnam snang sku rdo rje yin pas rigs thams cad kyi bdag nyid du grub cing*/ rang lhar bskyed pa de'i tshe'ang gsal snang tsam du ma zad/ nga ni tha mal pa nam yang ma yin te/ skyon kun zad yon tan kun rdzogs pa'i 'bras dus kyi rdo rje rnal 'byaur ma nyid yin snyam pa'i nga rgyal bya ba gal che la/ 'di la rigs bdag rnam snang byed pa rnal 'byor ma rnam snang gi rigs yin par ston pa ma yin gyi/ yum stong phyogs shes rab chos sku'i ngo bo la/ snang phyogs thabs gzugs phung rnam dag rnam snang gzugs kyi sku'i rgyas gdab pa yin gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa gzhan gyi gzhi sbyang bsgyur la dngos dang*/ mthar phyin pa'i bya ba gnyis las/ dang po la 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor nyams su len pa ste/ de la gzhi sbyang ba'i rim pa dang*/ bsgyur ba'i rim pa'o// dang po ni/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i snyingaṃ gaṃr sngar bshad pa lta bu'i chos 'byung dmar po nyis brtsegs zla dkyil dang bcas pa'i steng du bam̐ṃ yiṃg sngags phrengaṃ dang bcas pa gsal btab cing*/ de las 'od zer 'ja' tshon lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa bun long gis 'phros/ ba spu'i bu ga nas phar song*/ snod kyi 'jig rten rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba thams cad la phog sdig sgrib dang rnam smin gdos bcas kyi phung po thams cad lhag med du sangs kyis sbyangs/ de thams cad skad cig la 'od dmar po'i phung por gyur par bsgom mo gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa ni/

de'i mod la snod thams cad ye shes kyi gzhal yas khang chos 'byung dmar po 'od kyi rang bzhin can dang*/ bcud thams cad rdoṃ rjeṃ rnal 'byoraṃ maṃ'i skuraṃ lam gyis gyuraṃ par bsam/ de'ang phyi nang snod bcud thams cad rang sems kho na'i rtsal snang yin pa'i don gyis de ltar sbyang zhing bsgyur du btub pa yin la/ sbyang bsgyur 'di dag gi tshe bzod med kyi snying rje chen pos kun nas bslangs te/ 'gro ba rnams sbyang bsgyur byas pas gsang sngags lugs kyi byang sems mthar thug tu 'gro'o gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa sbyang bsgyur mthar phyin pa'i bya ba la dngos dang*/ yan lag gnyis las/ dang po la ye shes pa gzhug pa/ lus dkyil gsal gdab pa/ go cha bcing ba/ sems 'dzin pa/ bzlas pa gnyis bya ba/ zhar byung rdzogs rim bsgom pa/ thun bsdu ba dang bdun las/ ༈ /dang po ni/ kha cig ye shes pa gzhug pa'i gong du lus dkyil bsgom par bshad mod/ rang lugs la dang po ye shes pa gzhug par byed de/ gzhung gi sa bcad las/ dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlab/ 8 /zhes 'byung bas/ 'di la'ang bzhi ste/ gang gis spyan 'dren pa/ gang spyan drangs pa/ gang nas spyan drangs pa/ tshul ji ltar spyan 'dren pa'o// dang po ni/ sgrub pa po rang nyid lhar gsal ba des so// gnyis pa ni/ pho nya mchog 1 'bring 2 tha ma 3 gsum ste/ 'og min gyi lhan skyes 1 rnal 'byaur ma/ 'dzam gling yul nyer bzhi'i zhing 2 skyes rnal 'byor ma/ mkha' 'gro'i rigs skyes kyi rnal 'byor ma dang*/ sngags 3 skyes kyi rnal 'byor ma ste/ thams cad sngags skyes su 'dus pa nyid gang spyan drangs rgyu'o// gsum pa ni/ rang bzhin chos kyi dbyings nas te/ spros bral chos kyi sku nam mkha' lta bu las/ gzugs sku bzhin lag gi rnam par spyan drangs pa'o// bzhi pa ni/ sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gsum las/ sngags ni phaiṃ zhes pa ste/ de'ang drag por brjod cing pho nya gsum gcig tu 'dus pa'i don phaṃ eṃ maṃ gsum gyi gdangs tshang bar ring por brjod/

de bod skad du khoṃs shiṃg ces pa ste/ sngags dang phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis spyan 'dren pa na gnas gsum gyi mkha' 'gro rnams sngon gyi dam tshig rjes su dran nas 'dir mi 'byon na dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes pas mgo bo khos shig ces dmod pa bor ba'i mkha' 'gro'i srog sngags yin/ phyag rgya ni/ lus skyil krung bshig la tsog pur 'dug pas rkang pa g.yon pa'i mtheb chen gyis g.yas pa'i mthe bong mnan pa rus sbal gyi 'dug stangs dang*/ lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bong gnyis thur du brkyangs pa lto sbyar/ mdzub mo'i rtse gnyis phan tshun 'khyud/ gung mo gnyis kyang rtse sbyar/ srin lag gnyis dang mthe'u chung gnyis so sor brkyangs te 'bar ba ltar byas pa 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'am/ saṃ bu ṭa las ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i phyag rgya zhes gsungs pa de nyid g.yon ngos nas rim bzhin bteg la/ mig g.yon skor du gyen du ldog pa'i lta stangs dang bcas phyag rgya dpral ba'i thad du g.yon du lan gsum bskor/ ting nge 'dzin ni/ rang lhar gsal ba'i thugaṃs kaṃ'i saṃ boṃn bam̐ yig las 'od zer dmar po bun long gis 'phros/ smin mtshams nas phyir byung*/ rtse mo lcags kyu'i dbyibs can grangs med par gyur pa rnams steng 'og bar gsum phyogs thams cad du khyab par 'phros/ pho nya gsum gyi rnal 'byor ma thams cad 'gro ba rnal 'byor mar gyur pa bsdu ba'ang 'dir 'dus so// mchan/ la phog ste/ de rnams steng nas byon pa ni kha char bu yug 'tshubs pa lta bu/ 'og nas byon pa ni dbyar gyi sa rlangs rdol ba lta bu/ bar nas byon pa ni dge 'dun mang po chos 'khor la 'du ba ltar 'ur 'ur thib thib byon/ de thams cad 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub/ me tog gi char 'bebs/ snyan pa'i glu dbyangs rol mo dang bcas byon par bsams la/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi g.yas pa'i mdzub mos g.yon pa'i mthe'u chung gi steng nas 'khyud pa lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bya zhing*/

dzaḥzhes brjod pas gcig la gcig thim nas rang gi spyi bor byon par bsam/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis g.yas pa steng du byas nas rgyab sprad pa zhags pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas spyi bo'i de 'od dmar por zhu nas rang la sib kyis thim par bsam/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kha gyen du bstan pa'i mdzub mo dang*/ mthe'u chung phan tshun so sor 'khyud pa lcags sgrog gi phyag rgya dang bcas/ bam̐ zhes brjod pas snying ga'i sa bon la chu la chu bzhag pa ltar dbyer med ro gcig tu 'dres par bsam/ mthe bong nang du byas pa'i rdo rje khu tshur bsdams te g.yon pa'i chang mgor g.yas pa'i chang rting bzhag pa snying gar byas la/ hoḥzhes brjod pas gnyis med ye shes kyi dbang du gyur te byang chub snying po'i bar du mi 'bral bar dgyes bzhin du bzhugs par bsam/ tshar lugs la lag gnyis padma gar skor gyi tshul du se gol lan gnyis nang du gtogs pa tsam las mi mdzad kyang*/ gong bzhin rgyud sde spyi ltar byed pa legs so gsungs/ ༈ /de nas gnyis pa lus dkyil gsal gdab pa ni/ zhal gnyis ma'i rdzogs rim du sngags kyis de nyid 'grub par gsungs pa 'dir blangs pa'i thun mong ba zhig dang*/ grub chen nā ro'i slob bshad snyan brgyud thun mong ma yin pa gnyis su yod pa las/ skabs 'dir zhal shes gsum pa lus dkyil thun mong ma yin pa rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras la snyan brgyud kho nar bzhugs shing*/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang gis kun spangs rdo rings pa chen por stsal ba nas bzung slob ma chig brgyud kho na las/ gzhan dag gis mtshan tsam thos pa'i yul ma yin kyang*/ mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub sogs kyis bskyed rdzogs kyi khrid rdzogs par 'debs dus slob ma sum tshan du bcad de gnang ba las spyir 'bebs pa mi mdzad pa'i bka' rgya can te/ de lta bu'i lus dkyil 'di nyid ni sgrub pa po'i lus la gnad du bsnun bya yul sum cu so bdun rtsa khams kyi yi ger tshang bar gnas pa/

de thams cad kyi nus pa snying ga'i rtsa khams la tshang ba ste/ lte ba'i khams dmar po la nang gi phag mo'am/ dpyid dang thig le'i ya gyal ti la ka'i sgras bstan pa de nyid snying gar bam̐ yig gi rnam par gnas pa dang*/ 'byung bzhi'i khams 'babs pa'i rtsa bzhi'i ngo bo bam̐ gyi cha shas ya ra la wa bzhi dang*/ dza landhā ra la sogs pa'i yul nyer bzhi'i bdag nyid can gyi spyi gtsug la sogs pa'i rtsa nyer bzhi dang*/ der rgyu ba'i rlung dang khams dpa' mo'i ngo bor gnas pa rnams sngags phreng du gnas te/ rgyu de dag la rkyen dbang dus su mar me sbyin pa sogs kyi brda thabs kyis ye shes pa phab cing*/ gsang dbang gi skabs su lha'i bdud rtsis lus kyi rtsa rlung thig le rnams byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ skabs 'dir ye shes pa bcug pas rkyen byas te 'dir snying ga'i rtsa thig rlung gsum lus dkyil gyi lhar bsgoms pas/ lus kyi rtsa stong phrag bdun cu rtsa gnyis su las rlung dgu brgya phrag re rgyu ba rim gyis 'gags te/ sa dang po nas bcu gnyis pa'i bar gyi rtogs pa myur ba nyid du mngon du 'gyur bar byed pa dang*/ nang gi rten 'brel stobs su gyur pas/ de'i dbang gis phyi'i gnas yul gyi mkha' 'gro ma thams cad dbang du 'du zhing*/ de dag gis lam gyi grogs mdzad pa dang*/ rgyud byin gyis rlob par mdzad pa sogs gsang chen lam gyi zab gnad mthar thug pa yin gsungs/ de bas na bam̐ gyi srog dang cha shas ni lte ba'i dmar cha dang snying ga'i rtsa 'dab sum skor ma sogs bzhi dang*/ dbu ma khams dang bcas pa'i rang bzhin du mos/ skra mtshams sogs yul nyer bzhi dang*/ kha sogs sgo brgyad de so gnyis kyi rtsa khams kyi ngo bo yig 'bru so gnyis dmigs pa gtad pa yin te/ de las gzhan du kha cig gnas de dang de'i rtsa khams las rang 'dra chad nas bam̐ yig sogs la thim par bsam zhes bshad kyang de 'dra'i gu dogs mi dgos so// de lta bu'i lus dkyil bsgom tshul ni/

de'ang bam̐ yig 'di rnal 'byor ma lngar bskyed zer ba tsam las/ rgyu mtshan yang dag 'chad shes pa nyung bas/ cung zad bshad na/ e wam̐ gzugs sgrub kyi tshe/ mtshan brjod las/ stong pa chen po yi ge lnga// zhes a i u ṛ l̥ lnga po 'dir stong chen yi ge zhes bya ba yin pas/ de lnga ka 'dus pas bam̐ yig grub ste/ de'am sgra mdo las/ i ya'o// u wa'o// ṛ ra'o// l̥ la'o// zhes pas rim pa ltar i u ṛ l̥ bzhi po ya ra la wa bzhir lus 'gyur zhing*/ de nas srog gi a thung gri gug gi so lta bu dbus su gzhag 'di mchan nang la brda yig bya gzugs zhig 'dug raṃ dbyug pa'i rnam pa g.yon du gzhag /laṃ tsheg drag lta bu steng du gzhag /waṃ thong gug lta bu de'i 'og tu gzhag /yaṃ nya mig lta bu steng du gzhag pas/ wartu la'i yi ge'i bam̐ grub ste/ de so sor phral nas a thung srog gi yi ge las gtso mo dang*/ cha shas ya ra la wa bzhi las rnal 'byor ma bzhir bskyed pa yin pas/ rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs kar chos 'byung zla ba sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa gsal btab la/ yeṃ sheṃs pa bcugaṃ paṃ'i rkyen gyis bam̐ yig de nyid gzi brjid cher gyur te lus kyi nang thams cad gsal bar byas/ bam̐ yig de nyid 'od du zhu ste a ya ra la wa lngar gyur pa srog gi a thung dmar po dbus su bzhag la gsal gdab/ ya ljang gu rlung gi rlung rtsa'i ngo bo g.yon du bzhag ra dmar po me rlung gi rtsa'i ngo bo rgyab tu bzhag la ser po sa rlung gi rtsa'i ngo bo g.yas su bzhag wa dkar po chu rlung gi rtsa'i ngo bo mdun du bzhag ste/ dbus kyi a thung yig ngo mdun phyogs dang*/ gzhan bzhi'i yig ngo a la blta ba/ thams cad 'grengs stabs su yod par bsam/ slob bshad pa kha cig tshar chen rin po ches a thung ya ra la wa bzhi'i ngo bo rnal 'byor ma lnga/ zhes gsungs pa drangs nas/ 'od zhu byas te de las bskyed pa mi 'thad pa'i phyogs su mdzad kyang skyon med gsungs/

de nas dbus kyi srog gi yi ge a thung dang rtsa dbu ma gcig 'dus kyi ngo bo rdo rje rnal 'byaur ma dmar mo mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam/ 'jigs dus kyi gdan la bzhugs shing pad nyi med pa/ gzhan rgyan cha lugs sogs phyi'i rnal 'byor ma dang 'dra ba zhal mdun bstan/ phyogs kyi ya ra la wa bzhi yongs su gyur pa las/ shar du wa las rnal 'byor ma dkar mo/ byang du ya las rnal 'byor ma ljang gu/ nub tu ra las rnal 'byor ma dmar mo/ lhor la las rnal 'byor ma ser mo ste snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi'i ngo bo/ rgyan cha lugs sogs gtso mo dang 'dra ba/ che chung mtheb sor phyed tsam pa/ zhal gtso mo la phyogs par bsgom/ 'dir bdag gi bla ma mkhyen brtse'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa'i bskyed rdzogs mkha' spyod bgrod pa'i gsang lam las/ shar nas brtsams te g.yon skor gyis bam̐ yig gi cha shas ya ra la wa bzhi'i ngo bo snying po'i rnal 'byor ma dkar ljang dmar ser bzhi/ zhes gsungs kyang*/ yang des mdzad pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i lhan thabs las byang nas g.yon skor ljang dmar ser dang dkar/ zhes gsungs pa nyid skabs don yin la/ snga ma dgongs pa can no// de nas zla gdan gyi steng gi mtha' skor gyi kā li so gnyis sam/ sngar bshad pa ltar gyi mtshan dpe mtshon pa'i oṃ gsum ma'i yig 'bru rnams rnal 'byor ma dmar mo rgyan cha lugs gtso mo dang 'dra ba so gnyis zhal nang du gzigs par bsgom/ des ni rtsa dpa' mo

24 dang*/ khams kha ṭwāṃ ga 24 'i rnam par bskyed pas bde mchog gi sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo'i lha rnams mtshon pa yin la/ de ltar bsgoms pas rlung sems dbu mar 'dus te rdzogs rim gyi zab gnad bskyed rim du tshang zhing*/ de'ang 'khor lo bde mchog gi lha thams cad lus dkyil 'dir tshang tshul ni/ dbus kyi rnal 'byor ma dmar mo ni phag mo dang*/ kha ṭwāṃ ga he ru ka ste yab yum gnyis med dpyid dang thig le'i ngo bo dang*/ phyogs kyi rnal 'byor ma dkar ser dmar ljang bzhi ni mkha' 'gro ma sogs snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhi ste 'byung bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba'i rtsa 'dab bzhi'i ngo bo dang*/ mtha' skor gyi rnal 'byor ma so gnyis ni rab gtum ma sogs thugs kyi dpa' mo brgyad/ sa srung ma sogs gsung gi dpa' mo brgyad/ 'khor lo'i shugs can ma la sogs pa'i sku'i dpa' mo brgyad de dpa' mo nyer bzhi ste skra mtshams la sogs pa'i rtsa nyer bzhi dang*/ de rnams kyi 'chang rgyu'i kha ṭwāṃ ga dpa' bo nyer bzhi ste rtsa nang gi khams kyi ngo bo dang*/ khwa gdong ma sogs sgo ma bzhi/ gshin rje brtan ma sogs mtshams ma bzhi ste sgo mtshams ma brgyad po ni kha la sogs pa'i dbang po'i sgo brgyad kyi rtsa'i ngo bo ste/ de ltar shes par bya zhing*/ rang lus rtsa khams kyi ngo bo las lha de dang der shar ba nges par bya zhing nga rgyal dang gsal snang bya'o gsungs/ ༈ /gsum pa go cha bgo ba ni/ kha cig ye shes pa gzhug zin ma thag yo ga shuddha'i sngags rgya byed par bshad kyang*/ gnas gsar ba dang bdag gi bla mas 'dir bya bar gsungs pas/ pad skor sngon du 'gro bas 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsogs brjod cing rang nyid 'bras dus kyi rnal 'byor ma dang*/ lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad rtsa khams gnas su dag pa'i rang bzhin du nga rgyal brtan po byas la tha mal gyi 'du shes spangs/

sngags don ni/ chos thams cad shin tu dag pa'i rnal 'byor ma de nga'o// zhes pa ste/ de'ang*/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa// rnal 'byor de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs// zhes pa ltar 'khor 'das snod bcud thams cad thabaṃs sheṃs gnyiṃs kyi rang bzhin las ma 'das pa'i don yin gsungs/ de nas rang dang lus dkyil gyi lha thams cad kyi lte ba 1 / snying ga 2 kha ste lce'i steng 3 / dpral ba ste spyan dbus ma'i gong*/ 4 spyi gtsug ste skra mtshams nas gyen du sor bzhi'i thad/ 5 yan lag dpung mgo gnyis/ lag pa'i mkhrig ma gnyis/ dpyi gnyis/ bol tshigs gnyis te tshigs 6 chen brgyad rnams su zla dkyil chung ngu re sku gzugs dang dbyer med pa chu nang du zla ba'i gzugs shar ba ltar gyen langs skya 'khyil bar bsam/ phyi rol du rgyan btags pa lta bu dang*/ nang du sngags 'khor gyi gdan bkod pa lta bu ni min no gsungs/ zla gdan de dag gi ngos su/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo'i ngo bo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma'i ngo bo/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma'i ngo bo/ dpral bar hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma'i ngo bo/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma'i ngo bo/ tshigs chen brgyad la phaṭa phaṭa dud ka tsaṇḍi ka'i ngo bo/ yig 'bru rnams zla ba'i ngos la rgyab brten sbreng tshar me long du gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar bsam mo gsungs/ skabs 'dir go cha bgo ba ni/ dper na shing gnyis gzer gyis bsdoms te mi 'bral mi 'phyugs par byed pa dang mtshungs par dam ye dang rang dang lus dkyil gyi lha dbyer med bcing bar bya ba'i phyir skabs 'dir 'thad gsungs/ mchan/ ༈ /bzhi pa de ltar bsgom bya'i don la thos bsam gyi sgro 'dogs bcad nas bcad don nyams su blangs pa sems 'dzin bya ba'i rim pa la/ spyi'i sems 'dzin dang*/ bye brag gi sems 'dzin gnyis/

dang po la nga rgyal la sems 'dzin pa dang*/ rnam pa la gsal snang bsgom pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ bdag nyid tha mal pa gtan nas ma yin te bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa 'bras dus kyi rdo rje rnal 'byor ma de dngos rang yin snyam du nga rgyal ci nus bskyed cing bskyed rim la gsal snang las nga rgyal gtso che bar gsungs/ gnyis pa ni/ nga rgyal de ga'i ngang las/ rang rnal 'byor ma'i sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis gri thod 'dzin pa/ 'jigs dus kyi gdan la brkyang bskum tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ sku la rus pa'i rgyan cha khrol le ba/ ye shes kyi me'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'ol spyi tsam la gsal snang thon par sems 'dzin/ gnyis pa bye brag gi sems 'dzin la/ rgyan med la sems 'dzin pa dang*/ rgyan can la sems 'dzin pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ spyan dbus mar sems 'dzin pa ste/ rang gi dpral bar spyan dbus ma dbus nag pa/ mtha' skya ba/ spyan rtsa dmar shig ge ba/ spyan g.yon pa gyen du langs pa lta bu/ dbus sbom zhing mjug ma ring ba/ de'i 'gram du smin ma nag khyug ge bar gsal gdab cing*/ mi gsal na khyad par de dag ngag tu brjod cing gsal gdab/ des kyang ma gsal na de lta bu'i ri mo bris te mdun du bzhag la blta ba'am/ de nyid rang gi dpral bar sbyar la me long ngam/ ngo shel sogs su bltas la bsgom/ de gsal zhing brtan pa na/ spyan gnyis po khyad chos gong dang 'dra ba/ smin mtshams kyi dbus su gnyer ma'i ri mo cung zad dod tsam dang*/ g.yas g.yon du de las che tsam re yod pa/ de nas rim bzhin shangs kyi rtsa ba phra zhing rtse mo gzengs mtho la mdzes pa/ shangs bug dmar sang nge ba/ zhal mchu sgros legs shing mchu bim ba ltar dmar ba/ de nang tshems phreng bzhi bcu mu tig gi phreng ba ltar dkar zhing thags bzang ba/ mche ba cung zad 'bur ba/ zhal cung zad gdangs pa he byas pa lta bu/ snyan shal ring zhing mdzes pa snyan gshog rgyas pa/

phrag pa gnyis su kyong kyong med pas thal gong rgyas pa phyag gnyis bye ru'i lcug phran ltar byin gyis phra zhing mdzes pa/ nu 'bur mtho la rab tu rgyas shing bar dog pa/ mthong ba tsam gyis bde ba bskyed pa/ sku sked phra la grims pa/ brla sogs sku smad kyi cha shas cher rgyas pa/ chu 'dzin snum zhing sdug pa rus sbal gyi rgyab ltar mkhrang ba/ phyag zhabs kyi mthil padma'i 'dab ma ltar 'jam zhing mnyen la/ sor mo rnams drwa bas 'brel zhing mthil bzhir 'khor lo'i ri mo bkra ba/ zhabs mthil mnyam zhing long bu mi mngon pa/ dbu skra gnag snum nyag ma re re nas sil bur grol bas sku sked yan chad khebs pa rnams la rim bzhin gsal snang brtan po ma byung bar du sems 'dzin/ gnyis pa ni/ de la sems brtan pa na spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs so gnyis pa dkar po/ lte bar rigs bdag rnam snang*/ rigs lnga'i dbu rgyan dang skra ching*/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ phyag zhabs kyi gdu bu/ ska rags/ 'og pags/ do shal/ phyag mtshan/ gri gug thod khrag kha ṭwāṃ ga 'jigs byed dang dus mtshan pad nyi'i gdan/ sku'i 'od zer me ri dang bcas pa rnams gong du bshad pa ltar so sor gsal snang brtan por sems 'dzin/ de ltar lus dkyil rnams la'ang sems 'dzin gtong ste/ rnal 'byor ma re re'ang zhib par spyan dkar nag tshun chad gsal bar sems gzung*/ de dag gi skabs su gsal na gsal te 'phro gcad/ mi gsal na mi gsal te 'phro gcad pa ni ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa'i dug gam rnam rtog gi dug dbyung ba zhes bya gsungs/ res rgyan can dang*/ res rgyan med/ res rigs bdag nas pad gdan bar/ res de las ldog res phyi'i me ri nas nang gi rnal 'byor ma'i bar/ res de las ldog ste sems gzung*/ res phyi'i rnal 'byor ma yungs 'bru tsam gyi nang du lus dkyil gyi lha tshogs ri rab tsam bsgom pa/ dper na khab mig nang nas ri chen po mthong ba lta bur bsgom/

res phyi'i rnal 'byor ma ri rab tsam gyi nang du lus dkyil gyi lha tshogs yungs 'bru tsam bsgom ste dmigs pa'i rtsal sna tshogs sbyang*/ res rang nyid rnal 'byor mar gsal ba dang lus dkyil kyi lha tshogs bcas rgya je che je cher nam mkha'i khyon gang bar bsam/ res 'ga' rang rnal 'byor ma dang lus dkyil bcas je chung je chung rdul phran lta bur bsam ste/ phyi'i rnal 'byor ma sran chen tsam gyi nang du lus dkyil gyi lha tshogs spus bris pa lta bur bsgom pa ste phra ba la sems 'dzin/ de dag thams cad kyang rgyan can rgyan med phyi nang gi lha so sor dmigs te gsal 'debs/ sems 'dzin gang gtong kyang gnas cha brtan po 'ong du re nas rgyun mthud na rnam rtog gzhan gyis bar gcod cing*/ de 'dra la goms na rjes su dmigs pa nam gtad res kyi tshe rnam rtog 'og 'gyu shar te lang shor du thal zhing*/ gsal por ma byung kyang gsal snang 'ong du re nas yun bskyangs na shes pa 'thums te bying bying por rgya 'byams su 'gro bas myur du rang dbang ba'i tshul gyis 'phro gcad/ gsal po zhig shar nas brtan na/ da res gsal brtan byung bas 'di yun bskyangs dgos snyam pas u tshugs byas na/ bying rgod nam skyes mi tshor bas bar du gcod pas 'phro gcad kyin bsgom/ de la ched du mi bsam par rang so 'dzin cing ma yengs tsam gyi ngang du rang babs su ngal bso/ yang rtse gcig tu rig pa bsgrims nas rig pa gsal ba dang sngar ltar rang babs su glod la bsgoms pas res 'jog tu goms par byed/ gong ltar thog mar yid dmigs rlung gsum hril gyis bsgrims la dmigs pa gtad/ bar du shes pa khong lhod kyis cung zad mnyam par gzhag bying rgod byung ngam ma byung gi dran shes tur re bya/ de ltar byas pas gsal cha dang gnas cha thams cad brten zhing yun je ring du 'gro/ dmigs pa la brtan pa thob pa'i rtags snang phyogs kyi ngo bo nyid dang*/

stong phyogs kyi ngo bo nyid dang*/ zung 'jug gi ngo bo nyid gsum du yod pa las/ dang po ni/ dper na spyan dbus ma lta bur sems bzung bas ji ltar bsgom pa'i spyan de lta bu rang gi dpral bar mig gis mthong rgyu dang*/ lag pas reg rgyu yod pa snyam byed pa dang*/ dpral ba na lhang lhang ba za ba sbrid pa sogs 'byung*/ gnyis pa ni bsgom pa'i spyan mi gsal kyang mthar kun rtog rags pa thams cad ched du bkag pa ma yin par rang 'gags su song nas/ rang med pa lta bur snang ba stong cham mer gnas pa 'byung ste/ de ni stong nyid rtogs pa'i lta bar mi 'gro yang de la brten nas rim bzhin bsgoms pas/ rnam par mi rtog pa'i stong nyid rtogs pa'i nyer len du 'gyur/ gsum pa ni/ dmigs pa 'dzin pa'i tshe glo bur du smig rgyu dang*/ du ba dang*/ me khyer dang*/ nam mkha' nas re khā nag po thur du brkyangs pa lta bu dang*/ sgra gcan gyi lus shin tu 'jigs pa ril po'am/ phyed sogs 'od gsal gyi rtags rnams rim gyis 'char bar 'gyur ro gsungs/ kha cig lus dkyil bsgoms pa'i mthar/ ye shes pa dgug bstim bya ba dang*/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab mchod bstod sogs sbyor ba snang yang*/ rang lugs la de 'dra mi dgos gsungs/ ༈ /lnga pa bzlas 9 pa'i rnal 'byor la/ ngag bzlas dang*/ yid bzlas gnyis las/ dang po la/ sngags bzla ba'i dgos pa/ phreng ba'i de nyid/ phreng chog bzla tshul dngos dang bzhi/ dang po ni/ gnad dang ldan pas gsang sngags bzlas brjod byas pa'i mthus lha'i thugs rgyud rang dbang med par bskul nas dngos grub myur du ster bar byed pa yin no// gnyis pa ni/ las so so la bsngags pa'i phreng ba mi 'dra bar bshad pa mang yang*/ skabs 'dir rgyud dang bla ma'i dgongs don ltar/ mi thod gsar ba'i phreng ba sngar gzhan gyi longs ma spyad pa/ grangs brgya dang bcu gcig tu byas pas kha skong yang zhar la 'gro ba'i dgos pa yod/

phreng thag grong pa'i chos kyi ma gos pa'i bu mos bkal ba'i ras bal sogs kyi srad bu dgu bsgril du byas pas sprul sku dang nye sras mtshon pa/ mdo 'dzin nyis brtsegs kyis longs sku dang chos sku mtshon pa 'du bya'o// gsum pa ni/ phreng ba lag pa g.yon par bzhag pa g.yas pas dgab/ aṃ mṛṃ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stongaṃ pa'i ngang las rang gi lag pa g.yon pa paṃ las padma dmar po 'dab ma lnga pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du a yig dkar po'i mthar ā li dkar po'i phreng ba g.yon skor dang*/ lag pa g.yas pa hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ yig dmar po mthar kā li dmar po'i phreng ba g.yon skor du 'khod par bsam/ phreng ba'i steng du sum̐ dkar po/ de'i steng du hūm̐ sngon po/ de'i steng du āḥdamar po/ de'i steng du oṃ dkar po rnams brtsegs mar gnas par bsam/ skad cig gis phreng thag hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' nye sras brgyad dang bcas pa/ phreng rdog rnams āḥlas dgra bcom pa/ mdo 'dzin 'og ma oṃ las gzugs kyi sku/ steng ma hūm̐ las chos kyi sku rnams kyi ngo bor gyur par bsams la/ oṃ pā de pā de ma hā dzñā na sarba buddha mā yaṃ bha we ta hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho ā khaṃ swā hā/ zhes brgya rtsa brgyad bzla/ rang gi thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad ā li kā li'i rnam par spyan drangs te phreng ba la thim/ lag pa gnyis thabs shes kyi rnam par sbyor zhing bsrubs pa'i yi ge rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa phreng bar thim par mos la 'phur 'phur bya zhing sngags kyi has gdab/ yang na phreng ba padma gar dbang du bskyed kyang chog mod/ snga ma nyid legs la/ 'di nyid rgyun du ma lcogs na/ oṃ gsum ma lan gsum tsam dang*/

pā de sogs lan gsum/ spyir rgyug gi phreng sngags ru tsi ra ma ṇi sogs lan bdun bzlas nas has btab pas chog gsungs/ bgrang tshul ni/ lha dbang du bsdu ba'i gnad kyis lag pa g.yon pa'i gung mo'i steng du phreng ba bzhag pa mthe bong lcags kyu'i tshul gyis dngos grub myur du 'gugs pa'i bsam pas lte ba'i thad du bgrangs la/ g.yas mnyam gzhag gis phreng ba la bsten pa'i rnam par bya'o gsungs/ ༈ /bzhi pa bzla tshul dngos la'ang bkod pa'i bzlas pa dang*/ spro bsdu'i bzlas pa gnyis las/ dang po la/ rang gi snying ga'i lus dkyil gyi gtso mo'i thugs kar chos 'byung zla ba bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas sngar bshad pa ltar legs par gsal gdab cing*/ yig 'bru rnams la rim par sems gtad nas klog pa'i tshul du sngags bzla'o// gnyis pa la gzhan don don byed dang*/ bdag don don byed kyi dmigs pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ lus dkyil gyi gtso mo'i thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng las 'od zer dmar po dpag tu med pa 'phros/ lus dkyil gyi gtso mo'i sku'i nang thams cad gsal bar byas/ phyir 'phros/ lus dkyil gyi lha so drug gi sku'i phyi nang thams cad gsal bar byas/ yang phyir 'phros/ rang nyid phyi'i rnal 'byor ma'i sku'i nang thams cad 'od kyi snang bas gsal bar byas/ rang lus las kyang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas phyir 'phros/ phyogs bcur song ste rigs drug bar do dang bcas pa'i sems can thams cad la phog pas/ gser 'gyur gyi rtsis lcags la reg pa ltar de rnams kyi rgyud kyi sdig sgrib bag chags phung po dang bcas pa gtan nas sbyangs te thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur lam gyis gyur/ de thams cad kyi zhal nas kyang bung ba tshang zhig pa'i tshul du sngags sgra di ri ri sgrogs par bsams la sngags bzla'o// gnyis pa ni/ yang rang gi snying ga'i lus dkyil gyi gtso mo'i thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las 'od zer dmar po dpag med bun long nger 'phros/

lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ phyir 'phros pas 'od zer re re'i sne mor phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa thogs pa'i lha mo grangs med pa spros te/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa la kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin gyis legs par mchod cing mnyes par byas/ de rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub thams cad sku phyag rgya/ gsung yig 'bru/ thugs phyag mtshan/ 'od phung dmar po la sogs pa'i rnam par spyan drangs/ snying ga'i lus dkyil gyi gtso mo'i thugs ka'i bam̐ la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la sngags bzla'o gsungs/ de'ang res lha sku snang la rang bzhin med par gsal ba la sems gtad/ res sku'i cha shas la sems 'dzin/ res sngags yig 'bru dang de'i sgra la sems 'dzin/ res gnas lugs brjod bral gyi ngang du ngal bso/ res bdag don gyi dmigs pa/ res gzhan don gyi dmigs pa sogs la rtsal sbyang zhing*/ bzla bya'i sngags kyang*/ bde mchog rtsa brgyud las/ 'di las shin tu mchog gyur pa// 'jig rten gsum na ci yang med// sogs nas/ bklags pas 'di dag thams cad 'grub// ces sogs rdo rje 'chang rang nyid kyis rgya cher bsngags pa jo bo nā ro ta pa'i man ngag brgyud ldan dam pa'i zhal lung las 'ong ba rgyal chen ind+ra bhū ti'i lugs kyi phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i gzhung ltar mdzad pa'i oṃ gsum ma 'di ni/ phag mo skor gsum gyi sngags rnams gcig tu bsdus pa dang*/ phag mo lha so bdun ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs yi ge'i gzugs su shar ba sogs khyad chos mtha' yas pa dang ldan pas/ 'di nyid kyang*/ rgyud las/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// mkha' 'gro ma dang rang gtso mo// mngon sum du ni bya ba'i phyir// sngags ni snyan gsan dbab par brjod// dper na skyes bu la la zhig /skad kyi nga ros 'bod pa na// thos pa tsam gyis 'ong bar 'gyur// de bzhin skad cig sangs rgyas gshegs// sngags ma bzlas par mi 'grub cing*// sbyin sreg ma byas 'bras mi 'byin// zhes lha la 'bod pa lta bu ni sngags nyid yin la/

bzla tshul yang rgyud las/ bzlas brjod byed tshe mi myur mi dal zhing*// sgra cher ma yin ha cang chung bas min// smra bzhin ma yin gzhan du g.yeng bas min// gug skyed klad kor tsheg rnams nyams pas min// zhes pa ltar bzlas pa'i skyon brgyad dang bral bas yid gzhan du ma yengs par sngags sgra rang gi phrag gong na thos tsam du gang mang bzla zhing*/ rgyun du ni sngar byin rlabs kyi skabs ji tsam dam bcas pa nyung mthar byas te bzla/ spyir dam bcas pa'i bslab bya kun dang*/ khyad par sngags kyi rdo rje slob dpon las ji ltar khas blangs shing dam bcas pa'i dam tshig phra mo zhig nyams pas kyang mngon mtho nges legs kyi srog stong bar nges pas zhe rus drag po bya zhing*/ las dang po par lam gzhan gang las kyang ngag bzlas nyid gtso che ba la/ gzhan yang sdom 'byung las/ gzhan du mi 'phro'i sems kyis ni// de lta'i tshul gyis bzlas par bya// yul gzhan blo ni 'phro ba yis// bskal par bzlas kyang 'bras mi 'byin// zhes sems rgya yan du yengs shing rnam rtog rgya 'byams kyi ngang nas grangs ji ltar mang po zhig song kyang 'bras bu gtan nas mi 'byin pas gzab par bya'o gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa 'gog pa'i bzlas pa'am/ yid bzlas ni/ gnas der thal 'tshubs med cing*/ lto 'grangs ltogs ran pa'i dus su bya ste/ thog mar ngag bzlas ji tsam ran pa zin nas// lus rdo rje'i skyil krung bsam gtan gyi lus gnad drang ba'i mu nas/ rlung ro dgu phrugs su bsal dgos pas/ de'ang rang gi snying ga'i lus dkyil gyi rnal 'byaur ma bzhi gtso mo la thim/ gtso mo'ang skad cig gis bam̐ yig tu gnas gyur/ mtha' skor gyi rnal 'byor ma so gnyis kyang re re nas sdebs su 'od du zhu ste oṃ gsum ma'i sngags phreng du gyur/ de lta bu'i chos 'byung zla ba bam̐ yig sngags phreng bcas kyang phra mo spus bris pa ltar bsam/ de nas rang lhar gsal ba'i lus dbus drang po cung zad sgal tshigs la nye bar rtsa dbu ma mda' smyug tsam mar sne bha ga dang khad chad/

yar sne spyi bo nas gug ste smin mtshams su zug pa'i bu ga ha re yod pa/ kha dog dmar la snum pa rgya skyegs kyi khu ba lta bu/ gsal zhing dwangs pa til mar gyi mar me lta bu/ 'jam la mnyen pa padma'i 'dab ma lta bu/ drang zhing 'drongs pa chu shing gi sdong po lta bu ste khyad chos bzhi ldan/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar mo/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar mo ste gnyis ka'i yar sne spyi bo nas mar sba gug pa ltar gug ste sna bug gnyis su bug pa har re ba/ mar sne dbu ma dang ring thung 'dra bar bsams la/ mig g.yon du lta stangs dang bcas sna bug g.yon nas rlung thog mtha' gnyis dal la/ bar du shugs drag pa zhig sangs kyis bus la/ rang rgyud kyi 'dod chags kyi rtog pa thams cad dmar la mog pa'i rnam pas rkyang ma'i lam nas rlung dang 'grogs te phyir thon/ dang por 'dom gang tsam/ de nas khang pa sogs kyi phyi rol tsam/ de nas je ring je ring stong gsum 'jig rten gyi khams kyang brgal nas song ste/ mthar dud sprin yal ba ltar dmigs med du song bar bsams la rlung phyi rol du rgyang ring du 'dzin/ rlung ro rdzogs par thon pa'i rtags su snying ga na kham kham pa 'byung*/ yang g.yon nas dal bus nang du brngubs la sna bug g.yas nas gong ltar phyir 'bud cing*/ ro ma'i lam nas zhe sdang gi rtog pa thams cad nag la mog pa'i rnam pas sbyangs pa'i dmigs pa gong ltar dang*/ yas sna gnyis ka nas dal bus nang du brngubs nas sna bug gnyis ka nas gong ltar phyir 'bud la/ dbu ma'i nang nas gti mug gi rtog pa thams cad dkar la mog pa'i rnam pas sbyangs pa'i dmigs pa gong ltar bya/ slar yang de 'dra lan gnyis te gsum bya ba ni rlung ro dgu phrugs su bsal ba yin la/ de dag gi skabs su chos 'byung zla ba sngags phreng bam̐ dang bcas pa ni snying ga'i thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du yod par bsam ste/ kha cig dang po rlung ro bsal nas/

bum can gzung ba'i tshe lus dkyil gdan bcas lte bar phab/ de nas lus dkyil sngags su bsgyur bar bshad kyang*/ 'di ltar byas pas dmigs pa stabs bde bar snang ngo*// de'ang bum can mang du 'dzin na rlung ro dgu phrugs su bsal zhing*/ lan gcig lan gnyis las mi 'dzin na rlung ro lan gsum bsal bas chog go gsungs/ de nas yid bzlas dngos la/ 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum dang bcas 'og rlung snyan gsan 'bebs pa'i tshul du gyen du lte 'og tsam gyi bar phyed 'then tsam byas/ steng rlung sa len ma'i tshul zhes/ lus bying drang po'i mur/ sa kha nas dngos po zhig yar 'degs pa lta bur mgo lus rgur tsam thog steng rlung sna bug gnyis ka nas 'jam por dal bus brngubs la/ rlung de 'ded byed kyi rnam par mchil ma sgra med pa zhig mid/ sgra bcas su mid na pho ba'i me drod la gnod pas spang gsungs/ dmigs pa steng rlung mchil ma dang bcas pa snying gar slebs pa dang mnyam du chos 'byung zla gdan bam̐ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa mar 'phul te lte ba'i thad du dbab/ de'ang chos 'byung phyi ma'i rtsa ba phra ba gsang gnas su zug cing*/ gdengs ka che ba lte ba'i phyogs su bstan par bsams te/ bde ba bskyed par 'dod na gsang gnas dang*/ mi rtog pa bskyed par 'dod na lte bar dbab/ ces gsungs kyang*/ phyag len la lte bar dbab par mdzad gsungs/ lus tshugs bcing drag pa ma yin par rang babs su glod/ steng rlung lte 'og tsam du tshir gyis mnan cing*/ 'og rlung rdzogs par 'then nas srog thur bsres la/ 'jam rlung bum pa can gzung*/ rang sems bam̐ yig la zhugs pa bzhin bya/ mtha'i sngags phreng g.yon skor du klog pa'i tshul du/ so dang mchu/ lce mi 'gul bar yid kyis sngags lan bdun nam/ lnga'am/ gsum sogs gang rung bzla/ rlung 'byongs pa'i tshad bum can gzung bzhin du yid bzlas sum cu tsam thub pa yin gsungs/ de nas rlung 'dzin mi thub pa 'dra na btsan thabs su mi 'dzin par 'og rlung 'then ne ba'i ngang nas/

sna sgo'i spu mi 'gul ba'i tshod kyi dal bus rang 'gros su nar gyis gtang*/ cung zad ngal bsos la/ yang 'dzin zhing yid bzlas bya/ 'dis mtshon rlung sbyong gi rigs kyi dmigs pa ma yengs pa'i brtan po med par dran rtogs sna tshogs su 'phror gzhug na khams 'dus sogs kyi gegs bskyed pa yin no gsungs/ yid bzlas 'di mtshan bcas kyi rdzogs rim yin pas na 'di la brten nas du ba la sogs pa'i rtags dang*/ 'phar g.yo zhes rtsa mdud grol ba'i rtags su lus la tshugs mi thub pa'i bde drod sogs 'byung ba yin no gsungs/ de nas mthar phreng ba thal mo sbyar ba'i bar du bzung la/ phyogaṃs baṃcu dus gsumaṃ gyi bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes 'dod don la gsol ba btab nas phreng ba mgo thog tu gzhag go ༈ /drug pa zhar byung gi rdzogs rim gnyis las/ rdzogs rim dang po la'ang dngos dang*/ yan lag gnyis/ dang po ni/ rlung bum pa can sngar ltar gzung thub na dang*/ ma thub kyang 'gal ba med cing*/ rang lhar gsal ba'i lte ba'i chos 'byung gi zur drug la mdun rgyab gnyis spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil ba dmar po mthong ba tsam gyis bde chen skyed nus pa zhig g.yon skor du phril li li shugs drag tu 'khor ba/ de'ang reg 'byar med par chos 'byung gi mu dang khad chad kyi bar snang la khyir ri ri 'khor bar bsam/ des bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes skye bar byed/ ༈ /de'i yan lag ni/ de dang dus mnyam du tshangs bug gi nang du dga' 'khyil dkar po sran ma 'bring po tsam zla ba ltar dkar ba g.yon skor du drag por 'khor bar bsams pas mi rtog pa bskyed/

rtog pa rags pa 'gags nas sems bying por song na dga' 'khyil de bam̐ la bsdus te rig pa ngar phyung*/ bha ga padma kha bye ba lta bu'i nang du dga' 'khyil dmar po sran 'bring tsam mtshal lcog la mas bris pa lta bu drod kyi rang bzhin can g.yon du shugs drag tu 'khor bar bsgoms pas bde ba bskyed par byed/ bde ba ha cang ches pas 'dzag gegs byung na dga' 'khyil de nyid bam̐ la thim par bsam/ de'ang chos 'byung zur gsum pas shes rab ma'i padma dang*/ steng gi dga' 'khyil bzhi re re la'ang 'khyil chung bzhi re yod pas kunda lta bu'i byang chub kyi sems las byung ba'i dga' bzhi'i ye shes bcu drug mtshon pa yin gsungs/ ༈ /zhar byung rdzogs rim gnyis pa ni/ chos 'byung sngags phreng sogs re zhig mi dmigs pa'i ngang*/ rlung bum pa can 'dzin pa'am ma bzung kyang rung la/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i sku snang stong gnyis su med pa/ dar dmar gyi gur phub pa lta bu'i dmar seng nge ba'i dbus drang por/ chos 'byung sngags phreng zla gdan sogs kyi ngo bo rtsa dbu ma gro sog che phyogs tsam kha dog dmar gsal khyad chos bzhi ldan mar sne gsang gnas su thug cing*/ yar sne tshangs bug nas sba gug pa ltar mar gug ste smin mtshams su bug pa ha rer yod par bsam/ dbu ma'i mas sner dga' 'khyil mtshal lcog la mas bris pa lta bu dmar po sran 'bring tsam g.yon skor du drag tu 'khor ba la sems gtad/ mthar dga' 'khyil dmar po de g.yon skor du 'khor bzhin par dbu ma'i nang brgyud yar dmar 'khyil li li snying ga'i bar du byung zhing 'khor bas snang ba thams cad bde ba'i rang bzhin du cham cham song bar bsam/ yang dbu ma'i nang gi yas sner smin mtshams su dga' 'khyil dkar po nas 'bru tsam zla ba ltar dkar ba g.yon skor du drag por 'khor ba la dmigs pa gtad cing*/ mthar dga' 'khyil dkar po de nyid g.yon skor du skya khyir ri ri 'khor bzhin/

dbu ma'i nang brgyud smin mtshams nas gyen du song*/ spyi bo nas mar babs te snying ga'i dga' 'khyil dmar po de'i steng du reg la ma 'byar bar g.yon skor du 'khor bas/ snang ba thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ngang du lhan lhan song bar bsam/ mthar dga' 'khyil dkar dmar gnyis ka snying thad kyi dbu ma'i nang du g.yon skor du drag tu 'khor bzhin pa la dmigs pa gtad pas/ khrugs kyis 'dres te dga' 'khyil dmar skya 'od kyi rang bzhin can gcig tu gyur pa g.yon skor du phril li li 'khor bzhin je chung je phrar gyur te/ dbu ma'i nang der rang yal la song bar bsams la brjod bral gyi ngang la gzhag 'di lam gyi gnad che shos 'da' ka ma'i nyams len yin pas dmigs pa gang gsal dang rgyun gang ring byed dgos gsungs/ des kyang sbyang gzhi rang nyid 'chi ba'i gnas skabs su lte bar ma las thob pa'i khams dmar po yod pa de nyid gnas 'phyugs te mas nas yar gyen du song ba la brten nas mched pa dmar lam pa dang*/ spyi gtsug tu pha las thob pa'i khams dkar po yod pa de nyid gnas 'phyugs te yas nas mar thur du babs pa la brten nas snang ba dkar lam pa dang*/ de gnyis snying gar 'dus pa'i bar du rnam shes 'thums pa la brten nas dran bcas dran med kyi nyer thob nag lam pa 'char bar 'gyur ba rnams sbyong byed dga' 'khyil dkar dmar yas mas 'dres pa dang*/ mthar brjod bral stong nyid la bzhag pa 'dis sbyangs pas/ sbyangs 'bras gzhi dus su nyer thob kyi rjes de ma thag gzhi'i 'od gsal 'char ba'i tshe ma pang du bu 'jug pa ltar 'od gsal ma bu 'dres nas/ 'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi sku mngon du 'gyur ba'i gnad kyi don khyad par can yin no gsungs/ a ho sngon bsags las kyi 'phro sad pas// gzhan la 'gram chu ldang mi dgos pa'i chos// rmad byung 'di 'dra rnyed pa bla ma'i drin// drin lan sgrub pa'i mchod pas gzhal bar smon/
༈ /bdun pa thun bsdu ba'i rim pa la bsam mi khyab

10 kyi rnal 'byor nyams su blang ba yin pas/ 'di la'ang thun mong ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ rang gi snyingaṃ gaṃ'i bam̐ṃ yig sngags phreng dang bcas pa laṃs 'od zer 'phroṃs pas khaṃms gsuṃm snod bcud thams cad la khyab/ de dag la 'od des reg pa tsam gyis lan tshwa chur bcug pa bzhin 'od du ltem ltem zhu/ de'ang nam mkha' mtha' yas/ rnam shes mtha' yas/ ci'ang med pa/ yod min med min te gzugs med skye mched mu bzhi snod bcud dang bcas pa 'od sngon po'i rnam pas rang gi lus kyi stod cha la thim/ gzugs khams gnas rigs bcu bdun te bsam gtan bzhi snod bcud dang bcas pa 'od dmar po'i rnam pas rang gi lus kyi bar gyi cha la thim/ 'dod khams ris drug ste ngan song gsum mi dang lha ma yin dang lnga/ rgyal chen ris bzhi/ 1 sum cu rtsa gsum/ 2 mtshe ma/ 3 dga' ldan/ 4 'phrul dga'/ 5 gzhan 'phrul dbang byed 6 de 'dod lha drug la gcig tu byas pa'i drug po snod bcud dang bcas pa 'od dkar po'i rnam pas rang gi lus kyi smad cha la thim/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba snying ga'i chos 'byung la/ de zla ba la/ de sngags phreng la/ de bam̐ yig la/ de'i khog pa mgo bo la/ de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la thim/ nā da'ang mi dmigs pa 'od gsal nam mkha' lta bu'i ngang du gyur par bsams la mnyam par gzhag de nas slaraṃ raṃng nyiṃd rdoṃ rjeṃ rnalaṃ 'byoraṃ maṃ phyag mtshan spangs pa'i rnam par bzhengs la go cha bgo ba sogs bya'o gsungs/ 'dis kyang 'chi ba chos skur 'khyer ba yin no// ༈ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i bsam mi khyab kyi rim pa ni/ rang rdo rje rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i sku sha khrag rus gsum las 'das pa 'ja' tshon lta bu'i lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma sba lcag tsam khyad chos bzhi dang ldan pa yas sne spyi bo nas mar gug ste spyan dbus ma'i thad du zug pa/

mar sne lte 'og sor bzhir chos 'byung dmar po sor bzhi pa gcig gi nang du zug pa/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dmar mo khrag rgyu lta bu tsha reg can/ dbu ma'i g.yon du rkyang ma dkar mo 'o grod lta bu gsher bag can/ ro rkyang gi phra sbom gro sog 'bring po'am mda' smyug tsam/ rtsa gsum reg la ma 'byar ba'i tshul gyis sum gshibs/ ro rkyang gi yas sne sngar ltar gug ste sna bug gnyis su zug pa/ mas sne lte 'og gi chos 'byung nang du rtsa gsum sbubs stong gcig tu gyur pa ste/ ro rkyang gnyis dbu ma las cung ring ba yar gug ste dbu ma'i mas sne'i nang du yar tshud pa ni dper na smyug sbug nang du gro sog gnyis btsud pa lta bur bsam/ rtsa gsum 'dzom pa'i mas sner lte ba'i bam̐ dang rang sems dbyer med kyi ngo bo rnal 'byor ma ril ma tsam mam gsal thebs na ji tsam chung ba bzang bas/ sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs sogs bdag bskyed ltar gsal gdab/ de'ang 'phar la khad pa/ 'phur la khad pa zhabs gnyis dbu ma'i nang gi ro rkyang gi mar sne gnyis la gtad pa de lta bu la rang sems zhugs pa bzhin du rlung phyir 'gro ba dang bstun rnal 'byor ma de'i thugs kar bam̐ yig bsams pa las chu las chu bur rdol ba ltar rnal 'byor ma rang 'dra yungs 'bru tsam zhig glog 'khyugs pa ltar chad de dbu gtsug brgyud nas song*/ g.yas ro ma'i nang nas dmar khyug ger yar song*/ gzung rtog dang ro ma'i rtsa lam sbyangs/ sna bug g.yas pa'i sgor byung*/ rlung gi ngo bo 'ja' gur chung ngu zhig gi dbus su bzhugs/ de las 'od zer mang po nyi ma'i zer phran ltar 'phros pa'i sne mor rnal 'byor ma rang 'dra dpag tu med pa byung ba phyogs bcur gshegs/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa thams cad la phyi nang gsang ba kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin ltar sprul pas mchod cing chos nyan/ ma dag pa'i zhing thams cad du'ang gshegs shing 'od dang bdud rtsi spros te snod thams cad chos 'byung gi gzhal yas khang dang*/

bcud thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur lam gyis bsgyur/ chos bshad sgrib pa sbyang bar byas/ slar sprul pa rnams dang snod bcud rnal 'byor mar gyur pa thams cad sna sgo'i rnal 'byor mar 'dus/ de nyid rlung nang du 'jug pa dang bstun sna bug g.yon nas zhugs te rkyang ma'i lam brgyud/ 'dzin rtog dang rkyang ma'i rtsa lam sbyangs te lte ba'i rnal 'byor ma la thim par bsams la rlung kha sbyor ci thub gzung*/ slar yang gong ltar spro ba dang bsdu ba sogs lan gsum lnga bdun nyer gcig sogs gang rigs bya ba ni rtsa lam sbyang ba yin la/ de nas rtsa gsum gyi sum mdo'i rnal 'byor ma de nyid mkha' spyod du gshegs par rings pas gar stabs ling ling bzhugs pa'i thugs ka'i bam̐ yig las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ sku lus kyi nang thams cad 'od dmar pos khrig mer gang*/ phyi'i rnal 'byor ma'i gdan rnams zhabs la thim/ zhabs sku'i rdza ma la thim/ mkha' spyod nas snyan pa'i glu dbyangs dang ḍā dril sogs kyis 'ur sgra chil chil bsgrags pas rkyen byas te/ lte ba'i rang sems rnal 'byor ma de nyid mkha' spyod du rings par chas te lte bar byon pas/ ro rkyang gi mas sna cha yig ltar gug pa nyis 'brelaṃ gyis zhabs la yar thim/ dbu ma spyi gtsug nas mar zug snying gar byon pas phyi'i rnal 'byor ma'i sku smad nang gi rnal 'byor ma la thim/ dbu ma spyi gtsug nas mar dang ro rkyang gnyis zhabs la yar thim ste je chung je chung du gyur/ mgrin par byon pas phyi'i rnal 'byor ma'i sku'i bar thams cad nang gi rnal 'byor ma'i skur thim/ dbu ma ro rkyang gong ltar thim zhing thung ngur song*/ spyi bor byon pas phyi'i sku stod dang rtsa gsum thams cad lhag med du nang gi rnal 'byor ma la thim/ de nas rnal 'byor ma de nyid yer gyis 'phags te mkha' la bya 'phur ba bzhin du/ sgra 'od rol mo'i bsu ba dang bcas te/

mkha' spyod dag pa'i zhing du yud kyis gshegs par bsams la/ de ga'i ngang der sems gsal stong zung 'jug gi ngang la bcas bcos med pa nam mkha' lta bur mnyam par 'jog slar yang 'od gsal de'i ngang nas nam mkha' las sprin ldang ba bzhin du rang sems rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur langs te bya thur du babs pa ltar sngar gyi gnas su byon pas phyi'i lus kyang sngar bzhin grub par bsam/ yang rtsa sogs gong ltar gsal btab la bskyar gyin bdun nam nyer gcig sogs sbyang bar bya'o// gal te 'di nyid kyi man ngag med pa'am/ yod kyang rgyun du dmigs pas ma 'chun na gong gi thun mong ba de byas pas 'thus shing*/ 'di lta bu ni/ rnal 'byor ma'i nyams khrid yan lag dang bcas pa yongs su ma rdzogs pa'i slob ma la gnang srol med cing*/ de lta bu'i slob mas kyang sgrub pa'i dam bca' spyod pa'i khas len gser gyi maṇḍal dang bcas te/ gsol ba nan tan du btab nas zhu zhing*/ de ma yin pa la mi sbyin pa yin la/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di bskyed rim la brten nas mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i lam gyi nying khu nang gi rnal 'byor ma'am/ rdzong pa rnams rnal 'byor ma'i 'pho chung zer/ ngor pa rnams rnal 'byor ma'i 'chi chung zer te/ dpal sa skya pa'i sngags 'chang mang po lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs pa'i yid ches byin rlabs kyi tshan kha gzhan las khyad par du 'phags pa yin pas brtson par rigs la/ 'di lus sems ya ma bral bar tshogs pa gcig tu 'dres nas 'pho ba yin pas 'pho rab tshe thung ba'i skyon yang med pa yin no gsungs/ ༈ /de nas thun mtshams su babs pa na/ lha'i nga rgyal gsal snang dang ldan pa'i sgo nas rang la go cha'i lha sngar bzhin bkod cing*/ de nas lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis phyogs g.yon skor du sdigs mdzub dang bcas se gol gtogs la sum bha ni la hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags zhes zer ba de brjod/

de'ang sumaṃ bhaṃ niṃ'i sngags tshan dang po kha dog nag po las shar dang steng du kha gdong ma nag mo gnyis/ sngags tshan gnyis pa gṛhṇa sogs kha dog ljang gu las byang du 'ug gdong ma ljang gu/ sngags tshan gsum pa gṛhṇa pā ya sogs kha dog dmar po las nub dang 'og tu khyi gdong ma dmar mo gnyis/ sngags tshan bzhi pa ā na ya sogs kha dog ser po las lhor phag gdong ma ser mo rnams bskyed/ yang mtshams g.yas skor du sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i se gol gtogs la/ sum bha ni sogs phyed sngo phyed ser ba las gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo g.yon ser ba shar lhor bskyed/ gṛhṇa sogs phyed ser phyed dmar ba las gshin rje pho nya mo g.yas ser g.yon dmar ba lho nub tu bskyed/ gṛhṇa pā ya sogs phyed dmar phyed ljang ba las gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar g.yon ljang ba nub byang du bskyed/ ā na ya sogs phyed ljang phyed sngo ba las gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang g.yon sngo ba byang shar du bskyed la/ rang gis sum bha ni dngos su lan gnyis brjod/ lha mo brgyad po'i mngon rtogs bde mchog lū hi pa ltar gsal btab la bar gcod bsrung ba'i las la brtson zhing bzhugs par bsam/ de dang dus mnyam du rang dang sgo mtshams ma de rnams kyi sku las spros pa'i 'od las rdo rje'i rwa ba dang drwa ba gur dang bla re/ de'i phyi rol du mda'i drwa ba/ de'i phyi rol du ye shes kyi me dpung rab tu 'bar zhing 'khrugs pa'i srung 'khor gyi phyi rol nas dpag tshad lnga brgya'i tshod tsam du bskor zhing cis kyang gzhom du med pa gdon bgegs nag phyogs 'byung po'i tshogs kyis bltar mi bzod par bsam pa kun rdzob dang*/ don dam par bgegs la sogs pa'i chos rnams rang bzhin med pa'i lta ba'i rgyas 'debs pa ni bla na med pa'i bsrung ba'o zhes gsungs/ ༈ /gong gi gnyis pa'i yan lag 11 spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor la/

dngos dang*/ rjes 'brel gnyis las/ dang po ni/ thun mtshams su rang rnal 'byor ma rgyan dang ldan zhing phyag mtshan spangs pa'i 'od kyi skur gsal yang yang btab la/ gzugs snang thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor mar bsam pa ni sku'i dga' ba ste chags sdang spang*/ sgrar grag pa thams cad oṃ gsum ma'i gdangs su bsam pa gsung gi dga' ba ste snyan mi snyan gyi dung ris mi 'byed/ yid kyi dran rtog gang shar yang rnal 'byor ma'i thugs bde stong dbyer med du ngo shes par byas la/ mi yengs par rang ngo la blta zhing bskyang ba thugs kyi dga' ba ste dgag sgrub mi bya/ bud med la g.yon nas bskor zhing*/ srog chags 'khrig pa mthong na lha yab yum du mos nas phyi ma'i mngal sgo sbyang ba sogs bya byed thams cad lam du 'khyer ba la bslab cing*/ thun mtshams su rnam rtog rgya 'byams su ma shor ba'i dran 'dzin brtan po shin tu nas gal che la/ de ltar byas pas sdig sgrib gsog pa dang dam tshig nyams pa'i go skabs nam yang mi 'ong zhing lam la bogs 'byin pa sogs dgos pa che bar yod/ de min thugs dam du mnyam gzhag mog mog po re byas nas/ rjes thob kun tu tha mal du lus na chos pa'i 'khyer so stor nas 'gro gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa rjes su 'brel ba la/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor/ phyi rol mchod pa bya ba/ gtor ma gtang ba/ sbyin sreg tshes bcu'i mchod pa dang lnga las/ dang po kha zas kyi rnal 'byor la rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ rgyas par na/ kha zas snod bcas lag pa g.yon par bzhag la g.yas pas dgab cing*/ bsang sbyang sngon du 'gro bas bdud rtsi ltar byin gyis brlab/ rang gi lte bar gtum mo'i me 'bar ba'i khrod na chos srung nor lha'i tshogs dang*/ snying gar bla ma yi dam dbyer med rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bzhugs par bsam/ lag g.yas dgang gzar dang*/ g.yon blugs gzar du mos shing*/ kha zas bsreg rdzas bdud rtsir mos la/

kha thab khung gi tshul du lce me 'bar ba ltar bsam/ de nas kha zas bza' ba'i tshe/ dwangs mas 'das ma 'das kyi lha rnams mchod cing*/ snyigs ma rnams lte ba'i mes bsregs par bsams la nang gi sbyin sreg gi tshul du rol/ 'bring du na kha zas rnams oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis bdud rtsir brlabs la/ snying ga'i bam̐ yig bla ma'i ngo bor bzhugs pa la mchod pas/ thugs mnyes shing gzi brjid phun sum tshogs par gyur par bsam/ bsdus pa na/ kha zas nyid kyang lhar gsal bas lha la lha thim pa'i bsam pas zhen 'dzin med par longs spyod/ de ltar byas pas bu lon du mi 'gyur zhing dkor sgrib byang*/ tshogs rlabs po che rdzogs pa sogs phan yon mtha' yas shing*/ sbyang gzhi sbyangs 'bras sogs bdud rtsi myang ba dang 'dra'o gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa phyi rol mchod pa la'ang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ rgyas par bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor phyag len ltar bshams pa la/ sgrub mchod dang 'brel bar mchod gtor dang tshogs kyi 'khor los mnyes par bya/ 'bring du sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor rkyang pa tsam mam/ yang na tsandan gyi maṇḍal lam/ me long la chang gis chos 'byung bris te/ dri thig gam 'bru dmar po'i tshom bu gang rung dgod/ de nyid rnal 'byor mar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed de mchod pa 'bul zhing yum gyi rkang brgyad kyis bstod la gtor ma dbul ba sogs bya/ bsdus pa ni/ yum gyi lag mchod bya ba ste/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis zas kyi steng du chos 'byung bri ba'i stangs ka byas la/ chos 'byung dkar po'i dbus su bam̐ yig dmar pos mtshon pa gsal gdab/ bam̐ yig las bdud rtsi babs pas kha zas bdud rtsir byin gyis brlab/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis kha zas blangs la lag pa g.yon pa'i mthil dang mthe'u chung nas mthe bong gi bar thig le re btab la/

rdo rje phag mo'i ngo bo oṃ bam̐ dmar mo/ gshin rje ma'i ngo bo ham̐ yoṃ sngon po/ rmongs byed ma'i ngo bo hri moṃ dkar mo/ skyod byed ma'i ngo bo hriṃ hriṃ ser mo/ skrag byed ma'i ngo bo hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu/ tsaṇḍi ka'i ngo bo phaṭa phaṭa dud ka rnams kyis mtshan par bsam/ thig le btab pa'i gnas so sor g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis bdud rtsi gtor la/ gong sngags so sor 'bru gsum btags pas mchod/ lha rnams mnyes par bsam zhing 'dod don gsol/ gnas so sor 'od du zhu nas thim pas byin gyis brlabs par mos/ lag pa la gos pa'i kha zas rnams 'phur la lus la byug cing zas la bsres te longs spyod/ des dam tshig nyams pa'i nyes pa sbyong*/ sa lam gyi yon tan 'phel bar byed do gsungs/ ༈ /gsum pa gtor ma la/ dku bag dang 'dres pa ste 'bru bzang gi phye la sha chang nya sha sgog btsong bdud rtsi ril bu sogs btab par mar khus sbag pa'i gtor ma 'dzin gtor ram rten gtor byed na dbyibs zlum po padma'i snying po lta bu la/ mtheb kyus sked pa non tsam du bskor ba dang*/ 'phral gtor la dbyibs gong ltar la pad 'dab bzhi pa byed cing dkar rtsi dmar rtsi gang mos dang*/ sha rgyan chung ngu btags pa/ ma 'grigs tshe phye phud sogs gang 'byor gtsang sbra dang ldan pas bsham/ sum bha nis bsang sbyang sngon du 'gro bas lag pa g.yon bstan la oṃ brjod pas dngos 'dzin tha mal gyi snang zhen stong par sbyang*/ g.yas bstan la āḥbarjod pas thod pa'i snod stong gsum tsam bsgom/ gnyis ka bstan la hūm̐ brjod pas sha lnga bdud rtsi lngas phyur bur gtams par bsam/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bcas la ha ho hrīḥbarjod pas rlung mes khol zhu bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bsams te/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya ni/ gdan bzhi las/ lag pa gnyis ni bkan byas la// srin lag gnyis ni phan tshun dkris// gung mo dang ni mtheb rtse sbyar// khro bo gnyis kyis mnan par bya// zhes pa ltar ro// de'ang gtor ma gsar pa'i tshe sngags brgya rtsa tsam dang*/

gzhan rgyun du bdun nam gsum res 'thus/ de nas phaiṃ zhes brjod cing*/ ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ gtor mgron rnams cho ga ltar spyan drangs/ de rnams kyi ljags 'od zer gyi sbu gu bdud rtsir zug pas gsol bar bsams la/ pad skor sngon du 'gro bas rdo rje thal mo kha phye nas se gol gtog pa dang bcas/ gtor sngags lan grangs ci rigs kyis dbul/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis mchod cing nang mchod kyang 'bul la/ de nas ḍā ma ru dang dril bu'i sgrar bcas spro na yum gyi rkang brgyad dam/ de min dpal ldan rdo rje sogs kyis bstod pas nges par bstod/ chos 'di'i srung ma dur khrod bdag po dang mgon po che chung sogs la'ang gtor ma 'bul ba zhal shes su yod cing*/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor dang gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs kyang gtang*/ mgron rnams rten la brtan par bzhugs su gsol ba'am rang la bsdu ba/ gshegs gsol sogs skabs thob dang bstun te bya gsungs/ ༈ /bzhi pa sbyin sreg la dngos dang zhar byung gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ be'u bum du bzhugs pa'i rje zhwa lu ba sangs rgyas dpal bzang gi yig cha sogs mang yang*/ gsang chen slob bshad pa'i gdams pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i zhal shes rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan gyis mdzad pa dang*/ de nyid khyab bdag gnas gsar ba kun dga' legs 'byung gis lhan thabs dkyus su bcug ste nag 'gros mdzad pa dang*/ de bas bsdus pa kho bo'i bla ma rin po che pas mdzad pa gang rigs ltar gtong zhing*/ khyad par gyi rdzas ba lang rang bzhin gyis shi ba'i sha dang*/ sdig pa sbyang phyir til nag po rang la grangs bsags te dbul ba sogs phyag bzhes ltar bya/ des bsnyen pa sogs kyi kha skong du sngags kyi lhag chad skong ba dang*/ bar chad zhi zhing dngos grub myur du ster bar byed do gsungs/ ༈ /zhar byung sbyin sreg dngos ma grub tshe sdig pa sbyang phyir mar me'i sbyin sreg ni/

sangs rgyas dpal bzang dang*/ ngag dbang bstan 'dzin phun tshogs dang*/ zhu chen tshul khrims rin chen dang*/ bdag gi bla ma rin po ches mdzad pa sogs cho ga gang rigs ltar mar me rnal 'byor mar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed cing til kho na dbul te/ sngags mthar mkha' spyod 'grub pa'i spel tshig btags pa sogs man ngag ltar bya/ 'di'ang tshegs chung ngus sdig pa sbyangs pa dang mkha' spyod sgrub pa'i thabs rmad du byung ba zhig go/ ༈ /lnga pa tshes bcu'i mchod pa la'ang rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum las/ tshogs gsag par 'dod pas yar gyi tshes bcu'i nyin mo dang*/ sdig sgrib sbyang bar 'dod pas mar gyi tshes

25 bcu'i mtshan mo ste/ dus de dag gang ltar lan re ni nges par gtong zhing*/ de'ang rgyas pa ni gnas gsar ba kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyi sgrub mchod kyi yi ge nag 'gros ma las byung ba ltar sku tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor/ gsung bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor/ thugs sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor rnams legs par bzhengs te/ mchod pa lnga dang*/ gtor ma gnyis sogs brgyud pa'i lag len ltar bshams la/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor sgrub cing mchod bstod dbang bzhi blang ba sogs byas mthar/ tshar lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i phyag bzhes ltar bdag gi bla ma rin po ches mdzad pa'i yig cha ltar tshogs kyi 'khor lo'am dpa' bo'i ston mo rgyas par dbul ba sogs bya'o// 'bring du ras dmar pos bkab pa'i stegs kyi khar maṇḍa lar tsandan dmar po'i chu'am chang bdud rtsir brlabs pas srin lag g.yon gyis chos 'byung gru gsum g.yon skor du bri/ nang thams cad tsandan dmar po'i chus byugs pa la dbus su me tog dmar po'i tshom bu dgod/ de'i g.yas su me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ g.yon du dri chab/ gtor ma lha bshos/ mdun du sha chang sogs mchod pa'i yo byad bshams la/ maṇḍal gyi tshom bu rnal 'byor mar yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed la mchod bstod tshogs 'khor bsdus tsam bcas byed pa kho bo'i bla ma rin po ches mdzad pa ltar bya/ yang na grong pa'i chos kyis ma gos pa'i bu mo gzhon nu ma gcig gam/ lnga/ bcu gsum/ so bdun sogs lha grangs dang mnyam pa gang rung tshes bcu yin tshul ma shes par byas nas/ dpral bar sindhu ra'i thig le gdab/ ku sha'i stan la gzhag pa sogs man ngag ltar byas te/ sha chang gtso bor gyur pa'i bza' btung gya nom pas tshim par bya ba ni rigs ldan ma'i mchod pa zhes bya/ ༈ /de'ang ma grub na bsdus pa ni/ rang gis sngar dam bcas pa'i sngags sum 'gyur du bzla zhing*/

'dis tshes bcu byas pa'i go mi chod kyang*/ ma byas pa'i nyes pa khegs pa yin no gsungs/ de ltar tshes bcu rnam pa gnyis ma chag par brtson pas tshogs rdzogs/ bsod nams dang longs spyod 'phel/ mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub ster bar byed pas nan tan chen pos dka' ba dwang blang bya bar 'os so gsungs/ ༈ /de ltar gang zag rab 'bring tha ma thams cad kyi nyams len du gyur pa bskyed pa'i rim pa rnal 'byor bcu gcig cha lag dang bcas pa 'di nyid ma nor bar nyams su blangs pas mkha' spyod kyi dngos grub dus ring po ma yin par myur du 'thob par 'gyur ba ste/ 'di nyid la bskyed rim phag mo mkha' spyod ces gsungs kyang*/ don gyis bskyed rdzogs zung 'jug dbang bzhi'i lam thams cad kyi nyams len gyi gnad thams cad ma tshang ba med par mngon rtogs kyi dkyus gcig la tshang tshul gyi dbang bzhi lus la bsgrig na/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la bstim pa'i stong nyid kyi ngang las lus rtsa'i dkyil 'khor dag pa/ rang nyid sngags lha phyi'i rnal 'byor ma'i skur yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyi cho gas bsgrub cing*/ snying ga'i zla dkyil sa bon sngags phreng rnams rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' bo dpa' mo'i skur bskyed pa tsam du ma zad/ kha ṭwāṃ ga he ru ka'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis rten dang brten par bcas pa tshang zhing yab yum gnyis ka'i bskyed rim gyi lus yongs su rdzogs pa nyams su blang bar 'gro bas bumaṃ dbaṃng giṃ laṃm/ snying ga'i chos 'byung phyi ma'am/ 'og mas gsang gnas bde skyong gi 'khor lo lte ba e yig gru gsum gyi rnam par yod pas de mtshon pa dang*/ zla dkyil gyis snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo zlum por yod pa mtshon zhing*/ bam̐ yig gi cha shas ya ra la wa'i yi ge bzhis mgrin pa longs spyod kyi 'khor lo'i rtsa 'dab bcu drug gi rtsa ba'i rtsa bzhi mtshon/ sngags phreng yig 'bru so gnyis kyis spyi bo bde chen gyi 'khor lo rtsa 'dab so gnyis pa mtshon/

bam̐ yig gi sog a thung gis lte ba'i dmar cha dang chos 'byung nang mas lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo rtsa 'dab re bzhi pa mtshon/ bam̐ yig gi nā das rtsa dbu ma mtshon pa ste/ rten 'khor lo lnga la gnad du bsnun pas/ bsgom bya'i gnad steng mkha' spyod kyi 'khor lo la brten nas stong pa sgrub pa/ 'og gsang gnas kyi 'khor lo la brten nas bde ba sgrub pa/ bar sprul pa'i 'khor lo la brten nas bde drod sgrub pa gsum las/ 'dir sprul pa'i 'khor lo la brten nas bde drod sgrub pa gsaṃng dbang gi laṃm/ chos 'byung gi grwa bzhi'i dga' ba 'khyil pa byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin can du bsgoms pas/ steng 'og gi 'khor lo la brten nas las kyi phyag rgyas bskyed pa'i bde stong lhan skyes kyi ye shes skye bar byed pa sheṃr dbaṃng giṃ laṃm/ dbu ma'i yas mas kyi dga' 'khyil 'du 'phrod kyi mthar bde stong zung 'jug brjod bral gyi ngang du 'dzin med khra ler 'jog pa dang*/ der ma zad mgo mjug bar gsum du rang bzhin med pa'i lta ba skyong ba thams cad ni gnas lugs phyag rgya chen po ste dbang bzhi pa tshiṃg dbaṃng giṃ laṃm ste/ bskyed rim kho na la dbang bzhi'i lam tshang ba'o/ ༈ /laṃm 'diṃs grolaṃ baṃ thobaṃ lugs kyang*/ de ltar bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig po 'di'i sbyang gzhi dang sbyong byed thams cad legs par ngo 'phrod par byas nas/ bla ma dam pa'i man ngag ltar ye ma chag par bzlas sgom la brtson zhing*/ gzhi'i bsnyen pa 'bum phrag bzhi kha skong dang bcas pa grub par byas te/ yar mar gyi tshes bcu gnyis su tshogs gtor la brtson par byas pa tsam gyis nam zhig na rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mal bud med kyi rnam pas dngos su byon te zhal bstan cing*/ de la ngo shes par byas te gsol ba btab pas rnal 'byor pa'i lag pa'i mkhrig ma nas bzung ste rnam smin gyi lus 'di ma spangs par/

mkha' spyod rig pa 'dzin pa'i zhing ngam/ mkha' spyod chung ngur khyer la/ der slebs ma thag tu phung po rags pa 'di nyid 'chi med kyi 'ja' lus su gnas 'gyur zhing*/ longs spyod thams cad kyang nam mkha' las 'bad med du 'byung ba dang*/ tshe bskal pa'i bar du thub cing phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing rnams su rdzu 'phrul gyis bgrod nas/ gang 'dod kyi chos nyan par nus shing*/ dpa' bo rnams kyis lam sgrub pa'i grogs dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma rnams kyis phyag rgya'i nye rgyu mdzad nas lam gyi 'phro mthud de/ tshe 'dir bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang mngon du byed pa ni/ gang zag dbaṃng poṃ raṃb kyi grol lugs yin gsungs/ ༈ /gal te de lta bus ma grub tshe sindhu ra'i sgrub pa'am/ laṅka li'i sgrub pa bya ste/ de'ang thog mar oṃ gsum ma 'bum phrag brgya'am/ 'bru 'bum gsum kha skong dang bcas pa legs par bsgrubs nas/ shin tu dben pa'i gnas su/ dkyil 'khor gsum dang mchod gtor bcas bdag 'jug ltar bsham/ thugs dkyil me long gi steng du rab dza landha ra/ 'bring tsā ri tra/ tha ma gangs ti se'i pre ta pū ri nas byung ba'i sindhu ra bkram par/ chos 'byung sngags phreng bam̐ dang bcas pa gsal zhing dag par dgod/ bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ mdun bskyed dkyil 'khor yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bsgrub ste/ mchod bstod bya zhing bdag 'jug blang*/ mdun bskyed kyi sindhu rar dmigs te/ spro bsdu dang bcas oṃ gsum ma bzhi 'bum kha skong dang bcas pa thun bzhir bcad nas sgrub cing thun re re'i mthar sindhu ra'i ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa sindhu ra la bstim/ sindhu ra bsgrubs zin pa rnams shel gyi spar bu lta bur tshag bya/ 'byor na thun re re bzhin du sindhu ra brje zhing*/ ma 'byor na zhag rer sindhu ra nges par brje/ de ltar bsnyen pa grub nas/ lang ka li'i shing zhes pa bal yul nas 'byung ba'i so shing 'dra ba/

sbom shos byis pa'i lag ngar tsam yod pa de rnyed na dang*/ ma rnyed tshe bod du skyes pa'i sman do bar grags pa me tog paṇa zhwa leb 'jog byas pa lta bu ser po/ 'bras bu rdog po che ba rkang sbubs stong can zhig yod pa de'i nang nas do rgod pa zhes mdzub gang tsam dang*/ phra sbom mtheb mdzub kyi bar du tshud pa zhig yod pa de nyid mdzub gang gi ring thung tsam gyi nang rkang 'tshir phyi ba sogs gad bdar legs par byas/ gu gul gyis bdug kha zhabs su shing srab mor dga' 'khyil gyi spar brkos pa'i kha chod dam zhing 'grigs pa bzos/ phyi nas shog bu dug med gtsang mas legs par btum/ rang rnal 'byor mar bsgoms pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas snod de lag nang du bzung ba la oṃ gsum ma brgya rtsa tsam bzlas pa'i mthar/ sngar bsgrubs pa'i sindhu ra rnams cung zad kyang ma 'thor bar der blugs la kha dam par gcad/ de nas yar ngo'i tshes bcur mchod gtor dang bdag 'jug rgyas par bya/ srod kyi dus su grogs dam ldan 'khor lo sdom pa'i gzhi bsnyen mthar phyin pa zhig gis rnal 'byor dbyug pa zhes bya ba sba'i dbyug pa ring thung rang nyid sa la bsdad nas rtsar bslangs pas mgo dang mnyam pa'am/ thal mo gnyis kyi mthil snying gar sprad nas gru mo brgyangs pa'i gru mo phan tshun gyi rtse dang mnyam pa zhig lag tu bzung la sumbha ni'i sngags bar ma chad par bzlas pa zhig dang mnyam du/ rang gis sindhu ra'i snod khyer te dur khrod du phyin nas/ khru gang tsam gyi dong brus pa'i nang du sindhu ra'i snod de mi gzhan gyis mi shes par bcug kha la sas mi mngon par sbyi ba/ mi nor ba'i mtshan ma gdab/ rang de'i khar kha nub tu bltas nas bsdad la srod 'khor tsam gyi bar du lha'i rnal 'byor dang mi 'bral bar bzlas pa bya/ de'i tshe grogs des kyang sgrub pa po'i byang shar ngos su gnyid ma log par bsdad la sum bha ni'i sngags bzla zhing phyi nang gi bar gcod bsrung*/
