de nas yang sgrub khang du log la/ nyin gyi ring bdag 'jug dang phyi rol mchod pa ci 'grub bya/ nub mo sngar ltar dur khrod du phyin la/ bzlas pa je mang sdod yun je ring byas pa'i nyi shu gsum gyi nub mtshan phyed bar dang*/ nyer bzhi'i nub nam gyi sum gnyis dang*/ nyer lnga'i nub mtshan thog thag tu dur khrod der bzlas pa byas pas grub pa'i rtags su 'og tu sbas pa'i sindhu ra las sgra 'byin pa dang*/ 'od 'phro ba sogs 'byung zhing*/ ma byung kyang rung la/ nyer drug gi nangs par nam langs ma thag dong gi nang nas sindhu ra phyung ste khyim du khyer/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhag nas bdag 'jug dang phyi rol mchod pa rgyas par byed/ nyi ma shar ba dang mnyam du grogs ni mi dgos la/ rang nyid gcig pur ku sā li'i chas su zhugs/ sindhu ra'i snod de'i kha chod kyi dga' 'khyil spar de dpral bar gdab/ 'phros slar btum ste mchan khung g.yon du mis mi mthong bar sba/ rnal 'byaur dbyug pa de lag tu khyer la/ dza landha ra sogs yul nyer bzhi dang*/ bal yul sogs mkha' 'gro 'du che ba'i gnas dang*/ rgya nag sogs grong khyer chen po dang*/ lha sa lta bur yang zhing skyes kyi mkha' 'gro ma byung bar gsungs pas/ de lta bu'i yul phyogs med du 'khyams shing*/ 'phong ra lta bu'i bud med mang du 'tshogs pa dang*/ lhag tu skud pa 'tshong ba'i gnas thams cad du phyin te/ rang lha'i nga rgyal gyis bltas te ma bsdad par phyin pas re zhig na rang gi dpral bar btab pa'i dga' 'khyil de nyid bud med gang gi dpral bar me long la gzugs brnyan shar ba ltar 'phos pa de ni rdo rje rnal 'byor ma tha mal bud med kyi tshul bstan pa tsam yin nges pas/ 'khu 'phrig the tshom med par de'i g.yon nas bskor te zhabs spyi bor blangs la phyag 'tshal gsol ba btab cing bsnyen bkur bas dus de nyid du mkha' spyod rig pa 'dzin pa'i grong du khrid pa'am/

gzhan du gnas skabs der gang 'tshams kyi chos ston pa dang*/ zhi sogs kyi las dang grub pa brgyad sogs dngos grub ci rigs pa stsal zhing*/ nam zhig bar do'i snang ba shar ma thag tu rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur ba ni gaṃng zagaṃ dbaṃng poṃ 'bringaṃ gis bsnyen sgrub las gsum la brten nas grol tshul yin no gsungs/ ༈ /gal te de lta bus kyang ma grol tshe/ da dung sgyid lug pa dang zhum pa mi bya bar nyams su blangs pas nam 'chi ba'i tshe sher dbang gi lam mtshon pa'i rdzogs rim gyi rnal 'byor dang*/ nang gi mkha' spyod sgrub pa bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa'i bsdu rim gnyis po gang rung re res kyang 'chi ba 'od gsal chos kyi sku las bar dor ldang ba na/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bzlas sgom byed pa'i snang ba 'byung zhing*/ de la brten nas dus de nyid du rdo rje rnal 'byaur ma mkha' spyod kyi dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas pa lhags nas/ sgrub pa po de seṅge'i khri la bzhag 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub/ me tog gi char 'bebs/ rol mo'i sgra sgrogs bzhin du mkha' spyod du nges par 'khyer bar 'gyur ba de ni dbaṃng po thaṃ ma'iṃ grol lugs yin no gsungs/ ༈ /des kyang ma grol na gang zag dbang po tha shal las kyang yang mthar gyur pa/ las nyon gyi sgrib pa shin tu che zhing brtson 'grus chung bas len pa yin pas/ de ltar ma grol srid tshe skye ba phyi ma'am/ skye ba bcu drug tshun chad du nges par phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub 'thob nges pa ni/ dbang po yang tha smon lam gyis grol tshul yin mod kyi/ de lta bu las kyang ches myur bar byed pa'i thabs 'da' ka ma'i man ngag zab mo nyams su blang bar bya ste/ sa skya'i gdung brgyud rim par zhal shes su byon pa'i man ngag kun la med pa'i zab chos 'pho ba'i gdams pa la 'pho ba dngos/ 'chi ltas brtag pa/ las la sbyar ba dang gsum/ dang po ni/

rje btsun yab yum zhal sbyor la brten pa'i 'pho ba dang*/ yum rkyang gi 'pho ba gnyis las/ dang po la/ dben pa'i gnas su mtshams dam du bcad la zhag bdun tsam du sbyang zhing*/ de'ang rang nyid bdag bskyed bzlas pa gtor 'bul dang bcas pa sngon du song nas/ thun mtshams kyi lhar gsal ba'i sku lus stong ra dar dmar gyi gur phub pa lta bu'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma rag dung mgo mjug ldog pa lta bu mas sne phra ba lte ba'i thad du sleb pa/ mthil nyi gdan dmar 'khyil le bas smyug tshigs ltar bkag cing*/ yas sne tshangs bug tu rgya mthong kha phye ba ltar ha rer yod pa/ dbu ma'i mas sne'i nang nyi gdan gyi steng du rang sems dang rlung bam̐ yig gsum 'dus kyi ngo bo rnal 'byor ma dmar mo rgyan cha lugs rdzogs shing*/ gdan dang zhabs gnon med pa mtheb sor tsam pa zhig gsal gdab/ rang gi spyi bo'i thad kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar/ rang dang zhal sprod kyi tshul du/ seṅge chen po brgyad kyis btegs pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma nyi ma 'jigs dus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ rtsa ba'i bla ma dpal he ru ka'i rnam pa can/ sku mdog ind+ra nī la'i ri bo ltar sngo ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum rdo rje rnal 'byor ma dmar mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yab phyag rgya drug dang*/ yum phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa'i skur gsal gdab/ khri de'i steng gi mtha' skor kun tu sangs rgyas dang byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma skyabs yul gyi tshogs thams cad sprin phung gtibs pa ltar bzhugs shing*/ 'ja' 'od kyi gur phub/ me tog gi char 'bebs/ glu dbyangs rol mo'i sgra sgrogs shing mkha' spyod kyi zhing dngos su bsam/ tshogs zhing gtso bo yab yum gyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan par bsam/

de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bsgoms pa dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs/ gnyis med du thim par mos/ rang nyid rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas mchod pa'i lha mo'i tshogs spros par bsams la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta arghaṃ sogs nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pa phyag rgya dang bcas 'bul zhing*/ nang mchod kyang dbul/ chos dbyings rnam dag sogs ci rigs pas bstod/ de nas chags zhen dang bcas na/ be'u rtod phur la btags pa'am/ bya nam mkha' la 'phur ba'i rkang par rdo btags pa dang 'dra bas/ 'pho ba 'grub pa dka' bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ tshe 'di nyid du longs spyod sogs 'khor ba'i phun tshogs chags zhen skye ba'i yul gang yin thams cad bla ma yab yum la dbul zhing 'khri ba rbad chod du gtang*/ de nas gdung shugs drag po dang bcas/ dusaṃ gsumaṃ sangaṃs rgyasaṃ thaṃms cadaṃ 'dus pa'i dngos// bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs// bdag 'dzin blo yis thong bar byin gyis brlobs// dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlobs// lam mchog 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis brlobs// 'phyugs med mkha' spyod bgrod par byin gyis brlobs// zhes gdung dbyangs sam shar ma gang rigs kyis gsol 'debs grangs ci ltar rigs pa yid 'khul nges bya/ 'pho ba la rlung bum can rang gal che zhing*/ bum can 'byongs po yod na 'pho dmigs dang sbrags/ 'byongs po med na las dang po pas bum can dang dmigs pa sogs stabs gcig tu blo la 'char dka' bas/ 'og rlung 'then tsam byas la dmigs pa 'og rlung gis dbu ma'i mas sne'i nyi dkyil 'phul/ nang gi rnal 'byor ma nyi gdan dang bcas pa yer gyis bteg par bsams la/ ngag tu/ i hik ces pa'i gdangs ring zhing shugs drag po brjod de/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis rol mo'i sgra 'ur chems sgrogs pa dang bcas chab cig rang sems rnal 'byor ma skar mda' 'phangs pa bzhin du tshangs bug nas thon/

mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i bla ma he ru ka'i thugs kar thim/ bla ma'i thugs dang rang sems dbyer med du bsres nas bde stong gi ngang du cham gyis gzhag de nas yang*/ ka hi/ zhes brjod cing bla ma'i thugs las rang sems rnal 'byor ma zur du bye ste/ tshangs bug nas dbu ma brgyud mar zhugs/ sngar ltar nyi gdan la 'khod par bsam/ tshul de lta bus nyin re la brgya'am nyer gcig sogs ci nus sbyang*/ dmigs pas dub na bar bar du gdangs snyan po'i sgo nas gsol gdab kha shas bya ba spel mar byed/ thun mthar tshogs zhing rnams gtso bo he ru ka yab yum la thim zhing*/ yum phag mo dang gdan seng khri'ang bla mar thim/ bla ma he ru ka je chung du gyur pa rang gi tshangs bug nas mar zhugs/ sku'i 'od dbu ma'i yas sner 'ub kyis 'dus te gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram gyis tshangs bug lam gyis bgag bla ma snying gar zhugs te/ lte ba'i rang sems rnal 'byor ma dang*/ spyan gzigs res mdzad pas gnyis ka'i thugs rgyud rjes chags kyi bde ba chen pos mnyes te 'od kyi rnam par zhu la khad du gyur pa'i sku las 'chi med bdud rtsi dkar dmar gyi rgyun babs pas rang gi lus mer gyis gang*/ 'chi med tshe'i dngos grub thob par bsam/ lte ba'i rnal 'byor ma snying ga'i he ru ka la bstim pa'am/ lte bar 'jog pa gang bder bya/ des 'pho rab tshe thung ba'i gegs sel zhing*/ 'byongs rtags cung zad byung nas rang sems rnal 'byor ma tshangs bug gi yan la mi gtong bar mar dbab pa bzang gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa yum rkyang gi 'pho ba ni/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i stong ra gong ltar bsgom/ rtsa dbu ma'ang sngar ltar la/ mar sne chos 'byung dmar po chung ngu zhig gi nang du zug pa'i sne zla dkyil gyis bkag pa'i mas sne'i nang zla ba'i steng du rang sems bam̐ yig dmar po sran 'bring tsam 'phar la khad pa/ 'phur la khad par bsam/ tshogs zhing gtso bo rnal 'byor mas byed/

de la ye shes pa spyan drangs shing bstim/ mchod bstod/ zhen chags spang ba/ gsol 'debs rnams tshig phrad bsgyur ba tsam las gong ltar bya/ rlung ro bus nas 'og rlung yar 'then pas/ dbu ma'i mas sne'i zla dkyil 'phul nas/ rlung bus pa dang mnyam du ī hik ces rang sems bam̐ yig zla gdan dang bcas pa tshangs bug nas rgyang nger thon/ spyi bo'i bla ma rnal 'byor ma'i thugs kar thim par bsam zhing dar cig lta thog tu gzhag yang sna nas rlung rngub pa dang mnyam du bla ma rnal 'byor ma'i thugs las rang sems bam̐ yig gi rnam par bye nas/ tshangs bug nas zhugs/ dbu ma'i lam brgyud/ sngar gyi gnas su 'khod par bsams la/ ka hi zhes brjod nas/ rlung bum can gzung*/ bum can skabs su dmigs pa yengs na gegs bskyed pa yin pas bsgrim par bya'o gsungs/ gong ltar 'pho ba gnyis po gang yin kyang*/ res 'ga' rnam shes spyi bor 'phos pa dang lhan du sked pa khyed tsam byed pa ni 'pho ba'i 'khrul 'khor zhes bya zhing*/ mar babs nas lte bar gnas tshe kha sbyor ci thub 'dzin/ mi thub na rang babs su gzhag rlung dmigs la brten pa'i 'pho ba 'byongs dka' yang brtan pa yin/ sngags dang bstun pa'i sgra'i 'pho ba ni 'byongs sla'ang mi brtan pa yin/ de ltar sbyangs sbyangs pas 'byongs rtags su/ spyi gtsug za ba dang*/ sbrid pa dang*/ skrangs pa dang*/ rnag khrag chu ser rdol ba sogs 'byung zhing*/ lhag par chu ser rdol na mi nyams shing brtan pa yin/ phyi rtags su mkha' spyod grub pa'i ltas sgrub khang la 'ja' zug pa'am 'ja' gur phub pa'am me tog gi char dang dri bzang po'i ngad ldang ba sogs yid ches pa'i mtshan ma byung nas/ srod thun gyi skabs su mi brjed tsam re las mi dgos shing*/ rtag tu bsgoms na tshe thung zhing thal ba'i skyon yod gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa 'chi ltas brtag pa ni/ gdan bzhi las/ dus la babs na 'pho bya yi// dus min lha ni gsod byed pa'o// zhes 'chi nges pa'i tshe ma gtogs par gya tshoms su 'phos nas lus kyi lha bsad pa'i rtsa ltung brgyad pa 'byung bas 'dir 'chi ltas mdor bsdus tsam bshad na/

nyin grangs du ma'i bar sna bug gnyis nas rlung btud mar rgyu ba/ mig gi phyi zur mdzub mos mnan pas 'od dmar kor kor mi 'byung ba/ rna ba lag pa gnyis kyis mnan pa'i tshe 'ur sgra mi 'byung ba rna ba'i arta chad pa/ snga dro nyi ma rtse shar la nyi mar rgyab bstan nas bsdad pas mgo bo'i grib ma las rlangs pa 'byung ba de nyams pa/ lag pa g.yas kyi khu tshur dpral bar gtad/ gru mo pus mo g.yas par btsug mkhrig ma'i mtshams su mig cer gyis bltas pas mkhrig ma rbad kyis chad pa sogs nye ba'i 'chi ltas yin zhing*/ des mtshon gso dpyad kyi gzhung dang*/ slob dpon ngag dbang grags pa'i 'chi bslu sogs las rgyas par bshad pa'i 'chi ltas kyi rigs rnams nges par byas nas/ da dung 'chi ltas byung snyam du rtab rtob tu mi 'pho bar/ tshe sgrub dang srog bslu/ nye'u 'don pa sogs 'chi ba bslu ba'i thabs sna tshogs bya/ de dag gis kyang mi zlog par 'dug na/ ༈ /gsum pa las la sbyar ba ni/ nor rdzas longs spyod thams cad dge phyogs su btang la gang la'ang chags zhen med par bya zhing*/ bla ma dngos su bzhugs na sindhu ra'i byin rlabs zhu/ ma bzhugs na bdag 'jug bya zhing dam tshig nyams chag thams cad bshags la sor chud par bya/ 'pho ba'i dus kyang gzhan la 'debs na phyi dbugs chad/ nang dbugs ma chad pa'i bar der 'pho bar bshad kyang*/ rang la gnad du 'gro bar dka' bas/ nges pa'i 'chi ltas kyis zin cing nad ma byung gong nas 'pho zhing*/ gal te nad kyi zug rngu'am gcong gis dmigs pa mi gsal bar 'dug na/ grogs dam ldan zhig gis rna lam nas gsal 'debs su bcug la/ rang gis dmigs pa bskyar/ 'pho dmigs sogs gzhan gong ltar la/ rnam shes yang yang spor ba las phyir mi 'bebs/ gsol 'debs skabs su/ lam mchog 'pho ba thebs par byin gyis rlobs// zhes bsgyur ro// de ltar spor ba de nyid myur ba'i phyir 'pho rdzas bsten pa'ang shin tu legs/

des 'chi kha bar do'i 'jigs skrag myong mi dgos par mkha' spyod rig pa 'dzin pa'i zhing du skyes nas der lam gyi lhag ma rnams nyams su blangs te rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la nges par 'thob par 'gyur zhing*/ spyi bo'i bla ma lha 'ja' 'od rol mo'i sgra dang bcas mkha' spyod du phebs par bsam mo/ ༈ /gang gi gsum pa rjes kyi bya ba bsngo smon sogs 'og tu bshad pa ltar bya'o// 'di'i mkha' spyod rig 'dzin gyi zhing ni rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyi las dang smon lam gyi mthu las grub pa yin pas/ 'di tsam na yod ces tshad gzung ba'i yul las 'das pa'o// zhes gsungs so// 'dir smras pa/ yan lag bdun ldan mkhyen brtse'i lha lam las// rjes chags sprul pa'i snang brnyan 'od stong can// 'gro khams padmo'i mgon gcig rje btsun ma// yang yang dran no da ni phyag ring rkyongs// rtse gcig yid kyis nor 'dzin khyon yangs las// phyogs zla'i rnal 'byor dpag bsam 'khril ldem rtser// rig 'dzin dngos grub gser gyi snye ma ni// bde chen sbrang rtsi'i ro bda' ci yang 'dzin// de lta'i lam tshul slob bshad gdams pa'i bcud// zer sgros gzhan rgyas ma bkab ḍā ki ma'i// zhal rlangs drod du 'thul ba'i a mṛ ta// tshig gi bum bzang yangs par bskyil 'di ko /gtad pa rnam bzhi mtha' ru skyel nas kyang*// gong ma'i rnam thar snying la bkod nus grogs// kye kye 'bras med sbun pa ma 'phyar bar// rdo rje btsun mo'i nye lam nor du chongs// zhes pa'ang bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// ༈ /na mo gu ru samyaksaṃ buddhā dzñā kā ru ṇend+rā ya/ lhan skyes bde chen stong dbyings mdzes dga' ma// rjes chags dmar bas rab sgeg ḍā ki'i rje// bye ru'i lcug phran lta bu'i phyag rkyongs la// kho bo'i yan lag mchog la dpal sbyin mdzod// gsang chen bskyed rim gser gyi rtsibs stong can// dbang phyug rnal 'byor mu khyud sra brtan mdzes// sngon med legs bshad 'od brgyas g.yogs pa yi// brjod byed 'khor lo rin chen bskor zin nas// rlung khams rtsa gnas gling chen rnam bzhi la// dbang sgyur dbu ma'i lam gyi blon po che// sems nyid rgyal po'i mdun na rgyu ba yi// zung 'jug lha dbang srid la 'dug pa'i chos// gnad kyi btsun mo myur ba'i cang shes dang*// 'phyugs med glang po byin rlabs bai ḍūrya// lta ba mchog gi dmag dpon dang bcas pas// srid pa'i rgol 'joms stobs bcu'i mnga' thang 'dzin// de phyir brgyud ldan bla ma'i thugs kyi bcud// mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag lta bu zab mo'i lam// rdzogs rim sa gsum dge ba'i sprin char 'dir// dbab kyi skal ldan rna ba'i zhing sa rlogs// gnyis pa grol byed mkha' spyod chen mo gtso bor sgrub pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa la/

rnal 'byor gsang mtha' thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag 'di la rgyas par slob dpon nag po spyod pas dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rtsa bshad kyi rgyud thams cad kyi don gyi bcud phyung ste bkral ba/ mkha' 'gro brda'i skad du/ o la pa ti ste bod skad du rim pa bzhi par grags pa dang*/ 'bring po grub chen rdo rje dril bu pas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma las dngos su gsan pa'i zab chos dril bu rim lngar grags pa dang*/ bsdus pa rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug lū hi pa kun tu dge bas dpal sha wa ri pa las mnos pa'i rdzogs rim bsdu ba gsum pa zhes bya ba rnams su yod pa las/ de dag thams cad kyi gnad 'dus shing*/ zab khyad ches 'phags rmad du byung ba ni/ 'dir gang bshad par bya ba'i chos paṇa chen nā ro ta pas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma las dngos su gsan pa'i gdams pa/ rje btsun yum gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rtsa dbu ma zhes bya ba 'di nyid yin pas/ 'di la'ang zab pa'i rgyu mtshan dang*/ gdams pa dngos gnyis las/ dang po la dngos dang*/ dpe bstan pa gnyis/ dang po ni/ ji skad du/ chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*// bzhi stong mchog gi cho ga yis// lus kyi de nyid mi shes pas// de dag thams cad 'bras med gsungs// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rgyu pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa tsam du ma zad/ rgyud sde 'og ma gsum las kyang*/ rten sbyang gzhi la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs khyad par can ma gsungs pas/ dus yun ring po bskal pa grangs med gsum sogs kyi mthar/ sa bcu gcig tsam mngon du byed pa las/ zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang tshe 'di nyid la ster mi nus shing*/ 'khor lo bzhi la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs ston pa'i rdzogs rim rnams khyad par du 'phags mod kyi/ 'khor lo bzhi'i rtsa ba'ang dbu ma kho nar 'du bas/ der rlung sems ma zhugs na gnyis med kyi ye shes mi rtogs/

gzung 'dzin gyi rgya mdun mi khrol bas dman pa yin la/ 'dir rtsa dbu ma gcig pu nyid la gnad du bsnun pas/ snyigs dus kyi tshe thung gcig kho nar zung 'jug gi go 'phang ster bar nges pas na/ shin tu zab pa'o// gnyis pa rgyu mtshan dpes bstan pa la'ang gsum las/ dpe dang po bshan pa srog gi gnad la mkhas pa ni/ glang po chen po lta bu srog chags ji tsam stobs che ba zhig kyang*/ gnad ma shes pa du mas rkang lag sogs la mtshon cha mang du bsnun kyang myur du mi 'chi la/ gnad shes pa'i bshan pas srog rtsa lta bu la khab lta bu'i mtshon rnon phra mo zhig btab pas de ma thag 'chi bar byed pa bzhin/ sbyang gzhi gang la gnas pa'i gnad mi shes par lam la ji tsam 'bad kyang*/ bde chen gyi ye shes mi skye zhing*/ sbyang gzhi'i gnad shes pa'i dmigs pa phra mo res kyang lhan skyes kyi ye shes myur du skyed par byed do// dpe gnyis pa shing mkhan shing gi gnad la mkhas pa ni/ rgya gar lho phyogs ḍā ki nī li pā tra zhes bod skad du/ mkha' 'gro srung bar 'bod pa'i yul du shing sdong phyogs re re nas bcad kyang*/ phyogs re re nas skye ba zhig yod pa de/ gnad mi shes pas st+wa gri sogs brgya phrag bsnun kyang gcod mi nus la/ gnad shes pa zhig gis shing la chu rgyu ba'i srang gnad che sa zhig tu lcags gzer lta bu chung ngu zhig brgyabs pas de nas chu phyir byung ste mi ring bar sdong po bskams nas 'gyel 'gro ba bzhin du/ gnad dang bral ba'i lung rigs gtan tshigs du mas kha phyir blta'i spyod pa gang byas kyang gzung 'dzin je 'phel las rtog pa gcod mi nus la/ gnad dang ldan pa'i gdams pa chung ngu zhig gis kyang gnyis snang rang grol du gcod par byed do// dpe gsum pa sgyu ma mkhan 'khrul 'khor gyi gnad la mkhas pa ni/ rgya gar shar phyogs kyi rgyal po rāṃ dzaṃ de wi bha la ta zhes bya ba'i khang pa'i sgor shing gi mi rengs ral gri'i 'khrul 'khor lag na gnas pa de rgyun mi chad du bskor bas bsrungs nas/

gnad mi shes pa nang du zhugs kyang ral gri'i sos gcod par byed pa la/ 'khrul 'khor gyi gnad shes pas srang thag gi skud pa phra mo zhig bcad pas 'khrul 'khor de thams cad rang sar zhig nas bde bar 'gro btub pa bzhin du/ gnad mi shes pas rtsa rlung sbyang ba sogs la 'bad rtsol mang po byas kyang*/ rlung sems dbu mar 'jug mi nus la/ gnad dang ldan pa'i man ngag cung zad tsam gyis kyang*/ rlung sems dbu mar myur du 'jug nus pa yin pas/ de lta bu'i zab gnad dang ldan pa'i lam de nyams su len pa la brtson pa lhur blang bar bya'o gsungs/ gnyis pa gdams pa dngos la'ang*/ lam gyi lus dngos dang*/ zhar byung gnyis/ dang po la chos nyid dngos su ston pa dang*/ brgyud nas ston pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ dper na phyi'i rgya mtsho chen po blta bar 'dod pa'i mi zhig gis rgya mtsho'i rgyus yod pa zhig la rgya mtsho'i gnas tshul ni ji lta bu zhig yin zhes dris na/ des rgya mtsho chen po ni gting zab pa/ rgya khyon shin tu che ba/ kha dog sngon po/ ngam gnag pa/ rba rlabs dang lbu phreng 'phyo ba/ ba tshwa'i ro dang ldan pas btung mi rung ba/ chu srin sogs srog chags du ma gnas pa zhig go /zhes brjod pas/ dri ba po'i rgyud la rgya mtsho'i lo rgyus 'ol spyi tsam zhig 'char ba bzhin/ bla mas maṇḍal dang dung sogs kyi brda thabs la brten nas sems kyi gnas lugs ngo sprad pas/ don spyi'i tshul tsam rgyud la skye zhing don dngos su rtogs par mi 'gyur la/ sngon gyi bag chags rgyud la yod pa dag ni ma nges so// ༈ /gnyis pa chos nyid brgyud nas ston pa ni/ dper na rgya mtsho'i gnas tshul shes par 'dod pa'i mi de la/ rgya mtsho'i rgyus yod pa'i mis rgya mtsho'i lo rgyus snga ma rnams kyang bshad la/ rgya mtshor 'gro ba'i lam gyi tshul legs par bstan nas/ mi des kyang rgya mtsho yid la byas shing lam du zhugs te phyin pas nam zhig rgya mtsho'i 'gram du slebs pa na/

mi des zer ba ji bzhin rgyu mtshan dngos su mthong 'ong ba de bzhin du/ bla mas chos nyid dngos su ston pa'i byin rlabs kyang stsal la/ bskyed rdzogs kyi lam bstan pa de bzhin du ma 'khrul bar nyams su blangs pas mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes rgyud la skye zhing*/ de'i rgyun goms par byas pas mtshon bya don gyi ye shes mngon sum du rtogs par 'gyur ba yin la/ ༈ /des na skabs 'dir chos nyid brgyud nas ston pa'i gdams ngag de nyid 'chad par byed pa la/ gzhi chos can 'khor ba'i gnad/ lam bsgom pa'i gnad/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa'i gnad dang gsum yod pa las/ dang po ni/ sems can rnams 'chi ba'i tshe/ lus kyi sa khams chu la thim/ chu khams me la thim/ me khams rlung la thim/ rlung khams rnam shes la thim/ de nas rim bzhin lugs 'byung gi snang ba dkar lam/ mched pa dmar lam/ nyer thob nag lam rnams shar ba rim gyis 'gags te/ dug gsum las gyur pa'i rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa rnams 'gags nas/ gzhi'i 'od gsal de nyid 'char na'ang lhan cig skyes pa'i ma rig pas bslad de ngo ma shes pas de ma thag tu lugs ldog gi nyer thob nag lam/ mched pa dmar lam/ snang ba dkar lam rnams rim pas shar zhing*/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa rnams kyang mngon du 'gyur te/ de nas bar srid 'char ba ste bar do'i lus grub cing*/ de'ang dbang po kun tshang ba/ 'od lus khru gang pa/ mngon shes phra'u dang ldan pa/ lus la khams dkar dmar med pa nyi zla'i snang ba med cing mun sros pa lta bu/ gnas sa rtsa med pas g.yo ba rlung kha rgyal te shing bal rlung gis bskyod pa ltar yal yel phyad phyod kyis phyogs thams cad du dbang med du 'gro ba sogs ma nges pa'i rtags drug dang ldan la/ gshin rje'i pho nya'i snang ba dang*/ kha char rlung 'tshubs mun nag gi snang ba sogs 'khrul snang sdug bsngal drag po dang ldan pa zhig tu gyur te/

tshe tshad zhag bdun re'i mtshams nas rtags thams cad 'char bzhin du shi zhing*/ yang bar do'i lus grub ste bar do'i gnas tshad kyang thung mtha' nges med dang*/ ring mtha' rgyal ba yang dgon pa'i bzhed pa ltar lo'i bar sdod dgos pa'ang yod la/ phal cher ring mtha' zhag zhe dgu dang*/ thung mtha' bdun phrag bar du bar dor 'khyams shing*/ de lta bu'i bar do'i sems can gdos bcas kyi lus med pas skyo nas lus 'tshol ba'i snang bas phyogs thams cad du song bar/ je zhig na las kyi dbang gis skye ba phyi ma'i pha ma de gnyis nyal po byed pa rmi lam bzhin du mthong zhing*/ de'ang phor skye na ma la chags shing pha la sdang*/ mor skye na pha la chags shing ma la sdang bar skyes te/ bar do'i rnam shes de nyid pha'i kha las brgyud/ ma'i mngal du chags shing nying mtshams sbyar te/ pha'i khams dkar po'i dwangs ma yungs 'bru phyed gsum tsam dang*/ ma'i khams dmar po'i dwangs ma yungs 'bru gsum tsam 'dres pa'i dbus su rnam shes de nyid 'thums pa na brgyal ba'i rnam pa cung zad byung ba'i mthar/ bde stong gnyis med kyi ngang du gnyis snang nub pa'i 'od gsal mngon sum du shar te zhag bdun du gnas shing*/ de ngo 'phrod na skye ba sprul pa'i skur 'tshang rgya'ang bsgoms stobs kyis ngo ma 'phrod nas brgyal ba ltar gyur pa'i nyer thob nag lam gyi snang ba shar bar/ sngar dus yun ring mo'i skabs su ngo shes pa zhig bar skabs ma mthong bar/ yang nam zhig 'phrad pa na 'di gcig yin mod kyi snyam pa'i gsal bar ngo mi shes par yid blong blong por 'char ba bzhin 'di zhes ngos gzung med par rnam rtog phra mo yang yang skyes nas 'od gsal de la 'dzin pa phra mo zhig zhugs pas/ rang gi lte ba grub rgyu'i thad der khu khrag gnas nas yar mar skyed 'phel ba'i thog ma kho nar rtsa dbu ma rta rnga brgyar gshags pa'i tshad tsam grub/ de'ang a na ha ta zhes pa mi shigs pa'i yi ge'i gzugs su grub/

yang mched pa dmar lam gyi snang ba shar bas/ snang ba thams cad stong pa cir yang ma grub par 'dug snyam du stong pa la 'dzin pa zhugs pas dbu ma'i g.yas su ro ma dmar mo rta rnga brgyar gshags pa'i tshad tsam zhig grub/ yang snang ba dkar lam pa shar bas/ snang ba thams cad 'od gsal bar 'dug snyam du gsal ba la 'dzin pa zhugs pas dbu ma de'i g.yon du rkyang ma dkar mo rta rnga brgyar gshags pa'i tshad tsam grub/ de nas rtsa 'khor thams cad las lte ba'i rtsa 'khor sngon du chags te/ lte ba'i thad nas dbu ma las phyogs bzhir rtsa 'dab bzhi chags pa'i dbus su nam mkha'i rlung dang khams kyi dwangs ma'i rang bzhin gri gug gi so lta bu/ shar gyi 'dab mar rlung gi rlung dbyug pa lta bu/ lho'i 'dab ma la me'i rlung tsheg drag lta bu/ nub kyi 'dab ma la sa'i rlung thong gug lta bu/ byang gi 'dab ma la chu'i rlung thig le nya mig lta bu rnams chags/ lte ba'i rtsa 'dab bzhi las phyogs mtshams brgyad du/ rtsa 'dab brgyad gyes pa'i mdun nas g.yon skor du a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha ste khams kyi dwangs ma yig 'bru brgyad po'i rnam par gnas pa de re re las 'byung ba lnga'i rlung cha mnyam re re rgyu/ 'di dang dus mnyam du snying ga'i rtsa 'khor yang chags/ lte ba'i rtsa 'dab brgyad po de'i phyi rol du rtsa 'dab bcur gyes pa'i mdun nas brtsams te g.yon skor du rtsa 'dab dang por rtsa ba'i sa rlung stobs che ba gcig gnyis par yan lag gi sa rlung stobs zhan pa gcig de mchan rtsa 'dab gnyis la rtsa ba dang yan lag gi chu rlung stobs che chung gnyis/ de mchan rtsa 'dab gnyis la rtsa ba dang yan lag gi me rlung drag zhan gnyis/ de mchan rtsa 'dab gnyis la rtsa ba dang yan lag gi rlung gi rlung drag zhan gnyis/ de mchan rtsa 'dab gnyis la rtsa ba dang yan lag gi nam mkha'i rlung drag zhan gnyis te 'byung rlung rnams rgyu/ de'i phyi rol du rtsa 'dab bcu gnyis su gyes par mdun nas brtsams te rim pa bzhin/

a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥste dbyangs bcu gnyis 'khod pa'i dbyangs thung ngu dang po lnga dang āḥlas pho rlung dang*/ dbyangs ring po lnga dang i las mo rlung rgyu zhing*/ de'ang pho rlung thams cad ro ma dang*/ mo rlung thams cad rkyang mar zhugs te rlung rnams phan tshun du thag 'thag pa'i snam res bzhin du rgyu/ de'i phyi rol rtsa 'dab sum cur gyes pa la mdun nas brtsams te ya ra la wa bzhi spangs pa'i/ ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣa zhes pa rnams gnas pa las/ ka tsa ṭa ta pa sha rnams las sa rlung*/ kha tsha ṭha tha pha ṣa rnams las chu rlung*/ ga dza ḍa da ba sa rnams las me rlung*/ gha dzha ḍha dha bha ha rnams las rlung gi rlung*/ nga nya ṇa na ma kṣa rnams las nam mkha'i rlung rgyu/ de'ang rnam shes ni mi zha bo lta bu/ rlung ni rta lta bur 'gyur/ dug gsum gyi rtog pa ches mang du 'phros pas ro rkyang dbu gsum las gyes pa'i rtsa phran ji snyed pa rnams chags shing*/ de'ang rlung gi zhon pa can gyi rnam shes de/ lte ba'i rtsa rnams su gnas tshe rnam rtog rags pa yod kyang gsal bar mi 'char la/ snying gar slebs shing rnam shes tshogs drug rgyu ba'i rtsa rnams su slebs pa'i tshe don spyi'i tshul du gsal bar 'char zhing*/ mgrin pa'i rtsa 'khor du slebs te ming tshig gi brjod pa sna tshogs rgyu ba'i rtsa yig 'bru'i rnam pa can rnams su zhugs pa'i tshe 'di dang 'di'o zhes tha snyad so sor 'char ro// de nas rtsa de rnams kyi bar bar du chu rgyus dang rgyus pa dang khrag dang sha dang pags pa sogs grub cing*/ rim gyis mer mer po/ nur nur po/ gor gor po/ tar tar po/ mkhrang 'gyur/ nya dang*/ rtsangs pa rus sbal sogs mngal gyi gnas skabs bcu rim gyis rdzogs te lus rdzogs par grub ste/ zla ba dgu'am bcu 'das pa na phyi rol du btsa' bar 'gyur zhing*/

de'i cha sna sgor las kyi rlung gcig sir gyis byung ba'i rkyen gyis khams dkar dmar gnyis so sor gyes te lus po mgo mjug ldog nas skye/ de ltar na rtsa dbu ma'i nang dang*/ de las gyes pa'i rtsa rnams su rnam shes dang rlung zhugs na 'od gsal 'char ba yin kyang*/ ro rkyang gnyis kyis rtsa 'khor so so'i thad nas dbu ma la bcar te gnas pas/ der rlung dang rnam shes kyi rgyu ba 'gags te/ rgyu stong skam po ltar bag la zha ba'i tshul gyis gnas shing ro rkyang gnyis dang de las gyes pa'i rtsa 'dab ji snyed pa rnams su rlung sems kyi 'gro 'ong byas pas gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gi rtog pa ji snyed cig 'char te 'khor ba na 'khor ba yin no gsungs/ de bas na mngal du chags pa'i khu khrag gnyis 'dres kyi gong bu de sa yis 'dzin/ chu yis sdud/ me yis smin par byed/ rlung gis rgyas par byed pa ni sngar bshad pa ltar bam̐ gyi srog ya ra la wa bzhi po dang*/ snying ga'i 'byung bzhi'i khams 'babs pa'i rtsa 'dab bzhi po rnams phan tshun sbyar zhing sbyang gzhi ngos zin pa dgos la/ mdor na rtsa 'dab grangs med pa de dag thams cad rtsa dbu rkyang ro gsum du 'dus shing*/ ro rkyang gnyis kyang dbu mar 'du la/ der rlung sems zhugs pas 'od gsal 'char ba yin pas na nang gi pho nya gsum las mchog ni rtsa dbu ma/ 'bring ni pū dza o a sogs yul nyer bzhi'i rtsa rnams dang*/ tha ma dbu ma las gyes pa'i rtsa bye ba phrag phyed bzhi'i rtsa phran rnams yin cing*/ de'ang rim pa bzhin de rnams su rlung sems zhugs pas bde chen gyi ye shes shin tu myur ba dang*/ myur ba tsam dang*/ ring mo nas skyed pa yin te/ de dag la pho nya zhes 'dogs pa'i rgyu mtshan yang rgyal po lta bu'i bya ba myur du sgrub par byed pa de la pho nya'am/ bang chen nam/ bya ma rta zhes brjod pa bzhin/ 'dis kyang gnyis med lhan skyes kyi ye shes myur du skyed par byed pas na pho nya zhes btags shing*/

mchog 'bring dman gsum du byed pa'ang*/ rtsa phran rnams la gnad du bsnun pas bde chen gyi ye shes myur du skyed mi nus pas pho nya tha ma/ de las yul nyer bzhi'i rtsa rnams myur bas pho nya 'bring*/ de las kyang dbu ma ches shin tu myur bas pho nya mchog ces bya zhing*/ phyi nang gsang ba'i rigs ldan ma gsum las dbu ma ni nang gi rigs ldan ma zhes bya ba yin gsungs/ des na sbyang gzhi'i rtsa thams cad kyi nang nas gtso bo lte ba'i 'khor lo ste/ 'di thog mar nges par bya ba ni sman pas nad ngos 'dzin pa lta bu'o zhes gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa lam bsgom pa'i gnad ni/ spyir 'di'i rdzogs pa'i rim par/ snying ga'i dbus kyi dpyid ces pa'am/ bha santa zhes pa yab he ru ka'i ngo bo/ hūm̐ cha lnga pa yungs kar sbom po'i tshad tsam byang sems ba mo lta bu 'dzag pa'i rnam par bzhugs la/ dpyid ces bya ba'i don yang 'jig rten na dgun grang ba dang*/ dbyar char ser sogs sdug bsngal dang bcas shing*/ nam zla dpyid grang dro snyoms shing ljon shing me tog sogs kha 'bus pa'i rten 'brel gyis lus can rnams bde ba rgyas pa'i dus yin pa ltar/ 'di la'ang gang la gnad du bsnun pas bde chen skyed pa'i don gyis btags la/ nam zla dpyid de'ang 'byung ba dang sa chu dros pa'i rten 'brel la rag las pa bzhin/ snying ga'i dpyid bskul bar byed pa'ang lte bar gnas pa'i ti la ka'am bam̐ yig ces pa yum rnal 'byor ma'i ngo bo/ lte ba'i rtsa mdud gru gsum na khams dmar po a thung ngam/ skyer tsher mgo mjug ldog pa'i rnam par bzhugs pa de nyid la gnad du bsnun dgos pas/ des na re zhig 'dir nang gi he ru ka bskul ba btang snyoms su bzhag nas/ nang gi phag mo la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs rtsa dbu ma'i rnal 'byor 'chad pa la chags can dbu ma'i lam la dga' ba dang*/ chags bral rnal 'byor la dga' ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ chags can gyi lam padma can sogs las dang ye shes kyi phyag rgya dang mnyam par sbyor te rtsa thig rlung gsum la gnad du bsnun pa'i tshul rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi gsung las 'byung ba ltar la/

'dir ched du ma spros pas shes par 'dod na der blta bar bya'o gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa chags bral gyi rnal 'byor la/ rlung sems dbu mar bsdu ba'i rnal 'byor dang*/ bsdus nas bsgom pa'i rnal 'byor gnyis las/ dang po la rlung sbyang ba dang*/ bsdu ba dngos gzhi gnyis/ dang po ni/ gnas shin tu dben par bsam gtan gyi stan la rkang pa gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung*/ lag pa gnyis mnyam bzhag gi mthe bong lto sbyar ba lte 'og tu bcar/ sgal tshigs dong rtse brtsegs pa ltar bsrang*/ ol kos ol mdud non pa tsam mgo bo cung zad dud par gug mig gnyis smin mtshams kyi thad kyi bar snang du har rer blta ba'am sna rtser dbab/ dpung pa rgod gshog ltar brgyangs/ so dang mchu rang babs su gzhag lce rtse rkan la sbyar ba ste lus rnam snang gi chos bdun ldan du byas pas sgom gegs zhi/ sgrib pa byang*/ ye shes skye ba sogs phan yon dpag med 'byin pa spre'u'i gtam rgyud lta bu yin gsungs/ de nas skyabs 'gro nas zhar byung rdzogs rim yan chad rgyun gyi nyams len ltar ram/ yang na bla ma'i rnal 'byor gyi bla ma dang rang sems 'dres pa'i ngang de ga las/ rang nyid skad cig gis rnal 'byor ma sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan dang cha lugs sogs yongs su rdzogs par khra lam gyis gsal gdab/ de'i sku lus thams cad 'od kyi rang bzhin dar dmar gyi gur phub pa'am phru ma phus btab pa lta bu phyi gsal nang gsal snyan gshog dang phyag zhabs kyi sor rtse tshun chad stong sang nge ba'i stong ra bsgoms pas gegs mi 'byung*/ de nas rang lus 'od kyi rang bzhin de'i dbus drang por rtsa ro rkyang gnyis 'dus kyi ngo bo/ rtsa dbu ma sba lcag tsam yar sne spyi gtsug tu klad rgyas kyi thad du zug pa zla dkyil chung ngus kha bcad pa/ mar sne lte 'og sor bzhi tsam du zug pa sngar bshad pa'i khyad chos bzhi ldan du gsal gdab/ dbu ma'i mas sne'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor chung ngus smyug tshigs ltar khad chad du bkag par bsam/

dbu ma'i yar sne klad rgyas kyi nang du chu rlung gi rang bzhin oṃ dkar po/ g.yas su sa rlung gi rang bzhin ām̐ ser po/ rgyab tu me rlung gi rang bzhin dzrīṃ dmar po/ g.yon du rlung rlung gi rang bzhin kham̐ ljang gu/ mdun du nam mkha'i rlung gi rang bzhin hūm̐ sngon po ste dpa' bo 'bru lnga po mgo gyen bstan du gsal gdab/ de nas rlung ro sbyang ba la/ lag g.yas pa rdo rje rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgyas sna bug g.yas bkag nas rlung g.yon nas sangs kyis lan gsum bus la zhe sdang gi rtog pa rnams dag par mos/ de nas lag g.yon gyi rtse gsum rdo rje'i phyag rgyas sna bug g.yon bkag ste rlung ro sangs kyis g.yas nas lan gsum bus la 'dod chags kyi rtog pa rnams dag par mos/ de nas sna bug gnyis ka nas lan gsum bus la gti mug gi rtog pa byang bar mos te dgu phrugs su bsal/ de nas dbu ma'i yas sne'i oṃ dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba rnams kyi me long ye shes kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od dkar po'i rnam par bsdus/ spyi bo'i oṃ dkar po de la thim pas me long ye shes dang chu rlung gi ngo bo thig le dkar po sran ma'am/ yungs 'bru'i tshad tsam du gyur/ de dbu ma'i mas sne'i zla dkyil chung ngu ma de'i dbus su hril gyis babs par bsams la/ steng rlung sa len ma'i tshul du sna sgo'i spu mi 'gul par brngubs la mchil ma sgra med cig nang du bskyur/ 'og rlung las 'og sgo zum tsam byas nas rlung kha sbyor bum pa can gzung zhing dmigs pa bskyed/ mi thub na dal bus rang 'gros su gtang*/ de 'dra yang yang bya/ yang dbu ma'i yas sne'i g.yas kyi ām̐ ser po las 'od zer ser po 'phros/ rgyal ba rnams kyi mnyam nyid ye shes kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od ser po'i rnam par bsdu/ ām̐ la thim pas mnyam nyid ye shes dang sa rlung gi ngo bo thig le ser por gyur nas/

mas sne'i zla dkyil gyi steng g.yas su babs par bsams la/ gong ltar bum can gzung*/ yang spyi bo'i dzrīṃ dmar po las 'od zer dmar po 'phros/ rgyal ba rnams kyi sor rtog ye shes kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od dmar po'i rnam par bsdus/ dzrīṃ la thim pas sor rtog ye shes dang me rlung gi ngo bo thig le dmar por gyur nas/ mas sne'i zla dkyil gyi steng rgyab tu babs par bsams la/ sngar ltar bum can gzung*/ yang spyi bo'i kham̐ ljang gu las 'od zer ljang gu 'phros/ rgyal ba rnams kyi bya grub ye shes kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'od ljang gu'i rnam par bsdus/ kham̐ la thim pas bya grub ye shes dang rlung rlung gi ngo bo thig le ljang gur gyur nas/ mas sne'i zla dkyil gyi steng g.yon du babs par bsams la/ gong ltar bum can gzung*/ yang spyi bo'i hūm̐ sngon po las 'od zer sngon po 'phros/ rgyal ba rnams kyi chos dbyings ye shes kyi byin rlabs thams cad sngon po'i rnam par bsdus/ hūm̐ la thim pas chos dbyings ye shes dang nam mkha'i rlung gi ngo bo thig le sngon por gyur nas mas sne'i zla dkyil gyi steng mdun du babs par bsams la/ gong ltar bum can gzung*/ de nas dbu ma'i mas sne'i zla dkyil gyi steng dbus su thig le dkar po/ g.yas su ser po/ g.yon du ljang gu/ rgyab tu dmar po/ mdun du sngon po rnams la sems bzung nas/ rlung kha sbyor ci thub thub tu 'dzin/ rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi gnad dang nus pa thams cad thig le de rnams la tshang tshul legs par bsam/ de ltar bsgoms pas rlung lnga'i kha dog so sor mthong ba sogs rtags rnams 'char bar 'gyur ro gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la tsaṇḍa lī bsgom pa dang*/ dbu ma kha dbye ba gnyis/ dang po gtum mo bsgom tshul ni/ de'ang lus gnad chos bdun ldan gong ltar byas la/ rang lhar gsal ba'i lus kyi nang thams cad stong par gsal gdab cing*/

rang gi lus kyi dbus drang por rtsa dbu ma khyad chos sum ldan mda' smyug 'bring po tsam/ g.yas su ro ma dmar mo/ g.yon du rkyang ma dkar mo gnyis gro sog tsam sum gshibs reg la ma 'byar ba/ ya yo med par drang thal le ba/ dbu ma'i yas sne tshangs bug tu zug cing*/ spyi bo'i thad kyi nang du haṃ yig dkar po mgo thur bstan du yod pa/ mas sne lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad du slebs pa/ ro rkyang gnyis kyi yas sne tshangs bug nas mdun du gug ste sna bug gnyis su har rer zug cing*/ mar sne dbu ma dang ring thung mnyam zhing lte ba'i bu ga'i thad nas bzung rtsa gsum ka sbubs stong gcig tu gyur pa ldi ri bar bsam/ rtsa gsum ka'ang 'od kyi rang bzhin shel sbug lta bu phyi nang mi sgrib cing dwangs seng nge bar gsal gdab/ de nas lte ba'i thad rtsa gsum sbubs stong gcig tu gyur pa'i nang der/ nang gi tsaṇḍa li'am/ bod skad du gtum mo zhes pa ma las thob pa'i khams dmar po lte ba'i a thung bam̐ yig gi ngo bor gnas pa de nyid skabs 'dir yi ge dbu can ram̐ yig dmar nag sran ma'am ril ma chung ngu tsam me'i rang bzhin can thig le nā da shin tu phra ba sum 'khyog 'dar zhing g.yo ba spus bris pa lta bu drod tsha 'ur re ba/ de'i 'og tu rlung dkyil ljang nag sran ma phyed bkas tsam gsal gdab/ de nas rlung ro bsal bar sngar ltar lag pa'i phyag rgya'am/ mig lta stangs kyis bcun te/ thog mar sna bug g.yon/ de nas g.yas/ de nas gnyis ka yang de 'dra tshar gnyis te lan dgu phrugs su sangs kyis 'bud cing*/ dug gsum zhi ba'i dmigs pa sogs ni bya mi dgos/ de nas steng rlung sa len ma'i tshul du sna sgo'i spu mi 'gul bar dal bus nang du brngubs la mchil ma sgra med gcig dang mnyam du lte ba'i thad du ldigs kyis mnan/ 'og rlung 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum cung zad dang bcas phyed tsam yar drangs pa kha sbyar du bzung la/

dmigs pa ni/ lte ba'i rtsa sum mdo'i ram̐ me'i rang bzhin can de nyid lte 'og gi rlung gnyis pos drag tu bus pas me lce rtse mo gsal zhing dwangs la tsha reg bzod par dka' ba dmar hur gyis 'bar zhing*/ ram̐ de'ang me dmar nag 'bar ba zhig tu gyur par bsam pa des lte ba'i rtsa gsum 'dus kyi sbubs stong de dmar deng nge*/ drod tsha 'ur re ba la sems gtad cing gsal thebs na 'dzin med du cham mer gzhag rtog pa 'phro na ram̐ yig nyid gsal 'debs/ de'ang rnam pa ma gsal na drod mi skye/ 'dzin med du ma bzhag na mu stegs byed kyi gtum mo dang khyad med ces gsungs/ dang por me gso ba'i dmigs pa nan tan bya/ thog ma nas me cher 'bar ba la sems gzung na/ dmigs pa kha 'byams te yon tan 'bul bar 'gyur/ de lta bu'i ngang nas rlung zug sogs cher ma skyes bar du gzung*/ da dung u tshugs kyis bzung na gegs kyi rgyur 'gro zhing*/ de bas sna sgo'i spu mi 'gul ba'i tshod kyis phyir rang babs su shar gyis gtang*/ yang gong ltar nang du brngubs la kha sbyor dmigs pa dang bcas te gzung*/ 'og rlung 'then ne ba ma byas na rlung gi yon tan mi skye bas rgyun du cung zad re 'then ne bar bya'o gsungs/ de ltar thun re la bum can nyer gcig gam brgya rtsa sogs ci thub bzung ste/ zhag bdun gyi bar sogs su bsgoms pas 'byongs rtags su/ rab khang pa'i nang tsam/ tha ma'ang lte ba dang*/ mchan 'og rkang pa'i sgyid khug sogs lus kyi khol bur drod tsha chil li li 'phyur ba dang*/ kha skam pa sogs 'byung*/ de'ang mi bde ba med par bde yam me drod tsha lam lam byed na tshad du 'khyol ba yin/ tsha zug sogs mi bde ba skyes na/ lte ba'i ram̐ yig shin tu gsal zhing phra ba la sems gtad na gegs sel du 'gro/ 'di ni gtum mo'i me kha gso ba zhes bya ba ste/ las dang po pas dbu ma kha dbye ba'i dmigs pa la thog mar me dmigs 'di rang zab cing*/

thig le la dmigs pa gtad drag na 'dzag gegs yod gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa dbu ma kha dbye ba la/ rtsa gsum sogs gong ltar gsal btab cing sngar ltar bum can bzung bas/ lte ba'i ram̐ las me 'bar ba'i bar sngar ltar la/ 'og sgo 'byed 'dzum gsum tsam dang bcas 'og rlung rdzogs par 'then pas ram̐ de nyid las me lce tsha rno dmar ngar ba rim gyis mched pa dbu ma phra ba'i nang du zhugs ma thag nas ro rkyang gnyis kyi nang du yar dmar 'ur 'ur 'bar/ lus kyi nang thams cad nyi ma dang me'i drod kyis gdungs pa ltar tsha lam gyis song nas/ lus kyi rtsa stong phrag don gnyis dang*/ rtsa phran ba spu'i grangs mnyam bye ba phrag phyed bzhi'i nang du gnas pa'i rtsa khams snyigs ma thams cad rang shugs kyis skam zhing bsregs te mi dmigs par gyur/ rtsa de dag la gnas pa'i haṃ yig dang khams kyi dwangs ma thams cad dngul chu lta bur zhu ste ro rkyang gnyis kyi nang nas bde chil li li babs/ lte ba'i rtsa gsum 'dus kyi sbubs stong mer gyis gang bar bsams la rlung bum can gzung*/ de nas 'og rlung cung zad 'then pas lte ba'i sbubs stong nang gi khams dkar po de rnams dbu ma'i nang nas yar song ste/ spyi bo nas lte 'og sor bzhi'i bar gyi dbu ma'i nang thams cad thig le'i dwangs zhun dngul chu zhu ba lta bu/ dran pas bde chen gyi ye shes skyed nus pas ltem gyis gang bar mos la/ rlung bum can gzung zhing mthar rig pa 'dzin med du had der 'jog de ni rlung sems dbu mar bsdu ba'i 'jug pa ste sngon 'gro'i rim pa yin no gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa rlung sems dbu mar bsdus zin pa'i dus su bsgom pa'i man ngag la/ rlung lus la bcug nas bde ba sgrub pa dang*/ sems la bcug nas stong pa sgrub pa gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ de nas ro rkyang gnyis dbu ma'i nang gi thig le dang bcas pa 'ja' ltar rang yal du song bar mos la/

dbu ma rkyang pa lus dbus su gnas pa'i yar sne spyi gtsug nas mar gug ste/ smin mtshams su bu ga har rer yod pa'i smin mtshams su chos 'byung dmar po gdengs ka che ba mdun ngos su bstan pa/ rtsa ba phra ba'i ngos su bug pa yod par dbu ma'i yar sne khrig ge tshud pa/ dbu ma'i mas sne bha ga padma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i rnam pa can gyi ze'u 'bru'i dbus su sor phyed do tsam bug pa har rer yod pa/ de'i sner chos 'byung dmar po gdengs ka che ba phyir mthur du bstan pa'i rtsa ba phra ba'i ngos su bu ga yod par dbu ma'i mas sne khrig ger tshud par bsam/ de nas smin mtshams kyi chos 'byung de'i gdengs ka che ba'i nang du thig le kha dog dkar po sngo mdangs cung zad chags pa 'od kha dog lnga khra phrom phrom pa sran chung gi tshad tsam/ skad cig kyang sdod mi tshugs par 'dar phril li pa/ bde ba'i rang bzhin can zhig la rlung sems zhugs pa ltar bum can dang sbrags nas dmigs pa gzung zhing*/ smin mtshams su bde lhang lhang ba/ grang shum shum pa/ tsha khug khug pa dang*/ na kar kar ba/ za ba/ 'khrig pa sogs bde gsal gyi rtags bcu 'char ba 'byongs pa'i tshad yin zhing*/ de dag byung tshe thig le de nyid dbu ma nas tshur zhugs te/ spyi gtsug gi dbu ma gug pa'i nang der ri rtse la skar ma shar ba bzhin 'od phril li li sdod par sems bzung bas gong gi rtags rnams 'byung ba na/ yang spyi bo'i thig le de las bde ba'i rang bzhin can gyi khams dkar po shel dkar bzhus pa'i khu ba lta bu sbom phra dar skud phra mo tsam zhig skya nar gyis babs pa'i sne mor thig le mu tig gi rdog po lta bu hril le yod pa zhig dbu ma'i nang nas mar bde hril li li 'phyang nas/ dbu ma'i nang gi mgrin pa'i thad tsam du slebs par bsams la/ thig le de g.yo zhing 'tsher ba la sems gzung zhing yas babs kyi dga' ba bskyed/

rim gyis gong ltar mar 'phyang ste snying gar mchog dga'/ lte bar khyad dga'/ gsang gnas su chos 'byung du sleb tsam dang*/ chos 'byung gi phyir sor do'am gsum bzhi tsam du nar gyis 'phyang bar bsams la lhan skyes kyi dga' ba bskyed/ de ltar bsgoms pas bde ba che drag pa dang*/ 'dzag gegs sogs byung na nyams dang bstun te thig le phyir nur ba chos 'byung gi nang du bsdus/ de nas rlung phyir 'pho med du bzung ba'i rkyen gyis thig le de nyid lte bar rgyangs kyis song bar bsam zhing mas brtan gyi dga' ba bskyed/ rim gyis gong ltar snying gar mchog dga'/ mgrin par khyad dga'/ spyi gtsug tu spro gzhi'i thig le de nyid la thim par bsam la lhan skyes kyi dga' ba bskyed/ de ltar byas pas lus kyi cha thams cad la bde ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa brjod du med pa/ zag med kyi bde ba yin nam snyam pa zhig gis khyab par gyur pa'i tshe/ grang ba dang tsha ba'i reg bya sogs la brtags pas gdung ba mi skye bar bde ba 'ba' zhig tu 'char na tshad du 'khyol ba'o// gong gi dmigs pa spyi dang*/ khyad par yas babs mas brtan gyi dga' bzhi'i dus su bde stong sbyar nas bsgom pa gnad du che'o// de ltar rlung lus la bcug pa'i dmigs pas khams kyi snyigs ma thams cad zad nas khams dwangs ma 'ba' zhig gis lus thams cad rgyas par byed pa yin no gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa rlung sems la bcug nas stong pa sgrub pa ni/ rang lhar gsal ba'i lus stong ra'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma yar sne smin mtshams dang*/ mar sne gsang gnas su thad bcad kyi rnam pas bu ga har rer yod par bsam/ smin mtshams kyi dbu ma'i nang du thig le kha dog lnga ldan khra chem mer ba/ sran chung tsam bde ba'i rang bzhin can zhig bsgom/ de nyid dbu ma'i nang nas yar 'dril te spyi gtsug dbu ma'i gug mtshams nang der/ ri mthon po'i rtse la skar chen shar ba ltar 'dar phril ler yod par bsam/

de la dmigs pa gtad pas de las 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan 'ja' tshon lta bu bun long gis 'phros/ dbu ma'i nang thams cad gang zhing*/ de las kyang phyir 'phros/ lus kyi nang gang bas rang lus 'ja' tshon kha dog lnga ldan du bsgyur/ slar yang 'od kha dog lnga ldan lus kyi phyi rol du 'phros pas/ gnas khang yul ljongs sa phyogs stong gsum gyi 'jig rten khams gsum gyi snod bcud thams cad la reg pa tsam gyis bde ba chen po'i rnam rol 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i rang bzhin du bun long nge*/ khra shig ge ba'i rnam par bsams la/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i nyams gsal stong 'dzin pa med pa rang rig rang ngo shes tsam du mnyam par bzhag de nas phyi rol gyi 'od de dag thams cad tshur 'dus/ rang lus 'ja' tshon du gyur pa la thim/ de'ang rim gyis tshur 'dus/ spyi gtsug gi rtsa ba'i thig le kha dog lnga ldan de la thim/ de nyid kyang je phra je phras rang yal du song bar bsams la/ bde stong gnyis med kyi nyams gsal stong 'dzin med du rang rig rang ngo shes tsam du mnyam par bzhag de las ldang ba dang*/ stong nyid de'i ngang las rang gi smin mtshams kyi sa tshod de ga'i thad du thig le kha dog lnga ldan khra chem gyis thol byung bar bsam/ de nas rang lus lha sku dang*/ dbu ma bcas sngar ltar gsal btab la/ smin mtshams kyi thig ler sems gzung*/ yang spyi bor spo/ rang dang snod bcud 'ja' 'od du bsgyur ba stong nyid la mnyam par gzhag pa sogs sngar ltar dmigs pa bskyar/ de ltar bsgom pa ni/ rlung lus la bcug pas khams kyi snyigs ma dwangs mar bsgyur zhing*/ rlung sems la bcug pas dwangs ma 'ja' lus stong gzugs 'od skur sgyur bar byed pa'i thabs bla na med pa ste/ yun ring du goms par byas pas 'byongs rtags su lus thams cad la bde bas khyab pa/ shing bal ltar yangs ba/ grib ma mi 'byung ba'am srab pa/ lag pa sogs nyi zer la bltas pas phyi gsal nang gsal lta bu 'byung ba/

rkang rjes chung du 'gro ba/ 'od kha dog lnga ldan du mthong ba/ sgrub khang la 'ja' mdung tshugs su zug pa/ 'ja' gur phub pa sogs 'byongs rtags byung tshe de brtan par bya ba'i phyir kun 'dar gsang spyod ces thog mar rlung gi reg bya lta bus sngar mi bzod pa'i grang ngad che sa zhig tu bsdad la/ rang lus snod bcud 'ja' tshon du khra shig shig bun long long du gyur pa la dmigs pa gtad nas stong nyid bsgoms pas/ sngar rlung gi grang reg mi bzod pa zhig 'char ba de mi 'byung bar bde chen du lhang lhang 'char gin 'dug na/ me'i 'od dang*/ nyi ma dang*/ chu sogs la sngar ltar sbyangs shing brtag de dag gis mi gnod par bde ba'i grogs su 'gro gin 'dug na/ grogs shig gis dbyug pas dal bus brdungs la gong ltar dmigs pa gtad pas bde ba'i ngo bor 'char bar 'dug na/ dbyug pas cher brdungs te sbyang*/ de sogs cher goms pa'i tshe gri mtshon sogs gnad du bsnun kyang skyon du mi 'gyur zhing bde chen 'char ba na/ gsang spyod ces pa/ dur khrod du phyin nas lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul la sbyang*/ rim gyis yi dam gyi lha dang*/ mkha' 'gros lung bstan pa'i padma can sogs las kyi phyag rgyar spros bcas spros med shin tu spros med/ phyogs las rnam rgyal te spyod mchog rnam pa bzhi spyad pas/ de la brten nas lus kyi dwangs ma thams cad rgyas te/ gser 'gyur gyi rtsis lcags la za ba bzhin du lus kyi snyigs ma zad nas 'ja' lus kyi ngo bor gyur/ snyigs ma'i skra dang ba spu so dang sen mo tsam bzhag nas/ 'od sku stong gzugs grub ste myur du sku gsum yan lag bdun ldan phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i go 'phang mngon du 'gyur ba yin gsungs/ ༈ /gsum pa 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa'i gnad ni 'og nas 'byung ba dang rigs mtshungs so// gnyis pa zhar byung yab he ru ka dang thun mong gi rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma che bar grags pa cung zad bshad na/

'di la gnyis te/ sngon 'gro dang*/ dngos gzhi'o// dang po la'ang thun mong ba dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa gnyis las/ dang po thun mong gi sngon 'gro bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ bde ba'i stan la 'khod nas/ mdun du bsgrub pa'i maṇḍal tshom bu lnga pa zhig bsham/ der skyabs yul gyi gnas khang sogs sngar bshad pa ltar byas pa'i gzhal yas khang gi dbus su seṅge'i khri mtho zhing yangs pa rgya che la lhun stug pa'i dbus dang*/ phyogs bzhir padma 'dab ma bzhi pa'i gdan re re gsal gdab/ gdan dbus mar bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje chos sku mdog dmar po rdor dril thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa longs sku'i chas can/ shar gyi gdan steng du 'khor lo bde mchog sogs yi dam/ g.yas su shākya thub pa rdo rje 'chang sogs longs sprul gyi sangaṃs rgyasaṃ/ g.yon du byang sems nye sras nyan thos rang rgyal dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos srung nor lha sogs dge 'dun/ rgyab tu 'gog lam bden pa'i ngo bo gsung rab glegs bam dmar po brag ri brtsegs pa lta bu gdong dar khra chem me bar rang sgra sgrogs bzhin pa'i chos/ de dag gi steng gi cha la grub pa'i dbang phyug rdo rje dril bu pa/ ḍombi pa/ antar pa/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa sogs nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar gyi bla ma thams cad g.yas skor du 'khyil ler bzhugs pa/ de dag thams cad zhal gzigs phyogs phyi nang gang bder bya zhing*/ de la phyi nang gsang ba de kho na nyid kyi mchod pas mchod cing*/ skabs 'dir mchod lha spro ba dang*/ tshig dngos su brjod pa mi dgos gsungs/ gang drin ma dang*/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma sogs kyis bstod/ de nas thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa la gsol ba 'debs so// bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes dang rim gnyis kyi rtogs pa khyad par can dus myur ba nyid du= da lta nyid du= 'dug sa 'di nyid du skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes skyabs 'gro dang gsol 'debs chig sgril gyi tshig 'di chad lhag med par dag par lan gsum brjod la gsol ba btab pas/ skyabs yul rnams kyi gnas gsum las bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing gsum cig car du byung ba/ rang gi dpral mgrin snying gar lan gsum thim nas sgo gsum byin gyis brlabs par mos/ de nas tshogs zhing rnams phyi nas nang mar bsdus te/ mthar bla ma sangs rgyas rdo rje chos la thim/ bla ma skyabs gsum kun 'dus su mos gus byas pas/ bla ma dgyes te 'od dmar po bye ru'i sgo nga tsam du gyur pa rang gi smin mtshams nas thim par bsam/ de'i rkyen gyis rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rmi lam sgyu ma lta bu snang la rang bzhin med pa'i skur krong gis bskyed la lta thog tu mnyam par gzhag 'di thun rer tshar drug gam bzhi re nges par bya dgos gsungs/ sngon 'gro gnyis par rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas gong du bshad pa ltar tshar drug gam/ bzhi re gtong zhing*/ dmigs pa dbang bzhi blang ba'i skor kho nar byed/ ༈ /gnyis pa thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la/ rtsa lam sbyang ba dang*/ rlung sbyang ba gnyis las/ dang po ni/ lteṃ baṃ'i paṃdmoṃ rlungaṃ lnga'iṃ tiṃ laṃ kaṃ /zhes sogs kyi don/ slar yang skyabs yul gong ltar gsal btab la/ yid sprul gyi phyi nang gsang mchod kyis mchod/ gsol ba gong ltar gdab/ skyabs yul rnams kyi gnas gsum las bdud rtsi dkar dmar mthing gsum babs pa rang gi gnas gsum du thim pas sgrib pa dag byin rlabs thob par bsam/ tshogs zhing 'khor rnams bla mar thim zhing*/ bla ma skyabs gnas kun 'dus su mos/ sum bha ni'i sngags kyis phyogs g.yon skor dang*/ mtshams g.yas skor gyis bsrung ba bya/

bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang la thim pa'i rkyen gyis/ rang nyid rdo rje rnal 'byor ma stong gsal 'od kyi rang bzhin can du lam gyis gyur pa'i rang lus stong ra'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma sba lcag 'bring po tsam mam/ mda' smyug tsam yar sne tshangs bug dang mar sne lte 'og sor bzhi'i thad du slebs pa zla dkyil gyis bkag pa/ de'i g.yas su ro ma dang*/ g.yon du rkyang ma gnyis po mgrin pa'i thad man chad dbu ma dang sbubs stong gcig tu 'dres shing*/ mgrin pa yan so sor gyes pa mgo bo'i nang nas gug ste sna bug gnyis su har rer zug par bsgom/ lus gnad chos bdun ldan gong du bshad pa ltar bya/ rlung ro dgu phrugs su bsal nas/ rtsa lam sbyang dmigs dngos la/ dbu ma'i yas sner zla dkyil steng du ti la ka'i thig le lnga tshom du bsgom pa ni/ dbus su nam mkha'i rlung gi rang bzhin gyi thig le sngon po/ de'i shar te mdun du rlung rlung gi rang bzhin thig le ljang gu/ g.yas te lhor sa rlung gi rang bzhin thig le ser po/ nub ste rgyab tu me rlung gi rang bzhin thig le dmar po/ byang ste g.yon du chu rlung gi rang bzhin thig le dkar po rnams rtsa dbu ma sba lcag tsam bsgoms na thig le rnams sran ma tsam dang*/ dbu ma mda' smyug tsam bsgoms na thig le rnams yungs 'bru tsam re bsgom zhing*/ thig le rnams gsal zhing dwangs la 'tsher ba'i rnam pa can du gsal legs par gdab/ slar yang rlung ro dgu phrugs byed/ lag g.yas kyi mthe bong gis srin lag gi rtsa ba mnan zhing*/ khu tshur bcangs pa brla'i rtsar gtad/ g.yon pas phreng ba bzung la/ thun chen gcig la nang gses thun chung lnga re byas pa'i/ dang por rlung sna bug g.yon nas rgyu ba dang thug na gegs mi skyed pas thog mar de dang sprad la/ rlung phyir 'gro ba'i tshe dbu ma'i mas sne'i zla dkyil steng gi nam mkha'i thig le sngon po las nam mkha'i rlung spos reng gi dud pa ltar sngo na ra ra dbu ma'i nang brgyud gyen du byung*/

rlung g.yas g.yon gang nas rgyu ba'i ro rkyang brgyud sna bug gnyis ka nas mnyam du rgyu na dbu ma brgyud smin mtshams nas song bar bsgom zhing mdun gyi bar snang du sor bcu gnyis kyi sa tshod tsam der sngo 'khyil gyis 'khyil/ de ma thag tu rlung nang du 'jug pa dang bstun tshur byung*/ sna g.yon nam smin mtshams nas zhugs/ dbu ma brgyud/ mas sne'i zla dkyil dbus kyi nam mkha'i thig le la thim par bsam/ de lta bu'i lag g.yon pas phreng bar grangs bgrang la/ rlung phyir 'byung ba/ mdun na gnas pa/ nang du 'jug pa gsum re la re re brtsis pas tshar bcu gcig tsam mam/ nyer gcig tsam byas te rtsa lam sbyangs nas/ ༈ /gnyis pa rlung sbyang ba la/ rjes ma'i mjug thig le sngon po de la sems cher gtad nas/ steng rlung lte 'og tu mnan/ 'og rlung ci bder bzhag la bum can gzung zhing*/ lag g.yas pus mor dal bus bskor la se gol gtog pa'am/ pus mo gnyis su reg tsam re byas nas/ dbus kyi g.yas phyogs su se gol re brdabs la/ rlung sna bug nas sna sgo'i spu mi 'gul ba'i tshad kyis btang la lag g.yon phreng ba re 'dren/ de lta bu tshar gcig bya/ mthar dge ba bsngo zhing ngal bso ba na thun chung dang po'o/ ༈ /yang gsol gdab tshar gcig dang*/ srung 'khor dran tsam byas la/ shar gyi rlung gi rlung thig le ljang gu la dmigs nas rtsa lam sbyang ba dang*/ rlung sbyang ba gong ltar lag stabs pus mor bskor ba gnyis kyi yun dang se gol gtogs nas bum can gzung ba ni thun chung gnyis pa'o/ ༈ /yang gsol gdab srung 'khor dran par byas la/ lho'i sa rlung gi thig le ser po la dmigs nas gong ltar pus mor lan gsum bskor nas se gol gtogs pa'i yun la bum can gzung ba ni thun chung gsum pa'o/ ༈ /yang nub kyi me rlung gi thig le dmar po la dmigs nas lag stabs pus mor lan bzhi bskor zhing se gol gtogs pa'i yun la bum can gzung ba ni thun chung bzhi pa'o/

༈ /yang byang gi chu rlung gi thig le dkar po la dmigs nas lag stabs su pus mo la lan lnga bskor nas se gol gtogs pa'i yun la bum can gzung ba ni thun chung lnga pa'o/ ༈ /de lta bu'i thun chung lnga re la thun chen gcig tu brtsi zhing*/ mthar dge ba bsngos la thun las ldang*/ thun chung gi bar rnams su skom 'dra btung dgos byung na 'thungs pas chog kyang bza' ba'i rigs za mi nyan gsungs/ khams ngal zhing dub na kha zas bcud can bsten/ de ltar nyin mo thun chen gsum dang*/ mtshan mo gsum ste/ zhag rer thun chen drug re bya/ 'gro lugs mi 'dra ba ni/ thun chen gnyis par nam mkha'i rlung gi thig le sngon po la dmigs pa'i lag pas pus mor bskor baṃ drugaṃ se gol dang bcas pa'i yun la bum can gzung*/ de nas rim 'phar gyis rlung rlung gi thig ler bskor ba bduṃn yun/ sa rlung gi thig ler brgyadaṃ yun/ me rlung gi thig ler dguṃ'i yun/ chu rlung gi thig ler bcuṃ'i yun la bum can bzung ste thun chen gnyis pa'o// thun chen gsum par nam mkha'i rlung gi thig ler bskor ba baṃcu gcigaṃ yun/ rlung rlung la baṃcu gnyiṃs yun/ sa rlung la baṃcu gsuṃm yun/ me rlung la baṃcu bzhiṃ'i yun/ chu rlung la bcoṃ lnga'iṃ yun du bum can gzung ba ni thun chen gsum pa'o/ ༈ /thun chen bzhi par nam mkha'i rlung la bskor ba baṃcu drugaṃ yun/ rlung rlung la baṃcu bduṃn yun/ sa rlung la baṃco brgyadaṃ yun/ me rlung la baṃcu daṃgu'i yun/ chu rlung la nyiṃ shuṃ'i yun du bum can gzung ba ni thun chen bzhi pa'o/ ༈ /thun chen lnga par nam mkha'i rlung la bskor ba nyeṃr gciṃg yun/ rlung rlung la nyeṃr gnyiṃs yun/ sa rlung la nyeṃr gaṃsum yun/ me rlung la nyeṃr bzhiṃ'i yun/ chu rlung la nyeṃr lngaṃ'i yun du bum can gzung ba ni thun chen lnga pa'o/ ༈ /thun chen drug par nam mkha'i rlung la bskor ba nyeṃr druṃg yun/

rlung rlung la nyeṃr bduṃn yun/ sa rlung la nyeṃr brgyadaṃ yun/ me rlung la nyeṃr dguṃ yun/ chu rlung la sumaṃ cu'iṃ yun du bum can gzung ba ni thun chen drug pa ste/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi dbang du byas pa'i thun chen drug rdzogs pa ste nyin dang po'o/ ༈ /nyin gnyis pa'i thun chen dang por nam mkha'i rlung la soṃ gcigaṃ nas/ chu rlung la soṃ lnga'iṃ bar/ ༈ /thun chen gnyis pa'i nam mkha'i rlung la soṃ drugaṃ nas/ chu rlung la bzhiṃ bcu'i bar/ ༈ /thun chen gsum pa'i nam mkha'i rlung la zheṃ gcigaṃ nas chu rlung la zheṃ lnga'iṃ bar/ ༈ /thun chen bzhi pa'i nam mkha'i rlung la zheṃ drugaṃ nas/ chu rlung la lngaṃ bcu'i bar/ ༈ /thun chen lnga pa'i mkha' rlung la ngaṃ gcigaṃ nas/ chu rlung la ngaṃ lnga'iṃ bar/ ༈ /thun chen drug pa'i mkha' rlung la ngaṃ drugaṃ nas/ chu rlung la drugaṃ cu'iṃ bar te nyin zhag gnyis pa'i thun chen drug rdzogs/ des rigs bsgres te nyin zhag gsum pa'i thun chen dang por mkha' rlung la reṃ gcigaṃ nas/ thun chen drug pa'i mjug gi chu rlung la dguṃ baṃcur 'gro bas mtshon/ de ltar zhag bco lnga'i bar du nyams su blangs pas/ nyin zhag bco lnga pa'i thun chung tha mar dbang po rab kyis bzhi brgya dang lnga bcu'i yun thub pa dang*/ 'bring gis nyin zhag dang po'i thun chen dang por rlung lnga se gol re re'i yun/ thun gnyis par se gol gnyis re'i yun la rim gyis/ nyin zhag bco lnga pa'i thun tha mar se gol dgu bcu'i yun thub par 'gyur zhing*/ gong du dang por bshad pa ltar sbyangs na gang zag rab kyis zhag gsum dang*/ tha mas zhag bco lnga na mthar phyin par 'gyur ro// de la thun chung re rer yang gsol gdab/ srung 'khor/ rtsa lam sbyang ba/ rlung sbyang ba cha tshang gis bum can 'dzin pa'ang shes par bya'o// 'byongs rtags su rlung lnga'i kha dog so sor mthong ba dang*/ rab yul khams/ 'bring gis khyim gang*/

tha mas lus tsam la bde drod chen po skye zhing*/ der brten bde ba chen po'i nyams su lus phra la dgyes rgur rol pas kyang mi mtshon pa 'byung bar 'gyur la/ 'di lta bu'i tsaṇḍa lī bsgom thabs ni khyad par du 'phags pa yin no gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bdag byin rlabs kyi dmigs pa dang*/ dbu ma kha dbye ba'i dmigs pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ sngon 'gro thun mong dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa gong bshad ltar byas la/ rang rnal 'byor mar gsal ba'i lus kyi stong ra'i dbus su rtsa dbu ma rta rnga brgyar gshags pa'i tshad tsam shin tu phra ba khyad chos bzhi ldan/ yas sne tshangs bug dang*/ mas sne lte 'og tsam du slebs pa/ g.yas su ro ma dang*/ g.yon du rkyang ma gnyis gro sog tsam lte ba'i thad nas rtsa gsum sbubs stong gcig tu gyur pa dang*/ spyi bo'i thad du rtsa gsum sbubs stong gcig 'dres su gnas pa/ de min so sor ma 'dres par gnas pa'i spyi bo nas rtsa dbu ma ltar mi mngon cing*/ ro rkyang gnyis sba ltar gug ste sna bug gnyis su zug par bsam/ dbu ma'i yas sne'i rtsa gsum sbubs stong gcig tu gyur pa'i nang du haṃ dkar po mgo bo thur bstan dang*/ de'i steng du rlung dkyil ljang nag gzhu'i dbyibs can sran ma bkas pa tsam yod pa/ dbu ma'i mas sne'i rtsa gsum sbubs stong gcig 'dres kyi nang du am̐ dmar po mgo gyen bstan klad kor dbu ma'i nang du chud pa/ 'og sgo gnyis kyi bar sum mdor rlung dkyil gzhu dbyibs ljang nag g.yo zhing rtsub pa/ rkang pa gnyis kyi mthil du dzhaiṃ yig ljang nag 'bar ba'i rnam pa can 'grengs stabs rkang sor ngos su yig ngo bstan par bsam/ de nas rlung ro dgu phrugs su bsal/ rlung bum pa can bzung la/ rdo rje skyil krung byas pa'i rkang sor rnams bskyed cing bsgul tsam byas nas/ 'og rlung cung zad yar 'then pas/ rkang 'og gi yi ge gnyis las rlung g.yos/

sum mdo'i bar du song*/ sum mdo'i rlung dkyil la phog de las kyang rlung cher g.yos pas mas sne'i am̐ la phog de las me drag tu 'bar ba/ dbu ma ha cang phra bas nang du 'jug ma nus bar ro rkyang gnyis kyi nang nas me lce rtse mo phra zhing rno ba 'bru mar gyi mar me'am/ gzung mo byi thur gyi dbyibs lta bu rtse mo phra zhing rno ba/ rtsa ba dang sked pa cung zad sbom pa/ yar dmar nyug nyug 'bar bar bsams la/ 'og rlung dal bus 'then/ steng rlung sna bug gnyis nas rngub chung drag po gsum byas te mnan pas/ yar sne'i haṃ gi steng gi rlung dkyil las thur du rlung g.yos/ ro rkyang nang gi me yar 'bar ba de gnyis ro rkyang brgyud thur du brdab cing ded pa'i dmigs pa byas la/ snying ga'i thad der steng 'og gi rlung gnyis kyis me de khrug chil chil sbur bar bsams la bum can ci thub 'dzin/ de ltar nyams len la brtson pas/ lte ba dang mchan 'og sogs su drod tsha chil chil skye zhing*/ rim gyis rlung lus la bcug pa'i mthus/ lus la gtum mo'i ye shes kyi me drod shin tu rgyas pa la rten nas/ bde chen gyi lus tshor skye zhing*/ lus shing bal ltar yangs ba yod du mi tshor ba 'byung*/ de la yun bsrings te bsgoms pas/ rlung sems la chug nas/ sems la'ang bde stong gi rtogs pa khyad par can mthar thug pa de 'di yin nam snyam pa skye/ de la brten nas mi rtog pa'i bde ba skye/ de la goms pas mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes lta bu'i nyams skye zhing*/ de nas du ba dang*/ smig rgyu dang*/ me khyer/ 'od phung*/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ sgra gcan te/ lus stod yod la smad med pa'i zla ba nag po 'jigs su rung ba'i rnam pa/ de nas re kha nag po ste/ nam mkha' nas thur du thig nag po brgyangs pa'am/ zhags nag brkyangs pa lta bu'i 'od gsal gyi rtags rnams 'char bar 'gyur ro gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa dbu ma kha dbye ba'i dmigs pa ni/

thaṃ maṃlaṃ 'oṃd kyiṃ gtumaṃ moṃ zhes sogs kyi don te/ rtsa gsal 'debs pa sogs yum gyi rtsa dbu ma'i tsaṇḍa li sgom pa'i skabs ltar byas la/ dbu ma'i mas sne ro rkyang dang sum 'dres kyi lte ba'i sbubs stong de'i phyir gdugs kyi rtsibs ma ltar/ rtsa 'dab brgyad gyes shing*/ de'i phyi rol du de las gyes pa'i rtsa 'dab lnga bcu rtsa drug bsgom/ rtsa'i mdog kyang gzhi la ser por yod kyang*/ sgom dus dkar dmar gyis mdangs dang ldan par bsgom dgos pas/ de lta bu'i rtsa 'dab nang ma brgyad la g.yon skor du a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha/ zhes khams kyi snyigs ma'i ngo bo yig 'bru brgyad po mgo gyen bstan 'grengs stabs su yod pa/ phyi rol gyi rtsa 'dab lnga bcu nga drug por ka kha ga gha nga nas/ ha kṣa'i bar gsal byed so bzhi/ a ā nas/ aṃ aḥ'i bar dbyangs bcu drug zhi ba lhas dbyangs ring po drug tu bshad kyang ma dag pa 'dra'o// a i u e o aṃ drug ste yig 'bru nga drug khams kyi dwangs ma'i ngo bo mgo gyen bstan g.yon skor du yod pa/ rtsa rnams dkar ser dang*/ yig 'bru thams cad dkar la dmar pa'i mdangs can du bsgoms kyang rung*/ dbu ma'i yas sne'i sbubs stong nang du haṃ yig dkar po mgo thur bstan gong ltar gyi klad kor nang du 'od kyi gtum mo dang spyi bo'i khams dkar po'i ngo bo kṣuṃ yig dmar po mgo thur du bstan pa/ dbu ma'i mas sne'i sbubs stong nang du aṃ dmar po gong bzhin gyi klad kor nang du tha mal gyi gtum mo'am/ dpe'i gtum mo dang*/ lte ba'i khams dmar po'i ngo bo kṣuṃ dmar nag mgo gyen bstan zhig bsgom/ de nas rlung bum can bzung la/ rkang sor bskyod pas rkang mthil gyi yi ge las me 'bar ba sogs gong ltar la/ mas sne'i aṃ las me 'ur gyis 'bar/ khams kyi snyigs ma'i ngo bo yi ge a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha rnams lhag med du bsregs/

aṃ gi klad kor nang gi tha mal gtum mo'i ngo bo kṣuṃ las me tsha rno ngar rtsub ste khyad chos bzhi ldan glog gi zer ma lta bu 'phros/ dbu ma'i nang gyen du 'bar zhing yas sne'i haṃ yig mgo thur bstan de la phog de'i klad kor nang gi 'od kyi gtum mo'i ngo bo kṣuṃ yig de las kyang me khyad chos bzhi ldan thur du 'bar/ yas mas kyi gtum mo'i me gnyis dbu ma'i nang du khrug chil chil 'bar zhing 'thab/ lte ba'i rtsa sbubs rnams su song ste khams kyi dwangs ma'i ngo bo dbyangs gsal rnams las me dmar 'ur 'ur 'bar bar bsam pa ste/ dmigs pa 'di nyid rang la gnad du bsnun/ de ltar byas pas spyi bo'i khams dkar po'i ngo bo haṃ yig de nyid mes gdungs pas/ byang sems 'o ma'i rgyun lta bu skra shad ltar babs pas/ dbu ma'i nang gi me 'bar ba'i rtse mo rnams cung zad thur du mnan nas snying ga'i thad du sob sgra dang bcas pa'i 'bar 'dzag la sems gzung zhing bde stong gi ye shes bskyed par mos/ me'i dmigs rim ni/ 'bar 'dzag bum can gang bsgoms kyang stong char rang rang gi dmigs pa dang*/ mthar 'dzin med du 'jog gong gi 'bar 'dzag gi tshe/ steng 'og gi rlung kha sbyar/ lus cung zad bsgul zhing bsgom/ des drod la sogs pa ha cang ches na cung klod la bsgom/ de ltar bsgoms pas dang po drod skye/ de nas bde ba skye/ de nas mi rtog pa skye/ de nas mtshon byed dpe'i ye shes nyams su myong ba skye gsungs/ 'di la thun ni dang por drug bya/ de nas rim bzhin dbri zhing mthar thun re rer bya/ de nas goms pa na lus kyi spyod lam ma zhig pa tsam gyis kyang rtags rnams 'byung la/ de'i stobs kyis dbu ma kha bye/ rlung sems dbu mar thim/ lus zag med 'ja' lus/ sems rtogs med chos kyi sku zung 'jug rdo rje 'dzin pa mngon du 'gyur ba yin no gsungs/ ༈ /de dag ni chos nyid brgyud nas ston pa'i gdams ngag ste/

༈ /chos nyid dngos su ston pa'i nyams len gyi gnad cung zhig bshad na/ smon lam las/ skye 'gag gnas gsum bral ba gdod ma'i gshis// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i don/ 'khor 'das snang srid kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang sems kho na'i rnam 'phrul las don logs su grub pa rdul tsam yang med par thag gcad/ sems de la'ang kha nang du log ste cher gyis bltas pas/ dang por skye ba'i rgyus stong*/ bar du gnas pa'i ngo bos stong*/ mthar 'gags pa'i 'bras bus stong pas na gdod nas rang chas su gnas pa'i gshis lugs ngo bo stong pa/ mtshan nyid gsal ba/ de gnyis dbyer med pa'i zung 'jug nyams su myong bzhin du brjod pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba blo 'das kyi rig pa skad cig ma 'di ka don dam pa'i rdo rje rnal 'byor mar thag gcad/ rang ngo 'phrod nas nges shes bskyed/ 'dzin pa ma zhugs par byas te nyams len gyi rgyun bskyang*/ rnam rtog gang skyes kyang de ka rang gi steng du bzo bcos ma byas par klod nas sems la sems kyis blta ba'i tshul du ma yengs tsam du bzhag pas rtog pa kho rang gsal stong zung 'jug tu rjen lhang gis 'char ba zhig 'ong*/ des mtshon te bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa sogs mnyam bzhag dang rjes thob kyi gnas skabs thams cad du lta ba 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi nyams len dang ma bral ba gal che ste/ brtse chen snying pos/ bskyed rim rtog pa yin mod kyang*// rtog pa'i ngo bo sems yin te// sems kyi mtshan nyid gsal rig yin// gsal rig rang bzhin stong pa nyid// stong pa gdod nas chos kyi dbyings// 'khrul pa chos kyi dbyings nyid du// shes pas rtog pa thams cad kyang*// ji ltar bsgoms kyang mi rtog nyid// btsal yang 'khrul pa ga la srid// ces gsungs pa ltar/ sems kyi gshis lugs brjod bral gyi ngang nas/ gdangs bde chen du ma 'gags pa'i rang rtsal lha dang gzhal yas khang sogs dwangs ma'i mkha' la 'ja' tshon shar ba ltar snang stong zung 'jug chen po'i lam la bslabs pas bskyed rdzogs dbyer med dang cir snang ye shes su 'char ba'i rtogs pa khyad par can ji zhig na skye bar 'gyur ro gsungs/

༈ /da ni ji skad du/ bsam mi khyab bya mjug sdud tshar chos ston// zhes pa'i tshar chos su nyams len lag tu blang tshul mdor bsdus pa'i tshul gyis 'chad pa la/ bsnyen mtshams dang*/ de ma yin pa'i dus so// dang po ni/ smin grol gyis rgyud gtams nas dam tshig yongs su dag pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ gnas dben par mar ngo'i tshes bcu lta bu mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i dus su snga dro gnas khang phyag dar bya/ rang nyid kha nub tu phyogs pa sogs gang bder 'di ga'i rten gsum dgram/ gtor ma lnga tshar sogs mchod gtor phyag len bzhin 'du bya/ rang gi stan 'og tu sa dkar gyis g.yung drung bris la khri drwa mig can sogs gdan mi rul pa'i thabs dang bcas 'bru dkar dang ku sha dgram pa'i khar rnal 'byor gyi stan 'du bya/ mdun du nang mchod/ ḍā dril/ bgrang phreng*/ 'bru snod/ gur yungs sogs gzhag sngon 'gro gtor ma dkyil chog ltar gtong la de'i tshig phrad bsgyur shes par bya/ gtor ma phyir dor bden stobs sogs dang sngags rgya ting nge 'dzin gyi tsham rngam dang bcas bgegs bskrad/ mtshams g.yog dang sman pa tsam mtshams 'og tu 'jug cha gsum dang sher snying bdud bzlog bya/ de nas rgyal chen gyi tho 'dzugs byas la nang du log dal 'byor rnyed dka' sogs shar sgom dang bcas skyo shes dang nges 'byung dga' spro sogs kyis blo bcos nas/ thog mar brgyud 'debs dang*/ rtsa ba'i bla ma'i sku bstod skad gsang mthon pos 'don/ gnas yo byin rlabs dkyil chog ltar bya/ skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te bsam mi khyab kyi bar gong bzhin tshig skam tsam ma yin par bsgoms/ rjes thun mtshams kyi lhar ldang zhing*/ gtor bsngo/ go cha bsrung ba/ bsngo smon sogs rgyas par bya/ slar srod thun skyabs 'gro nas bsdu rim bar gong bzhin la/ nyal lugs rnam gnyis gang rung gis nyal/ gnyid tha mal du mi gzhag sang nyin ldang ba'i rnal 'byor dang bcas bdud rtsi myang ba/

skyabs 'gro sogs gong ltar las/ nyi ma ma shar gong du thun grol/ chab gtor/ tshe sgrub/ ngag 'don gzhan rnams bya/ de 'phral thun bsdoms nas nyin phyed ma zin tsam la grol/ kha zas kyi rnal 'byor/ phyag bskor/ kha ton/ sku spar sogs dge ba 'grub tshad bya/ de nas thun bsdams te gnas yo byin rlabs dang bcas gong ltar bya/ nyi ma nub la nye bar grol te gtor bsngo gang rgyas gtang*/ tsha gsur dang smon lam sogs bya/ bir srung dang brag rdzong ma sogs srung 'khor gyi rigs 'dir bsgom/ de nas srod thun bsdoms te/ nam gung ma zin tsam nas bsam mi khyab dang bcas nyal ba'i rnal 'byor bya ba sogs rigs 'gre/ de'ang mdang bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor dus spros med kyi ngang du nyal na/ sang nyin mdang gi thun mjug bsdu ba sngon du 'gro dgos shing de yang dang po nas dngos gzhi la spar zin byas te sngon 'gro rtsis med du bzhag na lam gyi rtsa ba stor ba yin pas thog ma'i tshe sngon 'gro la hur 'don bya/ de nas dngos gzhi'i tshe sbyang gzhi legs par ngos gzung bdag gi gzhi sbyang bsgyur dang 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor/ ye shes pa dgug bstim rnams legs par bsgoms nas bya/ lam 'di'i khyad chos lus dkyil thun mong ma yin pa snyan brgyud ltar bsgoms la go cha bgo /sems 'dzin spyi dang bye brag la nga rgyal dang gsal snang dpyad 'jog bogs gang thon bya/ ma yengs par ngag bzlas dag par bya zhing*/ des skyo na yid bzlas gang nus bya/ zhar byung rdzogs rim gnyis po la nyams len gnad du bsnun/ bsam mi khyab thun mong ma yin pa lan bdun sogs bskyar/ srod thun gyi mthar 'pho ba gnyis gang rung bsgom/ gtor bsngo'i tshe yi dam rnal 'byor ma dang*/ chos srung dur khrod bdag po/ mkha' 'gro spyi dang gzhi bdag gtor ma rnams bya/ mkha' spyod zhal bzang blta ba'i smon lam dang*/ bkra shis byams pa chos legs kyis mdzad pa 'di gnyis byin rlabs shin tu che zhing longs spyod 'phel ba'i rten 'brel yod par gsungs pas ma chag par bya/

thun mtshams su'ang 'khyer so gsum dang ma bral ba'i ngang nas gang snang lam du 'khyer/ byung na khor yug tu ngag gcad/ de tsam ma grub na thun sgang ngag gcad dam zhing kha zas bza' ba sogs mi bya/ thog mar mtshams dogs pa/ bar du grims pa/ tha mar klod pa ste bsnyen pa nas 'dra mar bya/ bzlas pa 'gro che ba/ nyams rtogs skye ba/ rmi lam bzang ba/ lha zhal mthong ba sogs e 'ong gi re ba dang*/ bar chad nad gdon sogs i 'byung gi dogs pa sogs blo tshab tshub mi bya bar lha dang bla ma la blo bkal/ sems nyid kyi rang zhal bltas te blo bag lhod/ dam bca' mi 'dor ba'i zhe dam snying rus drag po byas nas rig pa brjod med du bzhag na rnam rtog lam du 'gyur/ rkyen ngan grogs su 'char ba zhig 'ong*/ bzlas pa'i grangs gzhi bsnyen la 'bum bzhi kha skong bcas/ dngos grub sgrub par dbang po'i khyad par gyis 'bum ther so bdun nam/ don bzhi'am/ brgya dang bcu gcig sogs su bzla/ de dag tshe'ang*/ nam 'chi cha med/ 'khor bar nges 'byung*/ sems can la snying rje/ bla ma la mos gus rnams lam gyi srog tu gzung*/ khas blangs pa'i dam tshig rnams mig gi 'bras bu ltar bsrungs nas nyams len gyi rgyun bskyang*/ yar mar gyi tshes bcur sgrub mchod/ lag mchod/ mar me'i sbyin sreg tshogs 'khor bcas bya/ bsnyen pa'i mthar zhag gsum sogs su phyi rol mchod pa bdag 'jug sogs bya/ kha skong gi sbyin sreg ci 'grub gtang*/ gza' skar bzang po'i nyin thor thun gyi mthar gtor bsngo rgyas pa dang bcas/ sgo drung gi rgyal chen la gtang rag dbul zhing*/ tho 'grol/ de nas rim gyis dam ldan gyi grogs dang 'phrad par bya'o gsungs/ ༈ /gnyis pa rgyun 'don sogs la ji ltar bya ba ni gong du bshad pa des phal cher mtshon nus so/ ༈ /rtsa ba'i sa bcad gsum pa lam des bsgrod pa'i 'bras bu mthar thug pa ji ltar 'thob pa'i tshul ni/ de ltar bskyed pa'i rim pas rgyud smin zhing snod rung du byas nas/

zab lam grol byed rdzogs pa'i rim pa bla ma'i man ngag ltar ma 'khrul bar nyams su blangs pas/ tha mal dang 'od kyi gtum mos khams kyi snyigs ma thams cad bsregs shing sbyangs/ dwangs ma thams cad ye shes kyi thig le'i ngo bor bsgyur zhing rgyas par byas pas/ rtsa stong phrag bdun cu don gnyis po thams cad gang*/ de nas rim gyis lus thams cad la khyab pas lcags la gser 'gyur gyi rtsis reg pa na skad cig gis gser du bsgyur ba ltar/ tha mal zag bcas ma dag pa'i phung po 'di nyid zag med 'ja' lus su sgyur/ rlung sems dbu mar chud pa la brten nas lus kyi rtsa gzhan thams cad ro rkyang gnyis la thim/ de nas ro ma e yig dang*/ rkyang ma bam̐ yig gi gzugs su shar te dbu mar thim/ rtsa 'khor gzhan thams cad lte ba'i rtsa 'khor la thim/ de'i rtsa 'khor nang ma'i shar gyi rtsa khams dbyug pa'i rnam pa can de nyid bam̐ gyi rkang pa la thim/ dbus kyi gri gug gi so lta bu de nyid bam̐ gyi lto ba la thim/ nub kyi thong gug lta bu de nyid bam̐ gyi mgo bo la thim/ lho'i tsheg drag lta bu gnyis bam̐ gyi zla tshes la thim/ byang gi nya mig lta bu bam̐ gyi thig le la thim ste/ mdor na rtsa 'dab bzhi'i rtsa khams thams cad bam̐ yig gi rnam par thim/ rtsa 'khor phyi ma'i ka kha sogs gsal byed kyi sde pa drug po thig le dkar po drug tu gyur/ de drug e yig gi g.yon gyi rkang pa gnyis/ g.yas kyi lag pa gnyis/ mgo gnyis te drug tu gyur cing e yig gi rnam par thim/ a ā sogs dbyangs bcu gnyis dang*/ ṛ ṝ sogs ring po drug rnams thig le dmar po gnyis su gyur nas e wam̐ spyi'i rgyur thim pa ste/ de rnams ni rtsa yi ge'i 'gros thim tshul lo// de dang dus mnyam du nang gi rtsa 'dab bzhir rgyu ba'i rlung gi 'gros kyang thim ste/ nub kyi sa rlung*/ byang gi chu rlung*/ lho'i me rlung*/ shar gyi rlung rlung*/

dbus kyi mkha' rlung lnga po snga ma snga ma phyi ma phyi mar thim nas snying po rlung gi 'gros thim pa'o// mthar de lta bu'i e wam̐ gnyis po'ang dbu mar thim pas nyon mongs dang shes bya'i sgrib gnyis phra ba'i bag chags dang bcas pa gtan nas spangs te/ rang lus 'pho med stong gzugs 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku dang*/ rang sems rnam par mi rtog pa ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i chos thams cad sgrib med mngon sum du cig car gzigs shing gang 'dul sprul pa'i zlos gar bye ba phrag brgya 'gyed pa'i kha sbyor yan lag bdun ldan e wam̐ zung 'jug rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang mngon du byed pa yin no zhes gsungs so// //'dir smras pa/ rgyal kun skyed yum shes rab pha rol phyin// spros bral thugs las sna tshogs gzugs brgya 'char// mkha' spyod lha dang dbyer med 'khor lo'i mgon// drin can bla ma slar yang spyi bos mchod// e ma bdag gis mi lus rin chen rnyed// yongs 'dzin thugs byon dgyes pa'i zhal ta gnang*// gnang tsam ma yin 'ja' lus sgrub pa'i chos// 'di 'dra thob pa mgon khyod kho na'i drin// de phyir dben pa'i ri sul nyams dga' ru// bzhad pa rdo rje'i rnam thar bzung nas kyang*// snyan brgyud thos lor mi 'jog nyams myong du// 'gel ba'i smon lam yid la ri mor bris// 'on kyang phyi bshol bdud kyi 'ching dbang gis// re ba ji bzhin ma grub bar der yang*// slob bshad bstan la sri zhu bgyis pa 'di// sgrub pa'i maṇḍal drin lan bsab phyir dbul// 'ga' zhig tshig gi me tog phang phung du// g.yo yang don gyi 'bras bu nyin skar bzhin// 'ga' zhig mthon po'i chos skad 'brug ldir kyang*// rang rgyud zhing sar phan pa'i char dang bral// kye ma thub bstan nub ri'i nyi ma 'dra// gsang chen bshad sgrub padmo'i 'dab ma rnying*// tshig bshad ser bu sgang la 'grim mod de// dpyod shes su yi snying la phan nam ci// kye kye grogs dag gyi nar ma bzhes par// gcig chog lam zab 'jog po'i gtsug rgyan 'di// bshad sgrub rang rgyud rgyal mtshan rtser mchod dang*// grub gnyis 'dod rgu'i bang mdzod lag thob pa// the tshom bral ba rgyal gsung tshad ma nyid// tshogs bshad bklag lung tsam min nyams khrid rgyun// byin rlabs drod rlangs ma yal 'chi med bcud// 'di 'dra skal ldan gdul bya'i gsos min nam// chos brgyad khri la 'gying ba'i ston sgom phal// 'di 'dra nyan pa'i snod min rna la gzon// gzur gnas thar 'dod mchis na 'di long dang*// 'khrul med mkha' 'gro'i snying khrag kho na yin// rgyal bas gang gsungs rnam mkhyen sgrub byed lam// de yi yang snying gser gyi bcud thig 'di// phongs par 'dug kyang snying gi grogs la bsam// 'di 'dra'i legs bshad sngon chad byung ngam ltos// rang bzo ra gan bsres pa'i bstan bcos 'ga'// blun pos gser du 'dzin kyang 'khrul pa ste// slob bshad gdams zab seṅge'i 'o mar mngar// snod ldan seng phrug nyid la bcud du che// 'dir 'bad bdag rmongs blo yi dri ma yis// tshig don skyon byung bla ma yi dam lha// mkha' 'gro gnas nyul dur khrod mgon la bshags// sngon bsags las nyon dang bcas dag tshangs stsol// khyad par zab gsang mkha' 'gro'i snying gi khrag

/gsal ches skyon byung snying nas bshags lags na// sgrib par mi 'gyur bstan pa'i srog zungs dang*// 'gro phan nyer 'tsho'i gsos su bsgyur phrin mdzod// dpal mgon keng rus che ba gtsigs pa'i zhal// yab yum dam can srung ma'i dbang po la// chos 'di gnyer du gtad do tshe 'di yi// snang can dam med log lta'i lag nas phrogs// dam ldan bstan 'dzin skyes bur gtod mdzod la// bar chad kun zhi bsam pa'i phrin las sgrubs// phyi nang mi srun bdud sde mthar gyis la// bstan pa dar rgyas phrin las khyod kyis mdzod// dge ba 'di yis bdag gzhan 'gro ba kun// mkha' spyod dga' mas rjes bzung kha sbyor gyi// bde chen la dgyes rdo rje 'chang gi sa// ma thogs tshe 'di nyid la mngon gyur shog /ces rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma nā ro mkha' spyod kyi bskyed rdzogs dmigs khrid mkhaṃ' spyodaṃ 'khriṃd paṃ'i saṃ mkhaṃn mdzeṃs paṃr byedaṃ paṃ'i rgyanaṃ zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ drin can bla ma blo bzang ye shes nas nor phyir grong du chos 'tshong ba'i brtul zhugs spangs te/ lha 'di'i bsnyen sgrub la brtson pa'i zhal bzhes thog 'di lta bu bris shig pa'i bka' bskul ba dang*/ nye char ri khrod pa byams pa mkhas btsun dang*/ dge legs dngos grub gnyis nas kyang ram bteg ste tshogs kyi 'khor lo dang bcas bskul zhing*/ rang nyid kyang gcig tu spro bas rkyen byas te/ snyigs dus kyi rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po dang*/ de sras rdo rje 'dzin pa kun dga' 'jam dbyangs rnam pa gnyis las/ zab gsang gi chos tshul bsam gyis mi khyab pa nos shing*/ khyad par du lam 'di'i smin grol tshogs bshad dang bklag lung tsam du ma lus par/ kha'u brag rdzong pa'i bshad srol 'khrul med mthil phyin pa rgyab brten dang bcas legs par thob cing*/ gzhan yang snyan brgyud bstan pa'i mdzes rgyan rdo rje 'chang 'jam dbyangs phrin las las kyang smin grol mang du nos pas bskal pa bzang por gyur pa/

dus mtha'i btsun pa ngag dbang dam chos rgya mtsho blo bzang bshad sgrub bstan pa'i nyi ma'am/ ming gzhan tshangs sras zla ba 'chi med lang tshor 'bod pa'i snyoms las pas/ tshar chen yab sras rnams kyi gsung tshad ma gzhir bzhag paṇa chen ngag dbang chos grags/ rig 'dzin padma phrin las/ rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub/ zhwa lu ri sbug sprul sku rin chen blo gsal bstan skyong*/ kho bo'i bla ma kun mkhyen 'jam pa'i dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i zhabs rnams kyis mdzad pa'i gzhung che phra dang*/ zhu chen ma hā paṇḍi ta'i khrid yig la'ang brtags/ blo chen shānti de wa'i zin bris kyi legs cha blangs/ bla ma'i gsung sgros kyis zur brgyan te/ mang ba dang nyung ba'i mtha' spangs nas/ gong smos bka' 'gyur ba'i bzhed pa bskang slad dang*/ rang dang skal mnyam phyogs zhen gyi dug chus ma bslad pa rnams la sman pa'i slad du/ rang phyogs zhen 'dod kyis rgyas bkab ma byas par tshad thub kyi lugs su/ rab tshes sa yos kyi lo/ mgo zla ba'i yar tshes bcu'i dpa' bo'i dga' ston gyi dus/ bkra shis tshangs dbyug gi 'bru sbyor nyin dbu btsugs te/ zla ba de'i nya stong la zla nyir sgra gcan 'jug pa'i nang gi zla nyi sgra gcan gyi lam du 'dzud pa'i rten 'brel dang bcas/ dmar phyogs kyi nyi ma me bzhi'i 'bru sbyor la phal cher grub par bgyis/ slar yang mig lam la phab ste mar gyi tshes bcur mkha' 'gro mnyes pa'i ston mo dang lhan cig yongs su rdzogs par bris pa 'dis kyang gsang chen zab mo'i bstan pa 'phel rgyas yun ring du gnas pa dang*/ kun mkhyen 'jam dbyangs bla ma yab sras kyis mtshon pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu thams cad sku khams bzang zhing zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa dang*/ bdag dang bdag la ltos pa'i bu slob/ rjes 'jug chos 'di'i gdul byar gyur pa thams cad kyi dam bca' mthar phyin cing 'pho med 'ja' lus zung 'jug chen po myur du 'thob pa sogs phan bde'i snang ba sa gsum na rtag tu 'bar ba'i rgyur gyur cig

/dpe 'di chos skyong drag po keng rus gzugs can dang*/ dam can beg tse lcam dral la gnyer ro// gtad do// bcol lo// gu hā sa ma ya*/ dge'o// sarba dā ka lyā ṇaṃ bha wantu/ dam med la gsang zhing rlung phyogs tsam yang bsgrag par mi bya'o// bkra shis dpal 'bar 'dzam gling rgyan du byon// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
